प: प The twenty-first consonant of the Deva Nāgri alphabet, corres-ponding to the letter P.

प m. (-पः) 	 1. Air, wind 2. A prince, a ruler. 	 3. A leaf. 	 4. An egg. 	 f. (-पा) (at the end of compounds). 	 1. Drinking, (as in अनेकप) 	 2. Guarding, Protecting, ruling. (As in गोप)  E. पा to nourish, &c. aff. ड ।

प(पि)ञ्जर mn. (-रः-रं) A skeleton. 	 n. (-रं) 	 1. A cage, an aviary, a dove-cot. 2. The ribs. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. The body. 	 2. The Kali age.  E. पजि for पिजि to dwell, &c. Unādi aff. अरच्; also पिञ्जर.
पक्कण: पक्कण mn. (-णः-णं) The residence of low or outcast tribes.  E. पच् to cook, कण् aff. and क substituted for च.
पक्तव्य: पक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 	 1. To be cooked or dressed. 	 2. To be matured. 3. To be digested. पच् to cook, &c. तव्य aff.
पक्ति: पक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 	 1. Cooking. 	 2. Ripening. 	 3. Fame, respectability. 	 4. Digestion.  E. पच् to cook, aff. भावे-क्तिन् ।
पक्तिशूल: पक्तिशूल n. (-लं) Inflammation with violent pain of the bowels proceed-ing from indigestion, cholic.  E. पक्ति, and शूल cholic.
पक्तृ: पक्तृ mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ) Who or what ripens or cooks. 	 m. (-क्ता) 	 1. The digestive faculty. 	 2. Fire.  E. पच् to cook, &c. तृच् aff.
पक्त्र: पक्त्र n. (-क्त्रं) The sacred fire to be maintained perpetually by the huse-holder.  E. पच् to mature, Unādi aff. त्र.
पक्त्रिम: पक्त्रिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Ripe, ripened, matured, cooked.  E. पच् to cook, &c. aff. क्त्रि and मप् added.
पक्त्वा: पक्त्वा ind. Having cooked, dressed, matured, &c.  E. पच् to cook, क्त्रा aff.
पक्व: पक्व mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्वं) 	 1. Mature, dressed, matured by nature or by art. 2. Fully matured, on the eve of rottenness or decay. 	 3. Perfect, come to perfection. 	 4. Able, shrewd, experienced, mature (as the understanding.) 	 5. Grey, (the hair.) 	 6. Digested. 	 7. Cooked, boiled. 8. Baked, burned.  E. पच् too cook or ripen, व substituted for क्त ।
पक्वकृत्: पक्वकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Cooking, maturing, who or what does so. 	 m. (-त्) The Nimba tree.  E. पक्व ripe, and क्वत् what makes; the leaves of the plant are applied to phlegmonoid swellings, to induce suppuration.
पक्वकेश: पक्वकेश mfn. (-शः-शी-श) Grey-haired.  E. पक्व, and केश the hair.
पक्वरस: पक्वरस m. (-सः) Wine or vinous liquor.  E. पक्व matured, रस juice.
पक्ववारि: पक्ववारि n. (-रिः) 	 1. Rice-gruel. 	 2. Boiling water. 	 3. Distilled water. E. पक्व boiled, वारि water; also read पङ्कवारि.
पक्वान्न: पक्वान्न n. (-न्नं) Dressed or cooked food.  E. पक्व, and अन्न food.
पक्वाशय: पक्वाशय m. (-यः) The abdomen, the stomach.  E. पक्व, and आशय receptacle.
पक्वेष्टका: पक्वेष्टका f. (-का) A burnt or baked brick.  E. पक्व, and इष्टका a brick.
पक्ष: पक्ष r. 1st and 10th cls. (पक्षति पक्षयति-ते) 	 1. To take or accept. 	 2. To take a part or side. भ्वा० चु० उभ० सक० सेट् ।

पक्ष m. (-क्ष-) 	 1. The half of a lunar month or fortnight, comprising fif-teen days. 	 2. A wing, a feather; (it is also neuter in this sense.) 	 3. The feather of an arrow. 	 4. Partisan. 	 5. friend. 	 6. A side, a flank. 7. An army, forces. 	 8. A house. 	 9. An argument, a thesis, a posi-tion advanced, doctrine to be maintained. 	 10. Contradiction, opposition, rejoinder, reply. 	 11. The subject of an inference. 	 12. Alternative. 	 13. A tribe, a class. 	 14. The ash pit of a fire place. 15. A royal elephant. 	 16. (In composition with words signifying “hair”.) Quantity, as केशपक्ष much or abundant hair. 	 17. A bird. 18. A bracelet. 	 19. Purity, perfection. 	 20. A limb, a member. 21. A tail. 	 22. (In Arithmetic,) Side of an equation in a primary division. 	 23. Condition. 	 24. A wall. 	 25. A party. 	 26. The subject of a syllogism or inference.  E. पक्ष् to take, aff. अच् or पण to tran-sact business, Unādi aff. स, and क substituted for the radical final.
पक्षक: पक्षक m. (-क) 	 1. A private or back door. 	 2. A side. 	 3. A sidesman, an associate, a confederate or partisan.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
पक्षचर: पक्षचर m. (-रः) 	 1. The moon. 	 2. An elephant strayed from the herd. 3. An attendant, a constant companion.  E. पक्ष a fortnight, &c. चर who goes.
पक्षज: पक्षज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced in a fortnight, &c. 	 m. (-जः) The moon.  E. पक्ष a fortnight, and ज born.
पक्षजन्मन्: पक्षजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) The moon.  E. पक्ष, and जन्मन् birth: the last.
पक्षता: पक्षता f. (-ता) 	 1. The nature or essential character of a proposition. 2. The taking up a side of argument. 	 3. Maintaining or defend-ing a thesis.  E. तल् added to पक्ष; also with त्व, पक्षत्वं.
पक्षति: पक्षति f. (-तिः-ती) 	 1. The first day of the half month. 	 2. The root or insertion of a wing.  E. पक्ष a fortnight, &c. तिन् aff. and ङीष् optionally added.
पक्षद्वय: पक्षद्वय n. (-यं) 	 1. A month. 	 2. Both sides of an argument, &c.  E. पक्ष, and द्वय two.
पक्षद्वार: पक्षद्वार n. (-रं) A private entrance, an inner or back door.  E. पक्ष a a side, and द्वार a door.
पक्षधर: पक्षधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Who or what has a part or side, a wing, &c. m. (-रः) 	 1. The moon. 	 2. A bird. 	 3. A partisan. 	 4. An elephant strayed from the herd.  E. पक्ष a half month, धर who has.
पक्षपात: पक्षपात m. (-तः) 	 1. Adopting a side or an argument whether right or wrong, partisanship. 	 2. A partisan, an adherent, who or what sides with. 	 3. The moulting of birds considered to proceed from fever.  E. पक्ष, and पात who cause to go, or पक्ष a wing, and पात falling.
पक्षपातिता: पक्षपातिता f. (-ता) Adherence, friendship, fellowship.  E. पक्षपातिन्, and तल aff.; also with त्व, पक्षपातित्वं.
पक्षपातिन्: पक्षपातिन् m. (-ती) 	 1. A partisan, a friend, an adherent. 	 2. Moving the wings.  E. पक्षपात, and इनि aff.
पक्षपालि: पक्षपालि m. (-लिः) A private or back door.  E. पक्ष a side, and पालि a point, &c.
पक्षभाग: पक्षभाग m. (-गः) 	 1. The side or flank of an elephant. 	 2. The side, in general.  E. पक्ष the side, and भाग a part.
पक्षमूल: पक्षमूल n. (-लं) The root or articulation of a wing.  E. पक्ष a wing, and मूल a root.
पक्षवत्: पक्षवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 	 1. Winged. 	 2. Having a side or party. E. पक्ष, and मतुप् aff.
पक्षवाहन: पक्षवाहन m. (-नः) A bird.  E. पक्ष a wing, and वाहन vehicle.
पक्षविन्दु: पक्षविन्दु m. (-न्दुः) A heron.  E. पक्ष a feather, and विन्दु a spot.
पक्षस: पक्षस m. (-सः) A wing.  E. पक्ष as above, असि aff.
पक्षसुन्दर: पक्षसुन्दर m. (-रः) A sort of tree, commonly Lodh.  E. पक्ष a part, सुन्दर, handsome.
पक्षाघात: पक्षाघात m. (-तः) 	 1. Refutation. containing. 	 2. Palsy, hemiplegia.  E. पक्ष, and आघात a blow.
पक्षान्त: पक्षान्त m. (-न्तः) The fifteen and last day of either half month, new or full moon.  E. पक्ष a fortnight, and अन्त end.
पक्षान्तर: पक्षान्तर n. (-रं) Another side or part, another view of the argument. E. पक्ष, and अन्तर difference.
पक्षाभास: पक्षाभास m. (-सः) 	 1. A seeming or fallacious argument. 	 2. A false plaint.  E. पक्ष, and आभास semblance.
पक्षालु: पक्षालु m. (-लुः) A bird.  E. पक्ष a wing, आलुच् poss. aff.
पक्षावसर: पक्षावसर m. (-रः) The last day of either half month, new or full moon.  E. पक्ष a fortnight, and अवसर conclusion.
पक्षिन्: पक्षिन् mf. (-क्षी-क्षिणी) A bird. 	 m. (-क्षी) 	 1. An arrow. 	 2. An epithet of Sīva. 	 f. (-णी) 	 1. A night and two days. 	 2. Day of full moon. 3. A female fiend, also called Pūtana.  E. पक्ष a wing, and इनि poss. aff.
पक्षिपानीयशालिका: पक्षिपानीयशालिका f. (-का) A trough for watering birds, cattle, &c. E. पक्षिन् a bird, पानीय water, शाला a hall, and कन् diminutive aff.
पक्षिराज: पक्षिराज m. (-जः) King of the birds, usually applied to Gadura. E. पक्षिन्, and राज for राजा a king.
पक्षिल: पक्षिल m. (-लः) A name of the saint VATSYĀYANA.  E. पक्ष् to take, इलच् aff.
पक्षिशावक: पक्षिशावक m. (-कः) A young bird.  E. पक्षिन्, and शावक a young animal.
पक्षिशाला: पक्षिशाला f. (-ला) A nest, an aviary.  E. पक्षिन् a bird, शाला a hall or house.
पक्षिसिंह: पक्षिसिंह m. (-हः) A name of GADURA, the bird and vehicle of VISHṆU. E. पक्षि for पक्षिन् a bird, सिंह pre-eminent.
पक्षिस्वामिन्: पक्षिस्वामिन् m. (-मी) GADURA.  E. पक्षि, and स्वामिन् lord: see the last.
पक्षोद्ग्राहिन्: पक्षोद्ग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Showing partiality, taking a side. E. पक्ष, and उट्ग्राहिन् taking.
पक्ष्णु: पक्ष्णु mfn. (-क्ष्णुः-क्ष्णुः-क्ष्णु) Who or what cooks or matures.  E. पच् to ripen, स्नु aff.
पक्ष्मन्: पक्ष्मन् n. (-क्ष्म) 	 1. An eye-lash. 	 2. The filament of a flower. 	 3. The point of a thread. 	 4. A wing.  E. पक्ष् to take, मनिन् aff.
पक्ष्य: पक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) 	 1. Produced or occurring in a fortnight. 2. Belonging to a side, &c.  E. पक्ष, and यत् aff.
पङ्क: पङ्क mn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्कं) 	 1. Mud, mire, clay. 	 2. Sin.  E. पचि to spread, aff. कर्मणि, करणे वा घञ् and च changed to क ।
पङ्ककर्वट: पङ्ककर्व्वट m. (-टः) Soft mud, especially such as is left by the retiring of floods, or on the banks of a river, a marsh, a quagmire. E. पङ्क mud, कर्व्वट the capital of a district.
पङ्ककर्व्वट: पङ्ककर्व्वट m. (-टः) Soft mud, especially such as is left by the retiring of floods, or on the banks of a river, a marsh, a quagmire. E. पङ्क mud, कर्व्वट the capital of a district.
पङ्ककीर: पङ्ककीर mf. (-रः-री) A lap-wing.  E. पङ्क mud, and कीर a parrot.
पङ्कक्रीड: पङ्कक्रीड mfn. (-डः-डा डं) Wallowing, sporting in mud. 	 m. (-डः) A pig.  E. पङ्क mud, and क्रीड who sports.
पङ्कगडक: पङ्कगडक m. (-कः) A small fish, (Macrognathus Pancalus, HAM.) E. पङ्क mud, and गडक another fish. (पांँकाल माछ) ।
पङ्कगति: पङ्कगति f. (-तिः) The Pancāl fish: see the last.  E. पङ्क mud, and गति going.
पङ्खग्राह: पङ्खग्राह m. (-हः) The makara, a marine monster.  E. पङ्क mud, and ग्राह a shark.
पङ्कज: पङ्कज n. (-जं) A lotus.  E. पङ्क mud, ज born.
पङ्कजन्मन्: पङ्कजन्मन् n. (-न्म) A lotus.  E. पङ्क mud, and जन्मन् birth; also पङ्कज, &c.
पङ्कजिनी: पङ्कजिनी f. (-नी) A pool or pond where the lotus grows, or a place abounding with that flower. 	 2. The flexible stalk of a water-lily.  E. पङ्कज a lotus, इनि and ङीष् affs.
पङ्कण: पङ्कण m. (-णः) The residence of the lowest and most impure tribes. E. पचि to spread, युच् aff.
पङ्कता: पङ्कता f. (-ता) Muddiness, the nature or property of mud.  E. तल् added to पङ्क; also with त्व, पङ्कत्व.
पङ्कधूम: पङ्कधूम m. (-मः) One of the divisions of hell.  E. पङ्ग, and धूम smoke.
पङ्कप्रभा: पङ्कप्रभा f. (-भा) A hell, the hell of mud or mire.  E. पङ्क, and प्रभा light.
पङ्कभाज्: पङ्कभाज् mfn. (-क् or -ग्) Sunk in the mire  E. पङ्क, and भाज् what shares.
पङ्घभारक: पङ्घभारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Muddy, laden with mud.  E. पङ्क, and भारक, burthened.
पङ्कमण्डुक: पङ्कमण्डुक m. (-कः) A brivalve-shell.  E. पङ्क mire, मडि to ornament, aff. उक.
पङ्करुह्: पङ्करुह् n. (-रुट्) A lotus.  E. पङ्क mud, रुह् to grow, aff. क्किप्; also with क aff. पङ्करुह n. (-हं) ।
पङ्कवास: पङ्कवास m. (-सः) A crab.  E. पङ्क, and वास abode.
पङ्कशुक्ति: पङ्कशुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) A cockle.  E. पङ्क mud, शुक्ति an oyster.
पङ्कृसूरण: पङ्कृसूरण m. (-ण्णः) The fibrous root of a lotus.  E. पङ्क mud, and सूरण a sort of root; also written पङ्कशूरण, and पङ्कषूरण्ण.
पङ्कार: पङ्कार m. (-रः) 	 1. An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria.) 	 2. A bridge or rai-sed bank, forming a path amidst inundated fields. 	 3. Stairs, steps. 4. An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa, Rox.)  E. पङ्क mud, ऋ to go, अण् aff.
पङ्किल: पङ्किल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Muddy, clayey. 	 m. (-लः) A boat, a canoe.  E. पङ्क mud, इलच् aff.
पङ्केज: पङ्केज n. (-ज) A lotus.  E. पङ्के in mud, and ज born; also पङ्कज.
पङ्केरुक्ष: पङ्केरुक्ष n. (-हं) A lotus. 	 m. (-हः) The Indian crane.  E. पङ्के in mud, and रुह what grows; also पङ्करुह.
पङ्क्ति: पङ्क्ति f. (-ङ्क्तिः-ङ्क्ती) 	 1. A line, a row or range. 	 2. A sort of metre, a stanza of four lines, each line consisting of ten syllables. 	 3. The number “ten,” (in composition, ut infra.) 	 4. The earth. 	 5. Fame, celebrity. 	 6. Cooking, maturing. 	 7. Associating with, eating or sitting with, especially with persons of the same caste. 	 8. A com-pany, a society, an assembly.  E. पचि to spread, to extended, to make evident, and क्तिन् aff. or पच् to cook, deriv. irr.
पङ्क्तिग्रीव: पङ्क्तिग्रीव m. (-वः) A name of RĀVANA.  E. पङ्क्ति ten, ग्रीवा a neck, the ten-necked.
पङ्क्तिचर: पङ्क्तिचर m. (-रः) An ospray.  E. पङ्क्ति, and चर who goes.
पङ्क्तिदूषक: पङ्क्तिदूषक m. (-कः) An improper person to associate with, an outcaste. E. पङ्क्ति, and दूषक who spoils.
पङ्क्तिपावन: पङ्क्तिपावन m. (-नः) A respectable or eminent person.  E. पङ्क्ति, and पावन who purifies.
पङ्क्तिरथ: पङ्क्तिरथ m. (-थः) DAŚARAṬHA, the father of RĀMA.  E. पङ्क्ति ten, (sides) and रथ a car, whose car goes on all sides.
पङ्गु: पङ्गु mfn. (-ङ्गु-ङ्गुः-ङ्गु) Lame, crippled, halt, one who has lost his legs, &c. 	 m. (-ङ्गुः) The planet Saturn.  E. पण् to engage in busi-ness, उ aff, and अङ्गु substituted for the radical final. खजि-कु-पगादेशः नुक् च ।
पङ्गुल: पङ्गुल m. (-लः) A horse of a glassy or silvery white colour.
पङ्गुग्राह: पङ्गुग्राह m. (-हः) One of the signs of the zodiac: see मकर.
पङ्गुता: पङ्गुता f. (-ता) Deformity, mutilation.  E. तल् added to पङ्गु.
पच: पच (डु, ष्) डुपचस् r. 1st. cl. (पचति) To mature by cooking or ripen-ing, to boil, to dress, to ripen; (इ) पचि r. 1st. and 10th. cls. (पचति-ते पचयति) 	 1. To make evident or apparent. 	 2. To represent, to state fully. 	 3. To spread.  E. पाके भ्वा० उभ० सक० अनिट् । व्यक्तीकारे भ्वा० आत्म० अनिट् । विस्तारे चु० उभ० सक० सेट् इदित् ।
पच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) Who or what cooks, matures, &c. 	 m. (-चः) Cook-ing, maturing, &c.  E. पच् to cook, aff. अच्.
पचक: पचक m. (-कः) A cook.  E. पच् to cook, वुन् aff.
पचत्: पचत् mfn. (-चन्-चन्ती-चत्) Cooking, ripening.  E. पच् to cook, partici-pial aff. शतृ.
पचत: पचत m. (-तः) 	 1. The sun. 	 2. Fire. 	 3. A name of INDRA.  E. पच् to cook or ripen, Unādi aff. अतच्.
पचतिकल्प: पचतिकल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) or adv. 	 n. (-ल्पं) Almost cooked or ripened. E. पचति what cooks, and कल्प aff.; implying incompleteness; also in a similar sense, पचतिदेश्य and पचतिदेशीय.
पचत्पुट: पचत्पुट m. (-टः) A tree, (Hibiscus phæniceus.)  E. पचत् here side to mean the sun, and पुट् to shine, aff. क.
पचन: पचन mfn. (-नः-ना-नी-नं) What cooks or matures, &c. 	 n. (-नं) 	 1. Cook-ing, dressing, boiling. 	 2. Maturing. 	 m. (-नः) Fire.  E. पच् to cook, aff. युच् or कर्त्तरि-ल्युट् ।
पचमान: पचमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Cooking, in the act of cooking or ripening. E. पच् to cook, &c. and शानच् aff., मुक् augment.
पचम्पचा: पचम्पचा f. (-चा) A species of Curcuma, (C. zanthorhizon.)  E. पच् to cook, reiterated, अच् aff. and मुम् inserted; it is also read पचम्बचा. पचं पाचकं पचति पच-वा० खस्-मुम् । दारुहरिद्रायाम ।
पचा: पचा f. (-चा) Cooking, dressing, maturing.  E. पच् to dress, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
पचि: पचि m. (-चिः) 	 1. Fire. 	 2. Cooking, maturing.  E. पच् to be cooked, (by it,) इन् Unādi aff.
पचेलिम: पचेलिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Fit to cook or ripen of itself. 	 m. (-मः) 	 1. The sun. 	 2. Fire.  E. पच् to dress or ripen, केलिम्न् aff. of the reflec-tive form, or Unādi aff. एलिमच्.
पचेलुक: पचेलुक m. (-कः) A cook  E. पच, and एलुक aff.
पच्छस्: पच्छस् ind. Foot by foot, or stanza by stanza.  E. पत् for पाद, and शस् aff. of several orders.
पच्यमान: पच्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being in the act of ripening, cooking &c. E. पच् to cook, pass, शानच् aff.
पज्ज: पज्ज m. (-ज्जः) A Sūdra.  E. पत् for पाद a foot, and ज born, from the feet of BRAMHĀ. पद्भ्यां जायते जन-ड ।
पञ्चक: पञ्चक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Five or relating to five, made of five, bought with five, &c. 	 m. (-कः) Any collection or aggregate of five, a five. 	 n. (-कं) A field of battle.  E. पञ्च five, and कन् aff.
पञ्चकपाल: पञ्चकपाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) A particular ceremony in which ghee is offered in five cups.  E. पञ्च five, कपाल a concave piece of pottery skull-shaped.
पञ्चकर्मन्: पञ्चकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Five actions of the body, viz. vomiting, evacuation by bleeding or by stool, diseased excretion of fæces or purging, and blowing the nose.  E. पञ्च five, कर्म्मन् an act.
पञ्चकर्म्मन्: पञ्चकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Five actions of the body, viz. vomiting, evacuation by bleeding or by stool, diseased excretion of fæces or purging, and blowing the nose.  E. पञ्च five, कर्म्मन् an act.
पञ्चकृत्वस्: पञ्चकृत्वस् ind. Five times.  E. पञ्च, and कृत्वसुच् aff.
पञ्चकोण: पञ्चकोण m. (-णः) A pentagon.  E. पञ्च, and कोण an angle.
पञ्चकोल: पञ्चकोल n. (-लं) The aggregate of five spices. viz. Long pepper, its root, Chai or Piper Chavya, Plumbago, and dry ginger.  E. पञ्च five, and कोल pepper.
पञ्चकोषा: पञ्चकोषा m. plu. (-षा) The five sheathes supposed to invest the soul, or the Annamaya kosha, that supported by food, the gross form; the Prānamaya kosha, the organs of action; the Manomaya Kosha, the organs of perception, with the manas or mind; Vijnānamaya, the same with the Buddhi or intellect; and the Anandamaya, con-sisting of the elements of identity and divine wisdom.  E. पञ्च, and कोष a sheath.
पञ्चखट्व: पञ्चखट्व nf. (-ट्व-ट्वी) A collection of five beds.  E. पञ्च five, and खट्रा bed.
पञ्चगव: पञ्चगव n. (-वं) A collection of five cows.  E. पञ्च, and गौ a cow.
पञ्चगवधन: पञ्चगवधन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having five cows.  E. पञ्चगव, and धन wealth.
पञ्चगव्य: पञ्चगव्य n. (-व्यं) Five articles derived from the cow; viz. milk, curds, clarified butter, cow's urine, and cow-dung.  E. पञ्च five, and गव्य from गौ a cow.
पञ्चगुण: पञ्चगुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Five times, five-fold.  E. पञ्च, and गुण multiply-ing.
पञ्चगुप्त: पञ्चगुप्त m. (-प्तः) 	 1. A tortoise, a turtle. 	 2. The atheistical system of the Bauddhas.  E. पञ्च five, (members, &c.) गुप्त concealed.
पञ्चगो: पञ्चगो mfn. (-गौः-गौः-गु) Bought with five cows.  E. पञ्च, and गो a cow.
पञ्चचामर: पञ्चचामर n. (-रं) A form of metre, in which the line contains sixteen syllables.
पञ्चचीर: पञ्चचीर m. (-रः) A Bauddha saint and legislator; also named MANju-GHOSA, apparently the teacher of this doctrine in Nepal.  E. पञ्च spreading, चीर rags.
पञ्चचूडा: पञ्चचूडा f. (-डा) One of the nymphs of heaven.  E. पञ्च, and चूडा a top knot.
पञ्चजन: पञ्चजन m. (-नः) 	 1. Man is general, a man. 	 2. The name of a demon, whose bones became the Conch Pānchajanya, the shell of KRISHṆA. 	 f. (-नी) An assemblage of five persons  E. पञ्च five, (elements,) and जन who is born.
पञ्चजनीन: पञ्चजनीन m. (-नः) 	 1. An actor, a mimic, a buffoon. 	 2. The chief of five men,  E. पञ्च five, and जन a man, or पञ्चजन man, and ख aff.
पञ्चज्ञान: पञ्चज्ञान m. (-नः) A Buddha or Bauddha sanctified teacher.  E. पञ्च five (organs,) and ज्ञान knowledge.
पञ्चत्: पञ्चत् mfn. (-ञ्चत्) Five.  E. पचि to spread, अति aff.
पञ्चतक्ष: पञ्चतक्ष nf. (-क्षं-क्षी) An assemblage of five carpenters.  E. पञ्च, and तक्ष a carpenter.
पञ्चतत्व: पञ्चतत्व mn. (-त्वः-त्वं) 	 1. The five elements collectively. 	 2. (In the Tan-tras,) The five essentials of certain rites; or wine meat, fish, sexual intercourse, and mystic gesticulations.  E. पञ्च, and तत्व an element.
पञ्चतन्मात्र: पञ्चतन्मात्र n. (त्रं) The five subtile rudiments of the five elements. E. पञ्च, and तन्मात्र element.
पञ्चतपस्: पञ्चतपस् m. (-पाः) An ascetic, who in the hot weather, sits amongst four fires, and has the sun for the fifth.  E. पञ्च, and तपस् penance.
पञ्चतय: पञ्चतय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. Having five parts or limbs. 	 2. Five.  E. पञ्च five, and तयप् aff.
पञ्चता: पञ्चता f. (-ता) 	 1. Death, dying, (i. e.) the separation of the five elements of whose aggregate the body consists. 	 2. The nature or condition of five, the aggregate of five or five times. 	 3. The five elements collectively, earth, air, fire, water, and Akās.  E. पञ्च five, and तल् abstract aff.
पञ्चतीर्थी: पञ्चतीर्थी f. (-र्थी) 	 1. Any five principal places of pilgrimage, especially Visrānti, Saukara, Naimisha, Prayāga and Pushkara. 	 2. Bathing on the day of the equinox.  E. पञ्च, and तीर्थ a shrine, affix ङीप् ।
पञ्चत्व: पञ्चत्व n. (-त्वं) 	 1. Death. 	 2. The sate or being of five. 	 3. The co-existence of the five elements. 	 4. An aggregate, &c. of five.  E. पञ्च five, and त्व aff.; see पञ्चता.
पञ्चथु: पञ्चथु m. (-थुः) 	 1. Time. 	 2. The Kokila or Indian cuckoo.
पञ्चदश: पञ्चदश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Fifteen or fifteenth. 	 f. (-शी) The fifteenth day of a half month, full or new moon.  E. पञ्च five, दशन् ten, aff. डट्.
पञ्चदशन्: पञ्चदशन् mfn. plu. (-श) Fifteen.  E. पञ्च five, and दशन् ten.
पञ्चदीर्घ: पञ्चदीर्घ m. (-र्घः) Marks on five parts of the body, the arms, eyes, belly, nose, and breast.
पञ्चधा: पञ्चधा ind. In five ways, five-fold.  E. पञ्चन् five, and धा aff.
पञ्चन्: पञ्चन् mfn. plu. (-ञ्च) Five.  E. पचि to spread, Unādi aff. कनिन् ।
पञ्चनख: पञ्चनख m. (-खः) 	 1. An elephant. 	 2. A tortoise. 	 3. A tiger. 	 4. Any animal having five toes or claws. 	 f. (-खी) A lizard.  E. पञ्च five, नख a nail.
पञ्चनद: पञ्चनद m. (-दः) The Panjāb, or country of five rivers, viz. the Sata-drū, Vipāsā, Irāvati, Chandrabhāgā and Vitasthā.  E. पञ्च, नदी a river, अच् aff.
पञ्चनिम्ब: पञ्चनिम्ब n. (-म्बं) Five parts of the Nimba tree:--the flowers, fruit, leaves, bark, and root.  E. पञ्च five, and निम्ब the Nimba, tree, (Melia azadiracta).
पञ्चनी: पञ्चनी f. (-नी) A chequered cloth for playing at draughts, chess, &c. E. पञ्च five, नी to get, aff. क्विप्.
पञ्चनीराजन: पञ्चनीराजन n. (-नं) Waving four things before an idol; a lamp, a lotus, cloth, a mango or betel leaf, and then falling prostrate.  E. पञ्च, and नीराजन presentation.
पञ्चपञ्चनख: पञ्चपञ्चनख m. (-खः) Five kinds of animals allowed to be killed and eaten, the hare, porcupine, alligator, rhinoceros, and tortoise. E. पञ्च, and पञ्चनख a five-toed animal.
पञ्चपल्लव: पञ्चपल्लव n. (-वं) The aggregate of five sprouts; six. of the spondias, rose-apple, Bel or marmelos, citron, and wood apple.  E. पञ्च five, and पल्लव a new shoot.
पञ्चपात्र: पञ्चपात्र n. (-त्रं) 	 1. Five plates collectively. 	 2. A Srāddha in which offerings are made in five vessels.  E. पञ्च five, and पात्र a vessel.
पञ्चप्राण: पञ्चप्राण m. plu. (-णाः) The five airs supposed to be in the body, and necessary to life. viz:--प्राण, अपान, व्यान, उदान, समान ।  E. पञ्च, and प्राण vital air.
पञ्चप्रासाद: पञ्चप्रासाद m. (-दः) A temple with four pinnacles and a steeple. E. पञ्च, and प्रासाद a palace.
पञ्चबन्ध: पञ्चबन्ध m. (-न्धः) A fine equal to the fifth part of any thing lost or stolen.  E. पञ्च five, and बन्ध binding.
पञ्चभद्र: पञ्चभद्र mfn. (-द्रःद्री-द्रं) A horse with five auspicious marks; or spotted on the chest, back, face, and flanks. 	 n. (-द्रं) A sauce or condiment of five vegetables.  E. पञ्च five, and भद्र fortunate.
पञ्चभूत: पञ्चभूत mn. (-तः-तं) The five elements; earth, air, fire, water, Ākās. E. पञ्च, and भूत an element.
पञ्चभूतात्मन्: पञ्चभूतात्मन् m. (-त्मा) Man as formed of the five elements.  E. पञ्चभूत, and आत्मन् one with.
पञ्चम: पञ्चम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) 	 1. Fifth. 	 2. Beautiful, pleasing. 	 3. Dexterous, cle-ver. 	 m. (-मः) 	 1. The fifth note of the Hindu musical scale. It is called Panchama, from being said to be formed by air drawn from five places; the navel, the breast, the heart, the throat, and forehead. 	 2. One of the RĀGAS or modes of music. 	 f. (-मी) 	 1. A name of DRAUPADĪ, the wife of the five Pāndus. 	 2. A che-quered cloth for playing at draughts, &c. a chess board. 	 3. The fifth day of a half month. 	 4. The ablative case, (in gram.) 	 n. (-मं) 	 1. The fifth. 	 2. Sexual intercourse.  E. पञ्चन् five, and डटि aff. with मट augment; or पञ्चपतीन् मिनोति वध्नाति प्रेम्णा । मी-वन्धे ।
पञ्चमकार: पञ्चमकार n. (-रं) The five essentials of the left hand Tantra ritual; “Madya” wine, “Maṃsa” flesh, “Matsya” fish, “Maithuna” copu-lation, “Mudra” gesticulation.  E. पञ्च, and मकार the letter M; all beginning with that letter.
पञ्चमवत्: पञ्चमवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having the fifth of any thing.  E. पञ्चम, and मतुप् aff.
पञ्चमहापातक: पञ्चमहापातक n. (कं) The five great sins. They are thus described in Vāchaspatya. viz:--ब्रह्महत्या सुरापानं स्तेयं गुर्वङ्गनागमः । महान्ति पातकान्याहुः संसर्गश्चापि तैः सह ॥
पञ्चमहायज्ञ: पञ्चमहायज्ञ m. plu. (-ज्ञाः) The five great sacraments of the Hindus, or the worship of spirits, progenitors, gods, Vedas, and man-kind, by offerings of perfumes and flowers, obsequial rites, oblations with fire, the study of the Vedas, and hospitality. E. पञ्च five, महा great, and यज्ञ sacrifice.
पञ्चमार: पञ्चमार m. (-रः) The son of BALADEVA. पञ्चविधकामे च ।
पञ्चमाषिक: पञ्चमाषिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of five Māshas, relating to, worth, amount-ing to five Māshas.  E. पञ्च, माष a measure of silver, ठक् aff.
पञ्चमास्य: पञ्चमास्य m. (-स्यः) The Kokila or Indian cuckoo.  E. पञ्चम, the musical note, and आस्य mouth.
पञ्चमिन्: पञ्चमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Being in the fifth year of one's age. E. पञ्चम, and इनि aff.
पञ्चमुख: पञ्चमुख m. (-खः) 	 1. A name of SĪVA. 	 2. A lion.  E. पञ्च five, and मुख face.
पञ्चमुद्रा: पञ्चमुद्रा f. (-द्रा) Five gestures to be made in the usual presentation of offerings to an idol.  E. पञ्च, and मुद्रा gesture.
पञ्चमूत्र: पञ्चमूत्र n. (-त्रं) The urine of the cow, goat, sheep, buffalo, and ass. E. पञ्च, and मूत्र urine.
पञ्चमूल: पञ्चमूल n. (-लं) The assemblage of five roots, viz:--The Bel, Premna longi-folia, Cassia, Gmelian arborea, and the Trumpet flower. 	 f. (-ली) A similar aggregate of five roots, considered as the similar one, viz:--Hedysarum gangeticum, H. logopodioides, Solanum melon-gena, S. Jacquini, and Tribulus lanuginosus.  E. पञ्च five, मूल a root; the fem. aff. has a diminutive import.
पञ्चयज्ञ: पञ्चयज्ञ m. plu, (-ज्ञाः) The five rites of a house-keeper: see पञ्चमहायज्ञ । E. पञ्च, and यज्ञ a sacrifice.
पञ्चरत्न: पञ्चरत्न n. (-त्नं) A collection of five precious objects; viz:--Gold, a diamond, a pearl, a ruby, an amethyst.  E. पञ्च and रत्न a gem. For particulars see Vāchaspatya.
पञ्चरसा: पञ्चरसा f. (-सा) Emblic myrobalan.  E. पञ्च five, रस flavour, taste. (आम्लकी)
पञ्चलक्षण: पञ्चलक्षण n. (-णं) A Purāna or mythological poem.  E. पञ्च five, and लक्षण a mark; Puraṇa should comprehend five topics; the creation of worlds, their destruction and renovation, the genea-logy of gods and heroes, the reigns of the MANUS, and the ac-tions of their descendants.
पञ्चलवण: पञ्चलवण n. (-णं) Five kinds of salt.  E. पञ्च, and लवण salt. viz:--काचकं सैन्धवं चैव सामुद्रं विडमेवच । सौवर्चल तथा पञ्चलवणं परिकीर्त्तितम् ॥
पञ्चलाङ्गलक: पञ्चलाङ्गलक n. (-कं) Gift of land to the extent requiring five ploughs. E. पञ्च, लाङ्गल a plough, कन् aff.
पञ्चलोह: पञ्चलोह n. (-हं) A metallic alloy containing five metals; copper, brass, tin, lead, and iron.  E. पञ्च five, and लोह iron.
पञ्चवक्त्र: पञ्चवक्त्र m. (-क्त्रा) 	 1. SIVA. 	 2. A lion.  E. पञ्च five, and वक्त्र a face.
पञ्चवट: पञ्चवट m. (-टः) The Brāhminical thread as worn across the breast; also पञ्चावट. 	 f. (-टी) 	 1. Five fig-trees, viz:--the Indian and the holy fig, the Bel, Grislea tomentosa, Rox. (धात्री) and Asoka, placed or plan-ted in several quarters; viz. east, west, north, south and south-east. 	 2. Part of the great southern or Dandaka forest where the Godāvari rises.  E. पञ्च, and वट the Indian fig.
पञ्चवर्ग: पञ्चवर्ग m. (-र्गः) A class of five persons or things.  E. पञ्च, and वर्ग a class.
पञ्चवल्कल: पञ्चवल्कल n. (-लं) A collection of the bark of five trees, the Indian and the holy fig, the opposite-leaved fig, the wavy-leaved fig, and a sort of reed; other trees are sometimes taken.  E. पञ्च five, and वल्कल a bark.
पञ्चवाण: पञ्चवाण m. (-णः) KĀMADEVA, The Indian Cupid.  E. पञ्च five, and वाण an arrow; being armed with five arrows.
पञ्चशर: पञ्चशर m. (-रः) KĀMADEva.  E. पञ्च five, and शर an arrow: see the last.
पञ्चशाख: पञ्चशाख m. (-खः) 	 1. The hand. 	 2. An elephant.  E. पञ्च five, शाखा a branch, the five-fingered.
पञ्चशिख: पञ्चशिख m. (-खः) 	 1. A lion. 	 2. The name of a Muni, the son of DHA-RMA by HINSĀ.  E. पञ्च spreading, शिखा a crest or mane.
पञ्चशैरीषक: पञ्चशैरीषक n. (-कं) The bark of five trees.  E. पञ्च, and शिरीष Mimosa sirisha, ठञ् aff. शिरीषवृक्षस्य पुष्पमूलफलपत्रवल्कलेषुच ।
पञ्चष: पञ्चष mfn. plu. (-षाः-षाः-षाणि) Five or six.  E. पञ्च, and षष् six, with डच् aff.
पञ्चसुगन्धक: पञ्चसुगन्धक n. (-कं) The aggregate of five aromatic vegetable substances; cloves, nutmeg, camphor, aloe wood, and Kakkola.  E. पञ्च five, सुगन्ध fragrance, कन् added.
पञ्चसूना: पञ्चसूना m. plu. (-नाः) The five things in a house by which animal life may be accidentally destroyed; viz:--the fire place, the slab on which condiments are ground, the broom, the pestle and mortar, and the waterpot.  E. पञ्च five, and सूना place of slaughter.
पञ्चाग्नि: पञ्चाग्नि n. (-ग्नि) 	 1. A collection of five fires, amidst which a devotee performs penance during the summer season; or four fires light-ed severally to the north, south, east and west, and the sun over head. 	 2. Five mystic fires, supposed to be present in the body. m. (-ग्निः) 	 1. A householder who maintains five fires, or the do-mestic one, and one for warming visitors in addition to the other three. 	 2. One who is acquainted with the doctrine of the five mystic fires. viz:--अन्वाहार्य्य, पचन, गार्हपत्य, आहवनीय, सभ्य and आवसथ्य ।  E. पञ्च five, and अग्नि fire.
पञ्चाङ्ग: पञ्चाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Having five limbs or members, five parts or subdivisions, consisting of five things, &c. 	 n. (-ङ्गं) 	 1. Any aggregate of five parts or five things. 	 2. Five modes of dovo-tion; viz:--silent prayer, burnt offering, libations, bathing idols, and feeding Brāhmans. 	 3. An almanack describing solar days, lunar days, and the periods of asterisms, Yogas and Karanas. m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. A tortoise. 	 2. A species of horse with five spots on his body: see पञ्चभद्र. 	 3. Reverence by extending the hands, bending the knees and head, and in speech and look.  E. पञ्च five, अङ्ग body.
पञ्चाङ्गगुप्त: पञ्चाङ्गगुप्त m. (-प्तः) A tortoise.  E. पञ्च five, अङ्ग limb, and गुप्त hidden; covering his head and legs beneath his shell.
पञ्चाङ्गुल: पञ्चाङ्गुल mfn. (-लः-ला-ली-लं) Measuring five fingers. 	 m. (-लः) The castor-oil plant.  E. पञ्च five, अङ्गुलि a finger, aff. अच्: the leaves having five lobes compared to fingers.
पञ्चाङ्गुलि: पञ्चाङ्गुलि mfn. (-लिः-लिः-लि) Having five fingers, or finger-like divisions. E. पञ्च five, अङ्गुलि a finger.
पञ्चातपा: पञ्चातपा f. (-पा) Doing penance with five fires, or four fires and the sun.  E. पञ्च, and आतप heat.
पञ्चानन: पञ्चानन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Very passionate. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. A name of SĪVA. 2. (With the mouth wide open) A lion. 	 3. A title used at the end of the names of learned men to express veneration or high scho-larship.  E. पञ्च five or spreading, आनन a face.
पञ्चामृत: पञ्चामृत n. (-तं) 	 1. A mixture of milk, curds, sugar, ghee, and honey. 2. The aggregate of any five drugs of supposed efficacy.  E. पञ्च, and अमृत ambrosia.
पञ्चाम्नाय: पञ्चाम्नाय m. plu. (-याः) Five Shāstras supposed to have proceeded from the five mouths of SĪVA, constituting the basis of the Tantra ritual.  E. पञ्च, and आम्नाय a scripture.
पञ्चाम्ल: पञ्चाम्ल n. (-म्लं) The aggregate of five acid plants; the jujube, prome-granate, sorrel, spondias, and citron.  E. पञ्च five, and अम्ल sour.
पञ्चारी: पञ्चारी f. (-री) A chequered cloth for playing draughts upon: see पञ्चाली.
पञ्चार्च्चिस: पञ्चार्च्चिस m. (-र्च्चिः) The planet Mercury.  E. पञ्च five, अर्च्चिस् a ray.
पञ्चाल: पञ्चाल m. (लः) 	 1. A country in the north of India. 	 2. It may either be applied to its people or their king. 	 f. (-ली) 	 1. A chequered cloth for playing at draughts, &c. 	 2. A doll, a puppet. 	 3. A style of singing. E. पचि to spread, Unādi aff. कालन्; also with कन् added पञ्चालिका.
पञ्चावट: पञ्चावट m. (-टः) The sacrificial cord, as worn crossed upon the breast, the ends hanging over the shoulders.  E. पञ्च spreading, वट् to surround, aff. अच्, आङ् prefixed to the root; also पञ्चवट ।
पञ्चावस्थ: पञ्चावस्थ m. (-स्थः) A corpse.  E. पञ्च five, (elements,) अवस्था state or condition.
पञ्चाशत्: पञ्चाशत् f. (-शत्) Fifty.  E. पञ्च, with शत् aff. and आ augment.
पञ्चास्य: पञ्चास्य mf. (-स्यः-स्या) 	 1. A lion. 	 2. SĪVA,  E. पञ्च spreading, and आस्य a face.
पञ्चेन्द्रिय: पञ्चेन्द्रिय n. (-यं) 	 1. The five organs of sense; the eye, ear, nose, tongue, and skin; or those of action, as hands, feet, windpipe, anus, and parts of generation.  E. पञ्च five, and इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.
पञ्चेषु: पञ्चेषु m. (-षुः) A name of KĀMADEVA, the Hindu Cupid.  E. पञ्च five, इषु an arrow.
पञ्चेष्मन्: पञ्चेष्मन् m. plu. (-ष्माणः) The five digestive fires supposed to be in the body.  E. पञ्च, and उष्मन् heat.
पञ्जराखेट: पञ्जराखेट m. (-टः) A sort of basket or wicker trap in which fish are caught.  E. पञ्जर a cage, आखेट hunting. “पोलो” इति भाषा ।
पञ्जि: पञ्जि(ञ्जी) f. (-ञ्जिः-ञ्जी) 	 1. The ball or whisp of cotton from which thread is spun. 	 2. A journal, a register. 	 3. An almanack.  E. पजि for पिजि to touch, &c. aff. इन् and ङीष् optionally added; also पिञ्जि.
पञ्जिका: पञ्जिका f. (-का) 	 1. The ball or skein of cotton from which thread is spun: see the last. 	 2. A perpetual commentary. 	 3. A calendar, an almanack. 	 4. A journal, a register. 	 5. The register or journal of YAMA, the record of human actions.  E. स्वार्थेक added to पञ्जि; also पञ्जीका.
पञ्जिकाकारक: पञ्जिकाकारक m. (-कः) 	 1. A writer, a man of the Kāyastha tribe. 	 2. An almanack-maker.  E. पञ्जिका a journal, &c. and कारक who makes.
पञ्जीकर: पञ्जीकर m. (-रः) 	 1. The Kāyastha or scribe. 	 2. An almanack-maker. E. पञ्जी a journal, &c. कर who makes.
पट: पट r. 1st cl. (पटति) To go, to move. r. 10th cl. (पटयति-ते) 	 1. To string. 2. To surround or encompass. 	 3. To share, to portion, to distri-bute. (पाटयति-ते) 	 1. To speak. 	 2. To shine. With उत् prefixed, To pluck up, to eradicate, to destroy utterly. With वि, To fly, to run away. गतौ भ्वा० पर० सक० सेट् । दीप्तौ० चू० उभ० अक० सेट् । वेष्टने, अद० चु० उभ० सक० सेट् ।

पट mn. (-टः-टं) 	 1. Fine cloth. 	 2. Coloured cloth. 	 3. A leaf or sheet of cloth, &c. on which any figures may be painted. 	 4. A veil or screen. 	 5. A tablet for writing or painting. 	 m. (-टः) 	 1. A kind of tree: see पियाल. 	 2. Any thing well made or polished. 	 f. (-टी) 	 1. A particular sort of cloth, coarse thick cloth, canvas. 	 2. A screen of cloth surrounding a tent, an outer tent. 	 3. A coloured or chintz garment. 	 n. (-टं) A thatch, a roof.  E. पट to sur-round, aff. अच् fem. aff. ङीप्ः see पटि.
पटक: पटक m. (-कः) A camp, an encampment.  E. पट to surround, वुन् aff.
पटकार: पटकार m. (-रः) 	 1. A weaver. 	 2. A painter.  E. पट cloth, and कार maker.
पटकुटी: पटकुटी f. (-टीः) A tent.  E. पट cloth, कुटी a house.
पटच्चर: पटच्चर n. (-रं) Old cloth. 	 m. (-रः) A thief.  E. पटत् imitative sound, and चर going. पटदिव वेष्टित इव चरति चर-अच् ।
पटमण्डप: पटमण्डप m. (-पः) A tent.  E. पट cloth, and मण्डप a house.
पटमय: पटमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of cloth. 	 n. (-यं) 	 1. A tent, a canvas house. 	 2. A petticoat.  E. पट cloth, मयट् aff.
पटल: पटल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) A heap, a number, a quantity or multitude. nf. (-लं-ली) 	 1. A chapter of a book. 	 2. A tree. 	 3. A stalk. 	 mf. (-लः-ला) A roof, a thatch. 	 n. (-लं) 	 1. A cover, a coating, an enclo-sing or surrounding skin or membrance. 	 2. A place, a spot, a circle or district. 	 3. A mark on the forehead with Sandal wood 4. A basket. 	 5. Train, retinue. 	 6. A coat or film over the eyes. E. पट् to go, कलच् aff.
पटलप्रान्त: पटलप्रान्त m. (-न्तः) The edge of a thatch.  E. पटल a thatch, and प्रान्त end.
पटवाप: पटवाप m. (-पः) A tent.  E. पट cloth, and वाप what is woven.
पटवास: पटवास m. (-सः) 	 1. A tent. 	 2. A petticoat. 	 3. Perfumed powder. E. पट cloth, वास abode, or वस् to perfume, aff. अच्.
पटवासक: पटवासक m. (-कः) Perfumed powder.  E. कन् added to the last.
पटवेश्मन्: पटवेश्मन् n. (-श्म) A tent.  E. पट, and वेश्मन् a house.
पटह: पटह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) A kettle-drum. 	 m. (-हः) 	 1. A war-drum, or one used in battle. 	 2. Injury, killing, slaughter. 	 4. Tumult.  E. पट imitative sound, हा to quit or make, aff. ड ।
पटाक: पटाक m. (-कः) A kind of bird. 	 f. (-का) A flag, a banner.  E. पट to go, आक Unādi aff.
पटालुका: पटालुका f. (-का) A leech.  E. पट् to go, आलुच् aff., कन् added.
पटि: पटि(टी) f. (-टिः or -टी) 	 1. A kind of cloth. 	 2. An aquatic plant: see कुम्मिका. 	 3. The curtain of a stage. 	 4. A screen of a cloth surround-ing a tent.  E. पट् to surround, &c. aff. इन् or ङीप् । see पट and पटी.
पटिका: पटिका f. (-का) Cloth.  E. वुन् added to पटी.
पटिष्ठ: पटिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Very clever.  E. पटु and irr. superlative.
पटीयस्: पटीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very clever or able.  E. पटु clever, ईयसुन् aff. of the superlative.
पटीर: पटीर n. (-रं) 	 1. Sandal-wood. 	 2. A field. 	 3. Bamboo manna. 	 4. A radish. 	 5. The belly. 	 6. A sieve. 	 7. Height. 	 8. Khayar. 	 9. Rheu-matism. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. KANDARPA. 	 2. A cloud.  E. पट् to go, Unādi aff. ईरन्.
पटु: पटु mfn. (-टुः-ट्वी-टु) 	 1. Clever, dexterous, skilful. 	 2. Diligent. 	 3. Smart, sharp. 	 4. Hale, healthy. 	 5. Warm, hot. 	 6. Blown, ex-panded. 	 7. Cruel, ferocious, unmerciful, unfeeling. 	 8. Harsh, contumelious, (speech, &c.) 	 9. Fraudulent, crafty, a rogue or cheat. 	 10. Loquacious, talkative. 	 m. (-टुः) 	 1. A small kind of cucumber. (Trichosanthes diœca.) 	 2. The leaf of the Trichosanthes. n. (-टु) 	 1. Salt. 	 2. A mushroom.  E. पट r. 10th cl. to speak, &c. Unādi aff. डु, and the radical vowel shortened. or पट-उन् ।
पटुक: पटुक m. (-कः) A sort of gourd.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
पटुकल्प: पटुकल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) Not so clever, a little less able, &c.  E. पटु clever, and कल्प aff. of incompleteness; also in a similar sense पटुदेश्य, and पटुदेशीय ।
पटुजातीय: पटुजातीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of a clever sort, &c.  E. पटु as above, and जातीय aff. of kind.
पटुत्व: पटुत्व n. (-त्वं) 	 1. Cleverness. 	 2. Eloquence.  E. त्व added to पटु; also with तल्, पटुता.
पटुपर्णी: पटुपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A medicinal sort of moon plant.  E. पटु a sort of gourd, and पर्ण a leaf, fem. aff. ङीष्; also पटुपत्रक n. (-कं) and पटुपत्रिका f. (-का.)
पटुरूप: पटुरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Very clever.  E. पटु, and रूप here implying much.
पटोटज: पटोटज m. (-जं) A tent.  E. पट and उटज a house.
पटोल: पटोल m. (-लः) A kind of cucumber, commonly Parwor, (Trichosanthes diœca.) 	 n. (-लं) A sort of cloth, a kind of chintz. 	 f. (-ली) A small cucumber, either the same as above, (Trichosanthes diœca,) or another kind, (Luffa acutangula.)  E. पट् to go, in the causal form, aff. ओलच्; removing malady.
पटोलक: पटोलक m. (-कः) An oyster.  E. पटोल as above, and कन् aff. of res-emblance; compared to the shape of the Trichosanthes.
पटोलिका: पटोलिका f. (-का) A small cucumber, (Trichosanthes diœca:) it is also applied to Luffa acutangula.  E. कन् with the fem. form added to पटोली.
पट्ट: पट्ट m. (-ट्टः) 	 1. Cloth. 	 2. Coloured cloth, wove silk. 	 4. A turban, &c. or cloth for that purpose. 	 5. A coloured silk turban. 	 6. A fillet bound round the head. 	 7. A bandage, a ligature, a cloth bound round a sore, &c. 	 8. An upper or outer garment. 	 9. A plant, com-monly called Pāt, (Corchorus,) from the fibres of the bark of which, (called jute) a coarse sack-cloth and cordage are prepared. 10. A stone for grinding with a mullar. 	 11. A plate of metal for inscription or engraving. 	 12. A royal grant or order written on copper, stone, &c. 	 13. A shield. 	 14. A place where four roads meet. 	 15. A chair, a stool. 	 n. (-ट्टं) A city, a town, a village, the Pettāh probably of the south. 	 f. (ट्टा) 	 1. An ornament of the fore-head. 	 2. Red Lodh. 	 3. A horse's girth.  E. पट् to surround, क्त aff. and त changed to ट.
पट्ट(त्त)न n. (-नं-नी) A city:  E. पट(त)न्ति जना यत्र पट पत, वा तनन् नेट् ।
पट्टक: पट्टक m. (-कः) Cloth, a bandage, &c.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
पट्टज: पट्टज n. (-जं) A sort of cloth, probably a kind of canvas or sack-cloth. E. पट्ट as above, and ज produced; made from jute. कौशेयवस्त्रेच ।
पट्टदेवी: पट्टदेवी f. (-वी) A principal queen.  E. पट्ट a fillet or tiara, देवी a queen.
पट्टबन्धन: पट्टबन्धन n. (-नं) Crowing, binding the head with a fillet or tiara. E. पट्ट, and बन्धन binding.
पट्टमहिषी: पट्टमहिषी f. (-षी) A principal queen.  E. पट्ट a fillet or tiara, and महिषी a queen. (पाटराणी) ।
पट्टरङ्ग: पट्टरङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) A plant used in dying, (Cœsalpinia sappan.)  E. पट्ट cloth, and रञ्ज to dye, aff. करणे घञ् (वकम्) ।
पट्टरञ्जन: पट्टरञ्जन n. (-नं) Sappen wood.  E. पट्ट cloth, and रञ्जन colouring: with कन् added, पट्टरञ्जक.
पट्टशाक: पट्टशाक n. (-कं) A sort of potherb, commonly called Nālita, (Corchorus capsularis.)  E. पट्ट Corchorus, and शाक a potherb; the leaves re-sembling to those of the Pāt. नालिता, वा पाटशाक् ।
पट्टारोहा: पट्टारोहा f. (-हा) A principal queen.  E. पट्ट, and आरोह what mounts.
पट्टिका: पट्टिका f. (-का) Lodh.  E. पट्टी the same, कन् added: again with आख्या a name; it is read also पट्ठिकाख्य, mf. (-ख्यः-ख्या)
पट्टिन्: पट्टिन् m. (-ट्टी) Red Lodh; also पट्टी.
पट्टिल: पट्टिल m. (-लः) A plant, (Cæsalpinia bonduccella.)  E. पट्ट + अस्त्यर्थे -इलच् ।
पट्टि: पट्टि(का)लोध्र m. (-ध्रः) A sort of tree, the bark of which is used as an astringent; the red species of the Lodh, (Symploces racemosa, Rox.)  E. पट्टी the same plant, लोध्र the Lodh; also with कन् added पट्टिलोध्रक.
पट्टिश: पट्टिश(स) m. (-शः -or -सः) A sort of weapon, a kind of axe.  E. पट् to go, aff. टिश् or टिस्; whence it is also read पट्टिस.
पट्टोलिका: पट्टोलिका f. (-का) 	 1. A title deed, a Pāttā, a lease, &c. 	 2. A written legal opinion.  E. पट्ट a royal mandate, &c. ओलच् aff., कन् in the fem form added.
पठ: पठ r. 1st. cl. (पठति) To speak articulately, to declaim, to recite or read. भ्वा० पर० सक० सेट् ।
पठत्: पठत् mfn. (-ठन्-ठन्ती-ठत्) Reading, reciting.  E. पठ् to read, शतृ part. aff.
पठन: पठन n. (-नं) Reading, reciting.  E. पठ् to read, ल्युट् aff.
पठनीय: पठनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Readable, to be read.  E. पठ् to read, अनीयर् aff.
पठमञ्जरी: पठमञ्जरी f. (-री) A Rāgīni, one of the wives of SRĪRĀGA.
पठि: पठि f. (-ठिः-ठी) Reading, perusal.  E. पठ् to read, aff. इन्, ङीष् option-ally added.
पटित: पटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Read, studied. 	 2. Recited, repeated.  E. पठ् to read, क्त aff.
पठितव्य: पठितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be read, what may or ought to be read. E. पठ् to read, तव्य aff.
पठितृ: पठितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Reading, reciting, a reader.  E. पठ् to read, तृच् aff.
पठ्यमान: पठ्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being read or recited.  E. पठ् to read, poss. v. शानच् aff.
पड: पड (इ) पडि r. 1st. cl. (पण्डते) To go, to move. r. 1st. and 10th. cls. (पण्डति पण्डयति-ते) 	 1. To destroy, to annihilate. 	 2. To heap together, to accumulate. गतौ भ्वा० आ० सक०-सेट्-इदित् । राशीकरणे चु० उभ० सक० सेट् ।
पण: पण r. 1st cl. (पणते) also 10th. cl. (पणयति) 	 1. To negociate, to treat or transact business. 	 2. To bet or stake at play. (पणायति) To praise. व्यवहारे स्तुतौच भ्वा० आ० सक० सेट् ।

पण m. (-णः) 	 1. Measure of account, in cowries or shells, twenty gandās or eighty cowries; also a weight of copper of similar value. 	 2. Wages or hire. 	 3. A stake at play, a bet, a wager. 	 4. Gaming, playing. 	 5. Playing with dice. 	 6. Price. 	 7. Wealth, property 8. A commodity for sale. 	 9. Business. 	 10. A distiller. 	 11. A house, a dwelling. 	 12. A stipulation, a treaty. 	 13. A vendor. 	 14. A shop.  E. पण् to do business, aff. अप् ।
पणग्रन्थि: पणग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) A fair, a market.  E. पण a commodity, ग्रन्थि a knot.
पणता: पणता f. (-ता) 	 1. The state or condition of a pledge or stake. 	 2. Price, value.  E. तल् added to पण; also with त्व, पणत्वं.
पणन: पणन n. (-नं) 	 1. Sale, selling. 	 2. Betting.  E. पण् to do business, aff. भावे ल्युट्.
पणव: पणव mf. (-वः-वा) A sort of musical instrument; a small drum or tabor.  E. पण् business or price, वा to sound, aff. क; it is also read प्रणव.
पणस: पणस m. (-सः) A commodity, an article of sale or traffic.  E. पण् to do business, Unādi aff. कर्मणि-असच् ।
पणाङ्गना: पणाङ्गना f. (-ना) A prostitute, a whore,  E. पण price, अङ्गना a woman.
पणाया: पणाया f. (-या) Business, affair, transaction, buying and selling, &c. 2. Profits or receipts of trade. 	 3. A market place. 	 4. Gambling. 5. Praise.  E. पण् to negociate, in the causal form, अच् and टाप् affs.; or पण, and आय income, it also occurs mas. (-यः).
पणायित: पणायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Praised. 	 2. Transacted.  E. पण् to praise, aff. स्वार्थे-आय-क्त.
पणार्पण: पणार्पण n. (-णं) Agreement, engagement, contract.  E. पण price, अर्पण delivering.
पणस्थि: पणस्थि n. (-स्थि) The small shell used as coin, a Cowri.  E. पण busi-ness, and अस्थि a bone; also with कन् added पणस्थिक.
पणित: पणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Prasied. 	 2. Transacted as business.  E. पण to praise, aff. क्त; also पणायित.
पणितव्य: पणितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 	 1. Vendible, fit or intended for sale. 	 2. To be transacted, negotiable. 	 3. To be praised.  E. पण to deal, aff. तव्य.
पण्ड: पण्ड mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं) 	 1. A catamite. 	 2. An eunuch. 	 f. (-ण्डा) 	 1. Wisdom, understanding. 	 2. Science, learning.  E. पडि to go, aff. अच् or पण् to deal, Unādi aff. ड, तस्य नेत्वम्; also with कन् added पण्डक.
पण्डापूर्व: पण्डापूर्व n. (-र्वं) Non-occurrence of the results of fate or destiny. E. पण्ड, and अपूर्व unprecedented.
पण्डित: पण्डित m. (-तः) 	 1. A scholar, a teacher, a Pandit, a learned Brāhman, or one read in sacred science, and teaching it to his disciples. 2. Incense. 	 3. Clever. 	 4. Proficient.  E. पण्डा learning, तार० इतच् aff.
पण्डितम्मन्य: पण्डितम्मन्य m. (-न्यः) An ignorant and vain person, a pedant, one who thinks himself a Pandit or scholar.  E. पण्डित learned, मन् to think, खश् aff.; also with णिनि aff. पण्डितमानिन्.
पण्डितमानिन्: पण्डितमानिन् m. (-नी) An arrogant and ignorant man: E. see the last.
पण्डितायमान: पण्डितायमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Become wise from a state of ignorance. E. पण्डित used as a verb, शानच् aff.
पण्य: पण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) 	 1. To be sold, salable, vendible. 	 2. To be praised, 3. To be transacted as business. 	 n. (-ण्यं) 	 1. A ware. 	 2. Price. 	 3. Traffic. 	 f. (-ण्या) Heart pea: see पिण्या.  E. पण to deal, कर्मणि-यत् aff.
पण्यफलत्व: पण्यफलत्व n. (-त्वं) Prosperity in trade, profit.  E. पण्य, and फलत्व fruitfulness.
पण्यमूल्य: पण्यमूल्य n. (-ल्यं) The price of a commodity.  E. पण्य, and मूल्य price.
पण्यवीथी: पण्यवीथी f. (-थी) 	 1. A stall, &c. 	 2. A market: see the last.
पण्यवीथिका: पण्यवीथिका f. (-का) 	 1. A stall, a shop, a place of sale. 	 2. A market. E. पण्य vendible, and वीथी a shop, &c. कन् added.
पण्यशाला: पण्यशाला f. (-ला) 	 1. A market. 	 2. A shop, a ware-room.  E. पण्य vendible, and शाला a hall.
पण्यस्त्री: पण्यस्त्री f. (-स्त्री) A whore.  E. पण्य vendible, and स्त्री a woman.
पण्याङ्गना: पण्याङ्गना f. (-ना) A prostitute, a whore.  E. पण्य to be sold, अङ्गना a woman; also पणाङ्गना.
पण्यजीव: पण्यजीव m. (-वः) A trader. 	 n. (-वं) A market, a fair,  E. पण्य a vendible, and आजीव a livelihood.
पण्याजीवक: पण्याजीवक n. (-कं) A market.  E. कन् added to the last; also पण्यजीवकं.
पण्यार्ह: पण्यार्ह mfn. (-र्ह-र्हा-र्हं) Salable, vendible.  E. पण्य, and अर्ह fit for.
पत: पत(ऌ)पतॢ r. 1st. cl. (पतति) r. 10th cl. (पतयति-ते or पातयति-ते) 	 1. To go, to move, but especially downwards, as, to fall, to descend, to alight. 	 2. To possess supreme or superhuman power. r. 4th cl. (पत्यते) To be rich or powerful. With अति prefixed. To excel or surpass. With अभि or अव, To descend. With आङ्, To arrive, to come. With उत्, To ascend. With नि 1. To gain or get. 	 2. To happen. With निर, To abscond. With परि, 1. To go fast. 	 2. To be valuable. With प्र and नि, To fall prostrate, to salute, to worship. With वि and निर, To turn, to turn back. With सम्, 1. To go with. 	 2. To gain. With आङ्, To purify or cleanse. With सम् and उत्, To fly. With सम् and नि, To go forth or out. गतौ अद० चु० उभ० सक० ऐश्ये० अक सेट् । ऐश्ये दि० आ० अक० सेट् । गतौ भ्वा० पर० सक० ऐश्ये अक० ज्वला० सेट् ।
पत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cherished, protected. 	 m. (-तः) 	 1. Going, 2. Fall-ing, alighting. 	 3. Flying, flight.  E. पत् to go, अच् aff. or a various reading of पात.
पतक: पतक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Who or what falls, descends, &c. 	 m. (-कः) An astronomical table.  E. पत् to fall, to go, वुन् aff.
पतग: पतग m. (-गः) A bird.  E. पत् to go, Unādi aff. अगच्.
पतङ्ग: पतङ्ग mf. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी) 	 1. A grasshopper. 	 2. A bird. 	 3. A sort of rice. 	 4. The sun. 	 n. (-ङ्गं) 	 1. Quicksilver. 	 2. A kind of Sandal.  E. पत् falling, गम् to proceed, aff.; खच्; or पत् to fall, अङ्गच् Unādi aff. also पतङ्गम ।
पतङ्गम: पतङ्गम mf. (-मः-मा) 	 1. A bird. 	 2. A grasshopper.  E. पत, and गम what goes; see the last. पतन् उत्प्लवन् सन् गच्छति गम-खच् ।
पतङ्गिका: पतङ्गिका f. (-का) 	 1. A sort of bee. 	 2. A small bird.  E. कन् implying resemblance, with the fem. form added to पतङ्ग ।
पतञ्ज: पतञ्ज(ञ्च)लि m. (-लिः) 	 1. The name of a saint or Muni and teacher of the Yoga philosophy, thence called after him PĀTANJALA; also the author of Mahābhāshya or commentary on PĀNINI. 	 2. A name of the poet VARARUCHI.  E. पत् falling, अञ्जलि the hands joined as a mark of respect; having fallen from heaven, it is said, in the shape of small snake, into the hands of the saint PĀNINI as he was performing this act of reverence.
पतत्: पतत् mfn. (तन्-तन्ती-तत्) Falling, coming down, alighting, &c. 	 m. (-तन्) A bird.  E. पत् to go, to alight, participial aff. शतृ or अति
पतत्र: पतत्र n. (-त्रं) 	 1. A wing. 	 2. A vehicle.  E. पत् to go, अत्रन् करणे । Unādi aff.
पतत्रि: पतत्रि m. (-त्रिः) A bird.  E. पत् to go, अत्रिन् Unādi aff.
पतत्रिन्: पतत्रिन् m. (-त्री) 	 1. A bird. 	 2. An arrow. 	 3. A horse.  E. पतत्र a wing, इनि poss. aff.
पतत्रिराज: पतत्रिराज m. (-जः) VISHṆU'S bird, “Gadura.”  E. पतत्रिन्, and राज king.
पतद्ग्रह: पतद्ग्रह m. (-हः) 	 1. A spitting pot. 	 2. The reserve of an army.  E. पतत् what falls, and ग्रह what takes. (पिक्दानी) ।
पतद्भीरु: पतद्भीरु m. (-रुः) A hawk, a falcon.  E. पतत् a bird, and भीरु fearful.
पतन: पतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Who or what goes, falls, descending. &c. 	 n. (-नं) 	 1. Falling. 	 2. Alighting, descending. 	 3. Falling from dignity, virtue, &c. 	 4. Sin. 	 5. Going. 	 6. Subtraction. 	 7. The latitude of a planet.  E. पत् to fall, युच् or भावे-ल्युट् aff.
पतम: पतम m. (-मः) 	 1. The moon. 	 2. A bird. 	 3. A grasshopper.  E. पत् to go, अमच् Unādi aff.
पतयालु: पतयालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Falling, liable or accustomed to fall.  E. पत् to go, &c. in the causal form, आलुच् aff. तत्पर्युदानेन न णि लोपः ।
पतस: पतस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 	 1. A bird. 	 2. The moon. 	 3. A caterpillar.  E. पत् to go, Unādi aff. असच्.
पताका: पताका f. (-का) 	 1. A flag or banner. 	 2. A flagstaff. 	 3. An emblem carried as an ensign or banner, a symbol, a sign. 	 4. A mark. 	 5. An episode, or episodical incident in a drama. 	 6. Good fortune, auspiciousness.  E. पत् to go, अकन् Unādi aff. पत्यते ज्ञायते योधो अनया पत-णि-आक ।
पताकिन्: पताकिन् m. (-की) 	 1. An ensign, a standard bearer. 	 2. A scheme for casting a nativity. 	 f. (-नी) An army.  E. पताका a flag, and इनि aff.
पतापत: पतापत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Who or what goes, &c. much or frequently. E. पत् to go, अच् aff. repeated, and आच् augment.
पति: पति m. (-तिः) 	 1. A master, an owner. 	 2. A husband. 	 3. A root. 4. Ruler 5. Going, motion.  E. पा to nourish, Unādi aff. डति, or पत् to go, with the same aff.
पतिघ्नी: पतिघ्नी f. (-घ्नी) 	 1. The murderess of her husband. 	 2. A line on the hand, indicating that a woman will be faithless or treacherous to her husband,  E. पति and घ्न who kills, fem. aff. ङीप्.
पतिघ्नीलक्षण: पतिघ्नीलक्षण n. (-णं) Sign of a murderess of a husband.  E. पतिघ्नी, and लक्षण a mark.
पतित: पतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Fallen, alighted. 	 2. Fallen from virtue, wicked, abandoned. 	 3. Fallen in war, defeated, overthrown. 4. Degraded, outcaste. 	 5. Gone.  E. पत् to go, aff. कर्त्तरि क्त.
पतितसावित्रीक: पतितसावित्रीक m. (-कः) A man of the first three classes, whose investi-ture has not been duly performed.  E. पतित, and सावित्री the mys-tical verse, कन् added.
पतितेक्षित: पतितेक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Looked at by an outcaste.  E. पतित, and ईक्षित seen.
पतितोत्पन्न: पतितोत्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Born of an outcaste.  E. पतित, and उत्पन्न born.
पतित्व: पतित्व n. (-त्वं) The conjugal state.  E. पति, and त्व aff.
पतित्वा: पतित्वा ind. Having fallen or fallen down, having alighted, &c.  E. पत् to fall, क्त्वा aff.
पतिप्राणा: पतिप्राणा f. (-णा) A faithful wife.  E. पति, and प्राण life.
पतिंवरा: पतिंवरा f. (-रा) 	 1. A bride choosing her husband. 	 2. A pungent seed, (Nigella Indica.)  E. पति a husband, वृ to choose, खच् aff.
पतिवत्री: पतिवत्री f. (-त्री) A married woman, a wife whose husband is living. E. पति a husband, मतुप् aff. fem. form irr., नुक् being inserted.
पतिव्रता: पतिव्रता f. (-ता) A good and virtuous wife.  E. पति a husband, व्रत a religious obligation; who never violates her marriage vow.
पतिसेवा: पतिसेवा f. (-वा) Devotion to a husband.  E. पति, and सेवा service.
पतीयत्री: पतीयत्री f. (-न्ती) A woman wishing or fit for a husband.  E. पति, and क्यच् added, aff. शतृ.
पतेर: पतेर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Going, moving, one who goes or moves. 	 m. (-रः) 1. A bird 2. An Arhaka, a measure so called. 	 3. A hole.  E. पत् to go, एरक् Unādi aff.
पत्काषिन्: पत्काषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Pedestrian, going on foot. 	 m. (-षी) A footman, a foot soldier, &c.  E. पत् for पाद foot, कष् to injure, णिनि aff. पदादेशः ।
पत्तङ्ग: पत्तङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) Red sanders: see पत्रङ्ग, of which it appears to be a local corruption. (वकम्) ।
पत्तन: पत्तन n. (-नं) 	 1. A town, a city. 	 2. A sort of drum.  E. पत् to go, तनन् aff.
पत्तनवणिज्: पत्तनवणिज् m. (-णिक्) A tradesman.  E. पत्तन a city, वणिज् a trader.
पत्ति: पत्ति m. (-त्तिः) 	 1. A foot soldier. 	 2. A hero. 	 f. (त्ति) 	 1. Going, moving, walking. 	 2. A company, a platoon, consisting of one chariot, one elephant, three horse, and five foot.  E. पद् to go, नि Unādi aff. or तिन् aff. for the feminine.
पत्तिपङ्क्ति: पत्तिपङ्क्ति f. (-ङ्क्ति) A line of infantry.  E. पत्ति, and पङ्क्ति a line.
पत्तिसंहति: पत्तिसंहति f. (-तिः) A body of troops.  E. पत्ति, and संहति assemblage.
पत्तूर: पत्तूर m. (-रः) A plant, commonly Salincha. 	 n. (-रं) Red sanders.
पत्त्र: पत्त्र n. (-त्त्रं) Any vehicle or means of conveyance.  E. पत् to go, ष्ट्रन् aff.; also पत्र.
पत्री: पत्री f. (-त्री) A wife.  E. पति a husband, ङीप् aff. and नुक् augment.
पत्न्याट: पत्न्याट m. (-टः) The Harem, the private or women's apartments. E. पत्री a wife, आट who goes, from अट, with घञ् affix, and आङ् prefix.
पत्र: पत्र(त्त्र) n. (-त्रं) 	 1. A leaf. 	 2. A vehicle in general; as a car, a horse, a camel, &c. 	 3. The wing of a bird. 	 4. The feather of an arrow. 5. The leaf of the Laurus cassia. 	 6. The leaf of a book. 	 7. Gold leaf, &c. any thin sheet or plate of metal. 	 8. A letter. 	 9. The blade of a weapon. 	 10. Painting the person as a decoration. 11. A knife, a dagger. 	 12. The leaf of a flower. 	 nf. (-त्रं-त्री) A letter, any written document or address.  E. पत् to go, ष्ट्रन् aff. and one त rejected; also sometimes पत्त्र ।
पत्रक: पत्रक n. (-कं) 	 1. A leaf. 	 2. The leaf of the Laurus cassia. 	 3. Staining the person with Sandal, &c. by way of decoration.  E. पत्र with स्वार्थे-क added.
पत्रकाहला: पत्रकाहला f. (-ला) The noise made either by the flapping of wings, or by the rustling of leaves.  E. पत्र a leaf, a wing, &c. and काहल noise.
पत्रकृच्छ्र: पत्रकृच्छ्र n. (-च्छ्रं) A sort of penance, drinking infusion of any leaves for a given time.  E. पत्र a leaf, and कृच्छ्र a penance.
पत्रगुप्त: पत्रगुप्त m. (-प्तः) A species of Euphorbia, commonly Teykānta Sij. E. पत्र a leaf, and गुप्त hidden.
पत्रङ्ग: पत्रङ्गं n. (-ङ्गः) Red sanders, (Pterocarpus santalinus.) also पत्राङ्ग.
पत्रङ्गं: पत्रङ्गं n. (-ङ्गः) Red sanders, (Pterocarpus santalinus.) also पत्राङ्ग.
पत्रझङ्कार: पत्रझङ्कार m. (-रः) The current of a river: other authorities have in place of this word, पुरसंस्कार, and पत्रसस्कार, of which the last appears to be most accurate. रायभटीवृक्षे च ।
पत्रणा: पत्रणा f. (-णा) 	 1. Trimming the feathered butt of an arrow. 	 2. Pain-ting figures on the body as a decoration.  E. पत्र the feather of an arrow, णी to get, aff. ड.
पत्रगण्डुला: पत्रगण्डुला f. (-ला) 	 1. A woman. 	 2. A kind of barley.
पत्रतरु: पत्रतरु m. (-रुः) The fœtid Mimosa. दुष्खदिरे ।
पत्रदारक: पत्रदारक m. (-कः) A saw.  E. पत्र a leaf, &c. and दृ to tear, ण्वुल् aff. (करात) ।
पत्रनाडिका: पत्रनाडिका f. (-का) The fibre or vein of a leaf.  E. पत्र a leaf, नाडी a vessel, aff. कन्.
पत्रपरशु: पत्रपरशु m. (-शुः) A small file used by silversmiths, &c.  E. पत्र a sheet of metal, परशु an axe; also with पर्शु the same, पत्रपर्शु m. (-र्शुः) (छेनी) ।
पत्रपाल: पत्रपाल m. (-ल) A large knife. 	 f. (-ली) A pair of shears or scissors. E. पत्र a leaf, पाल् to nourish, aff. अच् (कांचि) ।
पत्रपाश्या: पत्रपाश्या f. (-श्या) An ornament of the forehead, a piece of gold leaf situated on the forehead, or a painted mark upon it.  E. पत्र a leaf, पश् to bind, aff. ण्यत्. (टीका) ।
पत्रपिशाचिका: पत्रपिशाचिका f. (-का) A sort of cap or cover for the head, made of leaves.  E. पत्र a leaf, पिशाचिका an imp. (टोका) ।
पत्रपुष्प: पत्रपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A plant, a red sort of Tulasi or Basil, (Ocymum pilo-sum.) 	 f. (-ष्पा) Holy basil, (Ocymum sanctum.)  E. पत्र a leaf, and पुष्प a flower.
पत्रपुष्पक: पत्रपुष्पक m. (-कः) A kind of birch, from the bark of which Hukka snakes, &c. are made: see भूर्ज्जपत्र  E. पत्र a leaf, and पुष्प a flower, कन् added.
पत्रपूग: पत्रपूग m. (-गः) A shower of arrows.  E. पत्र, and पूग a heap.
पत्रबन्ध: पत्रबन्ध m. (-न्धः) Adorning with leaves, flowers, &c. decorating with nosegays or garlands.  E. पत्र a leaf, and बन्ध a binding.
पत्रबाल: पत्रबाल m. (-लः) An oar, especially a large one used as a rudder.  E. पत्र a leaf, बल् to be strong, aff. घञ्.
पत्रभङ्ग: पत्रभङ्ग mf. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी) Decorating the person by staining it with fragrant pigments of sandal, musk, &c.  E. पत्र a leaf, भञ्ज to break, aff. अच्.
पत्रयौवन: पत्रयौवन n. (-नं) A new leaf, a sprout.  E. पत्र a leaf, यौवन youth.
पत्ररथ: पत्ररथ m. (-थः) A bird.  E. पत्र a wing, and रथ a vehicle.
पत्ररञ्जन: पत्ररञ्जन n. (-नं) Embellishing a page, illuminating, gilding, &c.  E. पत्र, and रञ्जन colouring.
पत्रल: पत्रल n. (-लं) Thin or skim milk.  E. पत् to go, रल् aff. (पात्ला दै) ।
पत्रले: पत्रले(रे)खा f. (खा) Decoratien of the face or person, by means of fragrant pigments, consisting of Sandal, saffron, musk, &c. E. पत्र a leaf, and लेखा a line.
पत्रवल्ली: पत्रवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) Staining the person with Sandal, &c. by way of ornament.  E. पत्र a leaf, and वल्ली a creeper; also पत्रावली, पत्रलेखा, &c.
पत्रवाह: पत्रवाह m. (-हः) 	 1. An arrow. 	 2. A bird. 	 3. A postman, a letter carrier.  E. पत्र a feather or a letter, and वाह bearing.
पत्रशि: पत्रशि(सि)रा f. (-रा) The vein or fibre of a leaf.  E. पत्र a leaf, and शिरा a tubular vessel.
पत्रसंस्कार: पत्रसंस्कार m. (-रः) The current of a river.  E. पत्र a leaf, संस्कार making perfect; see पत्रझङ्कार.
पत्रसूचि: पत्रसूचि m. (-चिः) A thorn.  E. पत्र a leaf, and सूचि a needle.
पत्रहिम: पत्रहिम n. (-मं) Cold, wintry weather.  E. पत्र here said to mean falling, हिम frost or snow.
पत्राख्य: पत्राख्य m. (-ख्यः) The pungent leaf of the Laurus cassia.  E. पत्र a leaf, and आख्या a name; the leaf, by way of distinction.
पत्राङ्ग: पत्राङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) 	 1. Red sanders (Pterocarpus santolinus) 	 2. Red or sappan wood, (Cæsalpinia sappan.) 	 3. Bhūrjapatra, a tree so called, a kind of Birch. 	 4. Another plant: see पद्मक.  E. पत्र a leaf, अङ्ग body or substance.
पत्राङ्गुलि: पत्राङ्गुलि f. (-लिः) Painting the forehead, throat, neck, &c. with coloured Sandal, saffron, or any other fragrant substance. E. पत्र a leaf and आङ्गुलि a finger, being applied with the finger.
पत्राञ्जन: पत्राञ्जन n. (-नं) Ink or blacking.  E. पत्र a leaf, (of a book,) and अञ्ज् to tint, करणे-ल्युट् aff.
पत्राढ्य: पत्राढ्य n. (-ढ्यं) 	 1. The root of a long pepper. 	 2. A kind of grass.
पत्राली: पत्राली f. (-ली) Coloured or ornamental marks on the face or person. E. पत्र, and आलि a row.
पत्रावलि: पत्रावलि f. (लि) 	 1. Red chalk. 	 2. A row of leaves. 	 3. Decorating the person.  E. पत्र, and आवलि a line: see the next.
पत्रावली: पत्रावली f. (-ली) 	 1. Drawing lines along the form; staining some parts of the body with coloured and fragrant pigments, as with saffron, sandal, &c. 	 2. A mixture of young Aswattha leaves with barley and honey.  E. पत्र a leaf, and आवली a line: see पत्रलेखा, पत्रक, &c.
पत्रिका: पत्रिका f. (का) A leaf, a written leaf or page, a writing, a letter, &c. E. पत्र, and कन् added, fem. form.
पत्रिन्: पत्रिन् mfn. (-त्री-त्रिणी-त्रि) 	 1. Winged. 	 2. Feathered. 	 3. Having a page or leaf. 	 m. (-त्री) 	 1. An arrow. 	 2. A bird. 	 3. A falcon. 	 4. A tree. 	 5. A mountain. 	 6. A chariot. 	 7. A rider in a car or car-riage. 	 f. (-णी) A sprout, a shoot.  E. पत्र a leaf, &c. इनि aff.
पत्रोपस्कर: पत्रोपस्कर m. (-रः) A tree, (Cassia esculenta.)  E. पत्र a leaf, उपस्कर a condiment.
पत्रोर्ण: पत्रोर्ण n. (-र्णं) Wove silk. 	 m. (-र्णः) A plant, (Bignonia indica.)  E. पत्र a leaf, ऊर्णा wool.
पत्रोल्लास: पत्रोल्लास m. (-सः) A bud.  E. पत्र, and उल्लास what delights.
पत्सल: पत्सल m. (-लः) A road.  E. पत् to go, सर Unādi aff. र changed to ल.
पथ: पथ r. 1st. cl. (पथति) to go, to move. r. 10th. cl. (पाथयति) To throw, to cast, to despatch or send; (इ) पथि, r. 1st. and 10th. cls. (पन्थति पन्थयति) To go, to proceed, to travel. गतौ भ्वा० पर० सक० सेट् । वा चुरा उभ० पक्षे भ्वा० पर० सक० सेट् इदित् ।
पथ m. (-थः) A road.  E. पथ् to go, aff. अच्.
पथत्: पथत् mfn. (-थन्-थन्ती-थत्) Going, travelling. 	 m. (-थन्) A road.  E. पथ् to go, शतृ aff.
पथिक: पथिक mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं) Knowing or going on a road. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A traveller, a way-farer. 	 2. A guide, one who knows the way. E. पथिन् a road, वुन् or कन् aff.
पथिकसन्तति: पथिकसन्तति f. (-ति) A line or range of travellers, a cafileh, a caravan. E. पथिक a traveller, सन्तति a range; also with संहति assemblage, पथिकसंहति.
पथिद्रुम: पथिद्रुम m. (-मः) A sort of Khayar, (Mimosa alba.)  E. पथिन् a road, and द्रुम a tree.
पथिन्: पथिन् m. (पन्था) 	 1. A road, a way. 	 2. Sect, doctrine, path in morals or religion. 	 3. A division of hell. 	 4. A journey. 	 5. Course of manner or action.  E. पथ् to go, इन् Unādi aff.; the noun is irregu-larly inflected.
पथिप्रज्ञ: पथिप्रज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Acquainted with roads.  E. पथिन्, and प्रज्ञ who knows.
पथिल: पथिल m. (-लः) A traveller, a way-farer.  E. पथिन् a road, इलच् Unādi aff.
पथिवाहक: पथिवाहक m. (-कः) 	 1. A fowler, a bird-catcher. 	 2. A porter, a burthen-carrier. Adj. Cruel.  E. पथिन् a road, and वाहक who bears.
पथ्य: पथ्य mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं) Proper, fit, suitable, agreeing with, but applied chiefly medically, with respect to diet, regimen, &c. 	 mf. (-थ्यः-थ्या) Yellow Myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) 	 n. (-थ्यं) Sea salt. E. पथ् to go, यत् aff.
पथ्यापथ्य: पथ्यापथ्य n. (-थ्यं) The class of things that are considered beneficial or hurtful in disease.  E. पथ्य, and अपथ्य improper.
पथ्याशिन्: पथ्याशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Eating wholesome things.  E. पथ्य, and अशिन् who eats.
पद: पद r. 4th. cl. (औ) पदौ (पद्यते) r. 10th. cl. (पदयते) to go, to move. (ए) पदे r. 1st. cl. (पदति) to stand fast. With अभि, prefixed, 1. To know, to understand. 	 2. To see, to look. With अनु, To follow. With आङ्, 1. To happen, to befall. 	 2. To gain. 	 3. To suffer misfortune. 4. To multiply. 	 5. To produce. 	 6. To come. With उत्, To be born or produced. With उप, 1. To gain. 	 2. To be born. 	 3. To be near or connected with. With उप, and सम्, To offer oblations. With प्र, 1. To gain, to acquire. 	 2. To commence. With प्र; and वि, To establish, to enact. With प्रति, 1. To gain. 	 2. To assent, to agree or promise. 	 3. To restore. With वि, To suffer misfortune or pain. With वि, and आङ्, To injure or kill. With वि and उत्, To discri-minate, to analyze. With सम्, 1. To thrive, to grow or increase. 2. To do, to execute, to perform. 	 3. To select. With सम्, and आङ्, 1. To arrive. 	 2. To finish. स्थैर्ये भ्वा० पर० सक० सेट् । गतौ दि० आ० सक० अनिट् पक्षे अद० चु० आत्म० सक० सेट् ।

पद n. (-दं) 	 1. A foot. 	 2. A footstep, the mark of a foot. 	 3. A word. 4. An inflected word. 	 5. A crude word. 	 6. A connected sentence. 7. Subject, thing, matter. 	 8. Preservation, defence 9. Industry, application. 	 10. Disguise. 	 11. Place, site 12. Rank, station, degree. 	 13. A mark, a spot. 	 14. A foot or rather line of a stanza. 15. A mode of writing the Vedas, in which the several words are detached from one another. 	 16. A business, an affair. 	 17. (In Arithmetic,) Any one of a set of numbers the sum of which is required, or the last of the series, a square-root. 	 18. To occupy. 19. Step, pace, 20. A trace, a mark. 	 m. (-दः) A ray of light.  E. पद् to go, aff. अच् or घञ्.
पद्: पद् n. (-द् or -त्) A foot.  E. पद् to go, aff. क्विप्; also पद; or it is considered as an irregular substitute for पाद.
पदक: पदक m. (-कः) 	 1. A Brāhman knowing the verses of the Vedas. 	 2. A Nishka, a weight of gold. 	 3. An ornament of the neck. 	 n. (-कं) 1. Step. 	 2. Position. 	 3. Office.  E. पद a verse, &c. and कन् aff.
पदकार: पदकार m. (-रः) One who divides or separates compound term. E. पद, and कार who makes.
पदक्रम: पदक्रम m. (-मः) 	 1. Step, pace. 	 2. Walking.  E. पद, and क्रम going.
पदग: पदग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Going with the feet. 	 m. (-गः) A footman, a foot soldier, &c.  E. पद् or पद a foot, and ग who goes; hence also पद्न.
पदगत: पदगत mfn. (-ता-ता-तं) 	 1. Gone on foot 2. Described or recorded in a line or stanza.  E. पद, and गत gone.
पदन: पदन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Who or what goes or move.  E. पद् to go, युच् aff.
पदन्यास: पदन्यास m. (-सः) 	 1. Step, pace. 	 2. Conduct, procedure. 	 3. Position of the feet in a particular attitude. 	 4. A plant; also गोक्षुर.  E. पद, and न्यास gesticulation.
पदपात: पदपात m. (-तः) Step, pace, foot-fall, tread.  E. पद, and पात fall.
पदभञ्जन: पदभञ्जन n. (-नं) 	 1. Explanation of obscure or obsolete words. 	 2. Ety-mology. 	 3. Separating the words of a line or sentence.  E. पद a word, भञ्जन a breaking.
पदभञ्जिका: पदभञ्जिका f. (-का) A register, a journal, a calendar or almanack. E. पद a mark, &c. भञ्ज् to divide, aff. ण्वुल्.
पदवि: पदवि f. (-विः-वी) 	 1. A road, a path, a way. 	 2. Station, situation, degree, rank. 	 3. Place, site.  E. पद् to go, अवि aff.; fem. aff. optionally ङीप्.
पदविक्षेप: पदविक्षेप m. (-पः) 	 1. Step, pace, walking. 	 2. A horse's paces.  E. पद, and विक्षेप throwing.
पदविष्टम्भ: पदविष्टम्भ m. (-म्भः) Tread, step, stamp with the foot.  E. पद, and विष्टम्भ fixing.
पदष्टीव: पदष्टीव n. (-वं) The feet and knees.  E. पद् a foot, and अष्ठीवत् the knee, deriv. irr.
पदसङ्घात: पदसङ्घात m. (-तः) A writer, an annotator, one who collects or classes words.  E. पद, and सम् before, हन् to hurt, अण् aff.; also पदसङ्घाट.
पदाङ्क: पदाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) Foot-mark, vestige.  E. पद, and अङ्क a mark.
पदाजि: पदाजि m. (-जिः) A foot soldier.  E. पद a foot, अज् to go, इन् Unādi aff.
पदात: पदात m. (-तः) A footman, a pedestrian.  E. पद foot, अत् to go, aff. क्विप्.
पदाति: पदाति m. (-तिः) A footman or foot soldier.  E. पद foot, अत् to go, इन् Unādi aff.
पदातिक: पदातिक m. (-कः) A peon, a footman or foot soldier.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
पदानुराग: पदानुराग m. (-गः) 	 1. A servant. 	 2. An army  E. पद, and अनुराग attachment.
पदाम्भोज: पदाम्भोज n. (-जं) 	 1. The foot of a mistress, or a divinity; &c. 	 2. A lotus-like foot.  E. पद, and अम्भोज a lotus; also similar compounds, पदारविन्द, &c.
पदार: पदार m. (-रः) 	 1. The dust of the feet. 	 2. A boat.  E. पद a foot, ऋ to go, घञ् aff.
पदारविन्द: पदारविन्द n. (-न्दं) The foot of a mistress, of a divinity, &c.  E. पद, and अरविन्द a lotus.
पदार्थ: पदार्थ m. (-र्थः) 	 1. Thing, substantial or material form of being. 	 2. A category of predicament in Logic, of which seven are enumerated; viz:--substance, quality, action, identity, variety, relation and non-existence or annihilation. They are sixteen according to Nyaya Philosophy six according to the Vaiseshika, twenty-five according to Sānkhya, twenty six according to Pātanjala, and two according to Vaidantica. 	 3. The meaning of a word or sentence. 	 4. A head, a topic.  E. पद word, thing, and अर्थ meaning.
पदासन: पदासन n. (-नं) A foot-stool.  E. पद a foot, आसन a place of sitting.
पदिक: पदिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Going on foot. 	 m. (-कः) A foot soldier. 	 n. (-कं) The point of the foot.  E. पद a foot. aff. ष्ठन्.
पदेपदे: पदेपदे ind. Continually.  E. पद a foot-step, seventh case repeated.
पद्ग: पद्ग m. (-द्गः) A foot-soldier.  E. पद् a foot, and ग who goes.
पद्धति: पद्धति f. (-तिः-ती) 	 1. A road. 	 2. A line, a row or range. 	 3. A ritual, a manual, a work upon any act or ceremony, detailing the mode of its performance, and collecting the texts connected with it. 	 4. A family name, a surname or title.  E. पद् a foot, हन् to strike, aff. क्तिन् ।
पद्धिम: पद्धिम n. (-मं) Coldness of the feet,  E. पद् for पाद, and हिम frost or cold.
पद्म: पद्म mn. (-द्मः-द्मं) 	 1. A lotus, (Nelumbium speciosum;) it is often con-founded with the water lily, (Nymphæa.) 	 2. A form of arraying army resembling to that of a lotus. 	 3. One of KUVERA'S trea-sures or gems. 	 4. A large number, ten billions. 	 5. Coloured marks on the face and trunk of an elephant. 	 6. A drug, also termed Pad-makāshṭha. 	 7. Lead. 	 8. A name given to the six Chakras of the body, or to the mystical faculties present in them. 	 9. The root of a lotus. 	 m. (-द्मः) 	 1. A Nāga or serpent of the lower regions. 	 2. One of the twelve Chakravartis or paramount princes of the Jai-nas. 	 3. One of the persons termed Sukla Balas by the Jains. 	 4. A name of RĀMA. 	 5. The personified treasures of KUVERA, as wor-shipped by the Tāntrikas. 	 6. A particular mode of sexual enjoy-ment. The posture is thus described on Vāchaspatya:--हस्ताभ्याञ्च समालिङ्ग्य नारीपद्मासनोपरि । रमेद्गाढं समाकृष्य बन्धोऽयं पद्मसंज्ञकः ॥ f. (-द्मा) 	 1. A name of LAKSHMĪ. 	 2. A plant, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) 3. A shrub, (Siphonanthus Indica.) 	 4. A female serpent or Nāga, the goddess MANASĀ, and wife to the sage JARATKĀRU. 	 5. The mother of the twentieth Jina or Jaina saint. 	 6. The flower of the Carthamus or safflower.  E. पद् to go, (on the water, &c.) Unadi aff. मन्.
पद्मक: पद्मक n. (-कं) 	 1. Coloured marks or spots on the face and trunk of an elephant. 	 2. A sort of drug, commonly called पद्मकाष्ठ, 3. A kind of leprosy. 	 4. An army arrayed in the form of a lotus-flower. E. कन् added to the preceding.
पद्मकर: पद्मकर m. (-रः) 	 1. The sun. 	 2. An epithet of Vishṇu.  E. पद्म, and कर hand, his image always holding a lotus in one hand.
पद्मकाष्ठ: पद्मकाष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A fragrant wood used in medicine, and described as cooling and tonic.  E. पद्म a lotus, and काष्ठ wood.
पद्मकिन्: पद्मकिन् m. (-की) 	 1. The Bhūrjapatra or birch tree, the bark is used for writing mantras upon, &c. 	 2. An elephant.  E. पद्मक, and इनि aff.
पद्मकेशर: पद्मकेशर mn. (-रः-रं) The filament of a lotus.  E. पद्म, and केशर the same.
पद्मखण्ड: पद्मखण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A quantity of lotuses, or spot abounding with them. E. पद्म a lotus, and खण्ड a portion or district.
पद्मगन्ध: पद्मगन्ध(न्धि) mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Lotus-smelling; smelling like a lotus. E. पद्म, and गन्ध smell; also with इ substituted for the final, पद्मगन्धि.
पद्मगर्भ: पद्मगर्भ m. (-र्भः) 	 1. A name of BRAMHĀ. 	 2. The sun. 	 3. An epithet of Vishṇu.  E. पद्म a lotus, and गर्भ womb, born from the lotus.
पद्मचारिणी: पद्मचारिणी f. (-णी) A small tree, (Hibiscus mutabilis.)  E. पद्म a lotus, चर् to resemble, aff. णिनि, fem. aff. ङीष्.
पद्मतन्तु: पद्मतन्तु m. (-न्तुः) The fibrous stalk of the lotus.  E. पद्म, and तन्तु thread.
पद्मदर्शन: पद्मदर्शन m. (-नः) The resin of the Pinus longifolia.
पद्मनाभ: पद्मनाभ m. (-भः) 	 1. A name of VISHṆU. 	 2. One of the Jinas of a fur-ture age.  E. पद्म a lotus, and नाभि a navel, अच् aff.
पद्मनाभि: पद्मनाभि m. (-भिः) VISHṆU is thus termed, because the lotus, contain-ing BRAMHĀ, sent to create the world, sprang from his navel.
पद्मनाल: पद्मनाल n. (-लं) The stalk of a lotus.  E. पद्म lotus, and नाल a hollow stalk.
पद्मपत्र: पद्मपत्र n. (-त्रं) A sort of Costus, (C. specious.)  E. पद्म a lotus, and पत्र a leaf; also पद्मपर्ण n. (-र्णं) from पर्ण a leaf.
पद्मपाणि: पद्मपाणि m. (णिः) 	 1. A name of BRAMHĀ. 	 2. The sun. 	 3. A Buddha, a Bauddha sanctified teacher. 	 4. An epithet of Vishṇu.  E. पद्म a lotus, and पाणि the hand holding a lotus in one hand.
पद्मपुष्प: पद्मपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) 	 1. A shrub, (Webera corymbosa:) see कर्णिकार. 	 2. A sort of bird.  E. पद्म a lotus, and पुष्प a flower.
पद्मप्रभ: पद्मप्रभ m. (-भः) The sixth Jina or Jaina pontiff.  E. पद्म a lotus, and प्रभ who shines. कमलसदृशप्रभान्वितेच ।
पद्मप्रिया: पद्मप्रिया f. (-या) The wife of the Muni JARATKĀRU.  E. पद्म a lotus, and प्रिया fond of.
पद्मबन्ध: पद्मबन्ध m. (-न्धः) The artificial arrangement of the words of a verse in a figure representing the leaves of a lotus; It is fully illustrated in Saraswatī Kanthābharana.  E. पद्म, and बन्ध binding.
पद्मबन्धु: पद्मबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) 	 1. A bee. 	 2. The sun.  E. पद्म a lotus, and बन्धु the friend. अर्कवृक्षे च ।
पद्मभू: पद्मभू m. (-भूः) BRAMHĀ.  E. पद्म a lotus, and भू born, क्विप् aff.
पद्ममुखी: पद्ममुखी f. (-खी) A sort of prickly nightshade.
पद्मयोनि: पद्मयोनि m. (-निः) BRAMHĀ.  E. पद्म, and योनि place of production.
पद्मराग: पद्मराग m. (-गः) A ruby.  E. पद्म a lotus, and राग colour.
पद्मरेखा: पद्मरेखा f. (-खा) A lotus-figure on the palm of the hand, indicating the possession of great wealth.  E. पद्म a large number, and रेखा a line.
पद्मलाञ्छन: पद्मलाञ्छन m. (-नः) 	 1. A king, a sovereign. 	 2. A name of BRAMHĀ. 	 3. The sun. 	 4. KUVERA, the god of wealth. 	 f. (-ना) 	 1. A name of LAKSHMĪ, 2. A name of SARASWATĪ. 	 3. A title of TĀRĀ, one of the forms of DURGĀ.  E. पद्म a lotus, a Chhātā or parasol-shaped, like one, a fabulous gem, &c. and लाञ्छन a mark or designation.
पद्मवर्णक: पद्मवर्णक n. (-कं) A species of Costus, (C. speciosus.)  E. पद्म a lotus, वर्ण a colour, कप् aff.
पद्मवासा: पद्मवासा f. (-सा) 	 1. A name of LAKSHMĪ. 	 2. Having the fragrance of a lotus-flower.  E. पद्म a lotus, and वासा abode; abiding at the crea-tion within the petals of the lotus. or पद्मं वासो अस्याः ।
पद्मवी: पद्मवी(बी)ज n. (-जं) The seed of the lotus.  E. पद्म a lotus, and वीज a seed.
पद्मस्नुषा: पद्मस्नुषा f. (-षा) 	 1. GANGĀ. 	 2. LAKSHMĪ. 	 3. GAURĪ or DURGĀ.  E. पद्म a lotus, and स्नुषा a daughter-in-law.
पद्माकर: पद्माकर m. (-रः) A large deep tank or pond; one in which the lotus does or may grow.  E. पद्म, and आकर a mine.
पद्माक्ष: पद्माक्ष m. (-क्षः) 	 1. The seed of the lotus. 	 2. Lotus-eyed.  E. पद्म a lotus, and अक्ष an eye.
पद्माट: पद्माट m. (-टः) A sort of Cassia, (C. tora.)  E. पड्म a lotus, and अट् to resemble, aff. अच्. चक्रमर्दवृक्षे, (दादमर्दनैति भाषा) ।
पद्मान्तर: पद्मान्तर m. (-रः) Petal of the lotus.  E. पद्म, and अन्तर inside.
पद्मालया: पद्मालया f. (-या) A name of the goddess LAKSHMĪ.  E. पद्म a lotus, and आलय an asylum. लवङ्गे च ।
पद्मावती: पद्मावती f. (-ती) 	 1. A name of the goddess manasā or the wife of the JARATKĀRU. 	 2. The name of a river, the main stream of the Ganges, between the KĀSIMBĀZĀR river and the sea.  E. पद्म a lotus, मतुप aff., fem. aff. ङीप्, and the antepen. made long.
पद्मावतीप्रिय: पद्मावतीप्रिय m. (-यः) 	 1. The Muni JARATKĀRU. 	 2. The Kalki avatāra. E. पद्मावती as above, and प्रिय beloved. शृगाल नृपेच ।
पद्मासन: पद्मासन n. (-नं) A posture in religious meditation, sitting with the thighs crossed, one hand resting on the left thigh, the other held up with the thumb upon the heart; the eyes directed to the tip of the nose. 	 2. A seat or throne made in the shape of a lotus, one especially on which idols are placed. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. A name of BRAMHĀ. 	 2. The sun.  E. पद्म a lotus, and आसन sitting.
पद्मिन्: पद्मिन् m. (द्मी-) An elephant. 	 f. (-नी) 	 1. A multitude of lotuses, or place abounding in them. 	 2. A woman of one of the four classes into which the sex is distinguished; the first and the most excellent. She is thus described in Vāchaspatya:--भवति कमलनेत्रा नासिकाक्षुद्ररन्ध्रा । अविरलकुचयुग्मा दीर्घकेशी कृशाङ्गी ॥ मृदुचरणसुशीला गीतनृत्यानुरक्ता । सकलतनुसुवेशा पद्मिनी पद्मगन्धा ॥ 3. A lotus, (Nelumbium speciosum.) 	 4. A pool or pond, espe-cially one deep enough for the growth of the lotus. 	 5. The fibrous stalk of a lotus. 	 6. A female elephant.  E. पद्म coloured marks. &c. or a lotus, इनि aff.
पद्मिनीकान्त: पद्मिनीकान्त m. (-न्तः) The sun.  E. पद्मिनी a lotus, and कान्त beloved. अर्कवृक्षे च ।
पद्मिनीखण्ड: पद्मिनीखण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A place abounding with lotuses, or a district in which they grow.  E. पद्मिनी, and खण्ड division.
पद्मिनीबल्लभ: पद्मिनीबल्लभ m. (-भः) The sun.  E. पद्मिनी a lotus, and बल्लभ a friend.
पद्मेशय: पद्मेशय m. (-यः) A name of VISHṆU.  E. पद्म in or on a lotus, and शय who sleeps.
पद्मोत्तर: पद्मोत्तर m. (-रः) 	 1. Safflower. 	 2. A proper name: see the next. E. पद्म, and उत्तर better.
पद्मोत्तरात्मज: पद्मोत्तरात्मज m. (जः) One of the Jaina Chakravartis or emperors. E. पद्मोत्तर, and आत्मज son.
पद्मोद्भव: पद्मोद्भव m. (-वः) 	 1. A name of BRAMHĀ. 	 f. (-वा) The snake goddess MANASĀ.  E. पद्म a lotus, and उद्भव born.
पद्य: पद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Hurting or coming in contact with the feet. 	 n. (-द्यं) 	 1. Metre, verse, a stanza. 	 2. Wickedness, infamy. 	 m. (-द्यः) 	 1. A Sūdra. 	 2. A part of a word. 	 f. (-द्या) 	 1. A road. 	 2. Praise, eulogium.  E. पद् to go, यत् aff.
पद्र: पद्र m. (-द्रः) 	 1. A village. 	 2. The entrance into a village.  E. पद् to go, रक् Unādi aff.
पद्व: पद्व m. (-द्वः) 	 1. The abode or world of human beings. 	 2. A car. 	 3. A road.  E. पद् to go, वन् Unādi aff.
पद्वन्: पद्वन् m. (-द्वा) A road.  E. पद् to go, वनिप् Unādi aff.
पन: पन r. 1st. cl. (पनायति) To praise: this root and पण in the same sense, take आय before the Sārvadhātuka, and some of the Ārddhadhātuka, affixes. (पनते) To traffic, to buy and sell: see पण. स्तुतौ भ्वा० आत्म० सक० सेट् । स्वार्थे आय वा तत्र आत्म० ।
पनस: पनस m. ((सः) 	 1. The bread-fruit or JACK tree, (Artocarpus integri-folia.) 	 2. A thorn. 	 3. The name of a monkey. 	 f. (-सा) 	 1. A malady, pustular and phlegmonoid inflammation of the skin or external organs. 	 2. A she monkey. 	 3. A female demon.  E. पन् to praise or be praised, Unadi aff. असच्.
पनसना: पनसना(ता)लिका f. (-का) The bread-fruit or JACK.  E. पनस, ठन् aff.
पन्थक: पन्थक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Produced in or on the road.  E. पथिन्, and वुन् aff.
पन्न: पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 	 1. Fallen, gone down or downwards. 	 2. Gone. 	 m. (-न्नः) Downward motion, falling, descending.  E. पद् to go, aff. क्त, deriv. irr., otherwise पद् to go, Unādi aff. नन् ।
पन्नग: पन्नग m. (-गः) 	 1. A snake. 	 2. A drug: see पद्मकाष्ठ. 	 f. (-गी) The snake goddess MANASĀ. 	 n. (-गं) Lead.  E. पन्न a fallen, ग who goes, or पद् a foot, न not, ग who goes,; moving without feet.
पन्नगाशन: पन्नगाशन m. (-नः) A name of GADURA, the bird and vehicle of VISHṆU. E. पन्नग a snake, and अशन food; the snake-eater.
पन्नद्धा: पन्नद्धा f. (-द्धा) A leather shoe or boot.  E. पद् a foot, नह to bind, aff. क्त, deriv. irr.
पनद्ध्री: पनद्ध्री f. (-द्ध्री) A shoe, a boot.  E. पद् a foot, नह् to bind, affs. ष्ट्रन्, or ङीष् optionally added.
पपि: पपि mfn. (-पिः-पिः-पि) Who or what drinks. 	 m. (-पिः) The moon.  E. पा to drink, कि aff. and the root repeated.
पपिस्: पपिस् m. (-पीः) 	 1. The moon. 	 2. The sun.  E. पा to drink, reiterated by special rule, Unādi aff. इस्.
पपीति: पपीति f. (-तिः) Mutual or reciprocal drinking, drinking alike or to-gether.  E. पा to drink, in the reiterative form, aff. क्तिन्.
पपु: पपु m. (-युः) A fosterer, a protector. 	 f. (-पुः) A nurse, a fostermother. E. पा to cherish, कु aff. and the radical consonant repeated.
पम्पा: पम्पा f. (-म्पा) 	 1. The name of a river, in the south of India. 	 2. Name of a lake in the Dandaka forest.  E. पा to drink, प Unādi aff., मन् inserted, and the radical vowel made short.
पय: पय r. 	 1. st. cl. (पयते) To go, to move. भ्वा० आत्म० सक० सेट् ।
पयश्चय: पयश्चय m. (-यः) A piece of water.  E. पयस् water, चय collection.
पयस्: पयस् n. (-यः) 	 1. Water. 	 2. Milk. 	 3. Semen virile. 	 4. Boiled-rice. 	 5. Night.  E. पय् to go, असुन् Unādi aff.
पयस: पयस n. (-सं) 	 1. Water. 	 2. Milk.  E. पयस् the same, अच् added.
पयस्प: पयस्प m. (-स्पः) A cat.  E. पयस् milk, and प who drinks.
पयस्य: पयस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) 	 1. Made from milk, (curds, butter, cheese, &c.) 2. Relating to or connected with milk or water. 	 3. A cat. 	 f. (-स्या) 1. A shrub, (Asclepias rosea.) 	 2. A medicinal kind of moon plant. 3. A drug: see क्षीरकाकोली. 	 4. Curds of two milk whey. 	 5. Any plant yielding a milky sap, as the Euphorbia, the Asclepias, &c. E. पयस् milk, यत् aff.
पयस्वल: पयस्वल m. (-लः) A goat.  E. पयस्, वलच् aff.
पयस्विनी: पयस्विनी f. (-नी) 	 1. A river. 	 2. A milch cow. 	 3. Night. 	 4. A she-goat. E. पयस् water or milk, विनि aff.
पयोगड: पयोगड(ल) m. (-डः or -लः) Hail. 	 n. (-डं) An island.  E. पयस् water, गड a drop.
