पयोघन: पयोघन m. (-नः) Hail.  E. पयस् water. घन a lump.
पयोजन्मन्: पयोजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) A cloud.  E. पयस् water, जन्मन् origin.
पयोद: पयोद m. (-दः) A cloud.  E. पयस्, and द what gives.
पयोधर: पयोधर m. (-रः) A woman's breast. 	 2. A cloud. 	 3. The sugarcane. 	 4. The cocoanut. 	 5. A sort of rush, (Scirpus kysoor.) 	 6. A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus, &c.) 	 7. An udder. 	 8. The back-bone. 	 9. (In Prosody) A scolius.  E. पयस् milk or water, and धर containing.
पयोधस्: पयोधस् m. (-धाः) 	 1. The ocean. 	 2. A piece of water. 	 3. A cloud E. पयस् water, धा to contain, Unādi aff. असि.
पयोधि: पयोधि m. (-धिः) The ocean.  E. पयस्, and धा to have, कि aff.
पयोधिक: पयोधिक n. (-कं) The cuttle-fish-bone.  E. पयोधि, and कन् aff. समुद्रफेने ।
पयोनिधि: पयोनिधि m. (-धिः) The ocean.  E. पयस्, and निधि a treasure.
पयोमुच्: पयोमुच् m. (-मुक्) A cloud.  E. पयस्, and मुच् what lets go.
पयोर: पयोर m. (-रः) The Khayar, (Mimosa catechu.)  E. पयस् water, रा to get, aff. क.
पयोराशि: पयोराशि f. (-शिः) A piece of water.  E. पयस्, and राशि a quantity.
पयोव्रत: पयोव्रत n. (-तं) Living upon milk for a month, which with prayer and residence in a cow house, is an expiation or receiving an unsuitable present; offering of milk to VISHṆU, and subsisting upon it for twelve days; also for one or for three days is consi-dered as a religious act.  E. पयस् milk, and व्रत religious observance.
पयोष्णी: पयोष्णी f. (-ष्णी) A river that rises in the Vindhya mountain. The Narmadā according to some, the Tapti according to others.
पर: पर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Distant, removed, remote. 	 2. Best, pre-eminent. 3. Subsequent, after, following. 	 4. Other, different. 	 5. Inimical, hostile, estranged, adverse. 	 6. Addicted to, attached to, engaged in. 	 7. More, exceeding, as परं शतं more than a hundred, परो लक्षः more then a Lac: these are also considered as distinct com-pounds, see the next. 	 8. Higher, Superior. 	 9. Beyond. 	 10. Last, final. 	 m. (रः) 	 1. An enemy 2. The life of BRAMHĀ. 	 n. ind. (-रं) 	 1. Only, alone. 	 2. After, afterwards. subst. 	 1. Final beatitude. 2. The Supreme spirit. 	 3. (In Logic,) One species of common property; that which comprehends many objects, genus; or it is the same with existence, as the common property of all things. E. पॄ to fill, &c. aff. भावे अप् or कर्त्तरि अच् ।
परःशत: परःशत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) More than a hundred, many.  E. पर more, and शत a hundred: see the last.
परःश्वस्: परःश्वस् ind. (-श्वः) The day after to-morrow.  E. पर after, श्वस् tomorrow.
परःसहस्र: परःसहस्र mfn. (-स्रः-स्रा-स्रं) More than a thousand.  E. पर more, and सहस्र a thousand: see पर.
परकलत्र: परकलत्र n. (-त्रं) Another's wife.  E. पर, and कलत्र a wife.
परकलत्राभिगमन: परकलत्राभिगमन n. (-नं) Intriguing with another man's wife, adultery. E. परकलत्र another's wife, अभिगमन approaching.
परकीय: परकीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Another, belonging to another. 	 f. (-या) The mistress or wife of another, one of the three objects of love, according to the Sringāra or amatory, doctrine.  E. पर another, छ aff. कुक् augment.
परक्षेत्र: परक्षेत्र n. (-त्रं) 	 1. Another man's wife. 	 2. Another's body. 	 3. Another's field.  E. पर another, क्षेत्र a field.
परग्रन्थि: परग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) An articulation, a finger-joint.  E. पर after, ग्रन्थि a joining.
परग्लानि: परग्लानि f. (-निः) Reduction or subjugation of an enemy.  E. पर, and ग्लानि vexing.
परच्छन्द: परछन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) Dependant, subservient, subjected.  E. पर another, छन्द inclination.
परछन्द: परछन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) Dependant, subservient, subjected.  E. पर another, छन्द inclination.
परच्छिद्र: परछिद्र n. (-द्रं) A fault or defect in another.  E. पर and छिद्र flaw.
परछिद्र: परछिद्र n. (-द्रं) A fault or defect in another.  E. पर and छिद्र flaw.
परजात: परजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Adopted, fostered, nourished by a stranger. 2. Dependant, servile, subjected. 	 m. (-तः) 	 1. The kokila. 	 2. A ser-vant.  E. पर another, and जात born.
परजित: परजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Nourished by a stranger. 	 2. Conquered, or subdued by another. 	 3. The kokila. पर another, and जित con-quered, &c.
परञ्ज: परञ्ज m. (-ञ्जः) 	 1. An oil press. 	 2. Froth, foam. 	 3. The blade of a sword or a knife. 	 4. A sword or scimitar. 	 f. (-ञ्जा) The sound of instruments at a festival. 	 n. (-ञ्जं) The sword of INDRA.  E. पर in the second case, another, and जि to conquer, aff. ड; some works have परज, and others पराञ्ज in place of this word.
परञ्जन: परञ्जन m. (-नः) A name of VARUNA, the regent of water.  E. पर an-other, जि to conquer, deriv. irr; also परञ्जय.
परञ्जय: परञ्जय m. (-यः) VARUNA: see the last.
परतन्त्र: परतन्त्र mfn. (-न्त्रः-न्त्रा-न्त्रं) Subservient, obedient, dependant.  E. पर another, तन्त्र will.
परतम: परतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Greatest.  E. पर, and तरप् aff. of the superlative.
परतर: परतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Greater, more.  E. पर more, and तरप aff.
परतस्: परतस् ind. 	 1. Afterwards. 	 2. Behind. 	 3. Otherwise, differently. 	 4. From an enemy.  E. पर or परा, and अतमुच् aff. According to Vāchaspatya:--1. From another. 	 2. Dependence.  E. पर + विभक्तर्थे-तसिल् ।
परत्र: परत्र ind. 	 1. The next world, futurity. 	 2. Further on, in the sequel. E. पर another, त्रल् aff.
परत्रभीरु: परत्रभीरु m. (-रूः) A pious man, one standing in awe of futurity. E. परत्र the next world, and भीरु timid.
परत्व: परत्व n. (-त्वं) 	 1. Difference, distinction, separateness. 	 2. Hostility. 	 3. (In Logic,) Priority of place or time, proximity, juvenility. 	 4. The nature of common or generic property.  E. त्व added to पर; also with तल्, परता.
परदार: परदार m. (-रः) Plu. Another's wife.  E. पर, and दार a wife.
परदारगमन: परदारगमन n. (नं) Adultery, adulterous intercourse or intrigue.  E. पर-दार, and गमन frequenting.
परदाराभिमर्ष: परदाराभिमर्ष m. (-र्षः) Intriguing with another man's wife.  E. परदार, and अभिमर्ष contact.
परदारोपसेवन: परदारोपसेवन n. (-नं) Intriguing with another's wife.  E. परदार, and उप-सेवन frequenting; also परदारोपसेवा ।
परदुःख: परदुःख n. (-खं) The pain or sorrow of another.  E. पर, and दुख pain.
परदेश: परदेश m. (-शः) A foreign country.  E. पर, and द्रेश place.
परदेशिन्: परदेशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Foreign, exotic. 	 m. (-शी) 	 1. A foreigner. 	 2. One residing abroad.  E. परदेश, and इनि aff.
परदेशसेविन्: परदेशसेविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Living abroad, travelling, traveller.  E. पर देश, and सेविन् who frequents.
परदोषकीर्त्तन: परदोषकीर्त्तन n. (-नं) Scandal, calumny, censoriousness.  E. पर, दोष fault, कीर्त्तन proclaiming.
परद्वेषिन्: परद्वेषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Hostile, inimical, adverse.  E. पर another, द्विष् to hate, घिणुन् aff.
परद्रव्य: परद्रव्य n. (-व्यं) Another's property.  E. पर, and द्रव्य thing.
परद्रोहिन्: परद्रोहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Tyrannising over another.  E. पर, and द्रोहिन् injurious.
परधन: परधन n. (-नं) Another's wealth.  E. पर, and धन wealth.
परधनास्वादनसुख: परधनास्वादनसुख n. (-खं) Feeding luxuriously at another's expense. E. परधन, आस्वादन eating, सुख pleasure.
परधर्म: परधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Another's duty or business, the occupation of another caste.  E. पर, and धर्म्म duty. उत्कृष्ट धर्मेच ।
परधर्म्म: परधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Another's duty or business, the occupation of another caste.  E. पर, and धर्म्म duty. उत्कृष्ट धर्मेच ।
परध्यान: परध्यान n. (-नं) Intent absorption or abstraction in the subject of medi-tation.  E. पर, and ध्यान meditating.
परन्तप: परन्तप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Vexing or annoying another, subduing a foe. 	 m. (-पः) A conqueror.  E. पर another, तप to heat or inflame, aff. खच् ।
परपद: परपद n. (-दं) 	 1. Eminence, high station. 	 2. Final felicity.  E. पर supreme, पद, a place.
परपरिग्रह: परपरिग्रह m. (-हः) The family or dependants of another.  E. पर, and परिग्रह dependants.
परपाक: परपाक m. (-कः) What is dressed or cooked by another, another's food. E. पर, and पाक cooking.
परपाकनिवृत्त: परपाकनिवृत्त m. (-त्तः) One who dresses his own food without observing the expiatory sacrifice for the five Sūnas, or places of destruction to animal life: see पञ्चसूना.  E. पर another, पाक cooking, and निवृत्त ceased.
परपाकरत: परपाकरत m. (-तः) One who observes all the due ceremonies prepara-tory to cooking, but lives upon others.  E. पर another, पाक cooking, रत constant.
परपाकरुचि: परपाकरुचि m. (-चिः) A constant guest at other's tables.  E. पर another, पाक cooking, and रुचि shining.
परपिण्ड: परपिण्ड n. (-ण्डं) Food given by another.  E. पर, and पिण्ड a ball of rice or meat.
परपिण्डाद: परपिण्डाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Feeding at another's cost.  E. परपिण्ड, and आद who takes.
परपुरुष: परपुरुष m. (-षः) 	 1. A name of VISHṆU. 	 2. Another man.  E. पर supreme, or other, and पुरुष a man.
परपुष्ट: परपुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्ठा-ष्टं) 	 1. Fostered, nourished, &c. by a stranger. 	 m. (-ष्टः) The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 	 f. (-ष्टा) 	 1. A harlot, a whore. 	 2. A parasite plant.  E. पर another, पुष्ट cherished.
परपुष्टमहोत्सव: परपुष्टमहोत्सव m. (-वः) The mango.  E. परपुष्ट the cuckoo, महा great, and उत्सव festival.
परपूर्वा: परपूर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा) A woman formerly married.  E. पर another, (husband,) पूर्व्व prior, fem. aff. टाप् ।
परपूर्व्वा: परपूर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा) A woman formerly married.  E. पर another, (husband,) पूर्व्व prior, fem. aff. टाप् ।
परपूर्वापति: परपूर्व्वापति m. (-तिः) The husband of a woman remarried.  E. परपूर्व्वा, and पति a husband.
परपूर्व्वापति: परपूर्व्वापति m. (-तिः) The husband of a woman remarried.  E. परपूर्व्वा, and पति a husband.
परप्रतिनप्तृ: परप्रतिनप्तृ m. (-प्ता) A great-great-grandson.  E. पर subsequent, प्रति after, नप्तृ a grandson.
परप्रपौत्र: परप्रपौत्र m. (-त्रः) A great-great-grandson.  E. पर, subsequent, प्रपौत्र great-grandson.
परप्रेष्यत्व: परप्रेष्यत्व n. (-त्वं) Servitude, slavery.  E. पर, and प्रेष्यत्व service.
परव्रह्मन्: परव्रह्मन् n. (-ह्म) The supreme Being.  E. पर, and व्रह्म the same.
परभाग: परभाग m. (-गः) 	 1. Excellence, superior merit, supremacy. 	 2. Good fortune, prosperity. 	 3. The last part, residue, remainder.  E. पर best, and भाग portion.
परभाग्य: परभाग्य n. (-ग्यं) Another's wealth or prosperity.  E. पर, and भाग्य good fortune.
परभुक्त: परभुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Possessed or enjoyed by another.  E. पर, and भुक्त enjoyed.
परभुमि: परभुमि f. (-मिः) A foreign or an enemy's country.  E. पर, and भूमि land.
परभूमिष्ठ: परभूमिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Living or being in a foreign or an enemy's country.  E. परभूमि, and स्थ who stays.
परभूषण: परभूषण n. (-णं) Another's ornament. 	 m. (-णः) Peace purchased by ceding the produce of lands.  E. पर, and भूषण ornament.
परभृत्: परभृत् m. (-भृत्) A crow.  E. पर another, (the cuckoo,) and भृत् who nourishes.
परभृत: परभृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cherished or nourished by a stranger, fostered, adopted. 	 m. (-तः) The Indian cuckoo, which is supposed to leave its eggs in the nest of the crow to be hatched.  E. पर another, and भृत nourished.
परभेदक: परभेदक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Destroying or subduing a foe,  E. पर, and भेदक who breaks.
परम्: परम् ind. A particle of command. 	 2. Of dismissal or refusal. 	 3. Here-after, afterwards.
परम: परम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 	 1. Best, most excellent. 	 2. Chief principal, preced-ing 3. First, chief part. 	 4. Adequate. ind. (-मं) 	 1. A term of assent, yes 2. A term of command.  E. पर best, मा to mete, aff. ड or डम्.
परमगति: परमगति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Chief object or refuge, as a god, protector. 	 2. Final felicity.  E. परम, and गति going.
परमगव: परमगव mf. (-वः-वी) An excellent bull or cow.  E. परम, and गो a cow.
परमगहन: परमगहन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Very mysterious or profound.  E. परम, and गहन thick.
परमत: परमत n. (-तं) A different opinion or doctrine.  E. पर, and मत thought.
परमपद: परमपद n. (-दं) 	 1. Eminence, high station. 	 2. Final felicity  E. परम, and पद station.
परमब्रह्मन्: परमब्रह्मन् n. (-ह्म) The Supreme Spirit.  E. परम, and ब्रह्मन् the same.
परमराज: परमराज m. (-जः) A supreme monarch.  E. परम, and राजन् a king, टच् aff.
परमर्षि: परमर्षि m. (-र्षिः) A Rishi or divine sage, of a peculiar order or division, comprising the Muni BHELA and others.  E. परम excellent, and ऋषि a divine sage.
परमर्मज्ञ: परमर्म्मज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) One who knows another's character or disposition. E. पर, and मर्म्म a vital point, and ज्ञ who knows.
परमर्म्मज्ञ: परमर्म्मज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) One who knows another's character or disposition. E. पर, and मर्म्म a vital point, and ज्ञ who knows.
परमस्वधर्मन्: परमस्वधर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) A virtuous or pious man, one who attends scrupu-lously to the proper duties of his tribe or station.  E. परम best, स्व own, धर्म्म virtue or duty, and अनिच् added.
परमस्वधर्म्मन्: परमस्वधर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) A virtuous or pious man, one who attends scrupu-lously to the proper duties of his tribe or station.  E. परम best, स्व own, धर्म्म virtue or duty, and अनिच् added.
परमहंस: परमहंस m. (-सः) An ascetic, a religious man who has subdued all his senses by abstract meditation.  E. परम best or first, हंस devotee.
परमागति: परमागति f. (-तिः) Final beatitude.  E. परमा best, गति going.
परमाङ्गना: परमाङ्गना f. (-ना) A beautiful woman.  E. परम, and अङ्गना a woman.
परमाणु: परमाणु m. (-णुः) 	 1. An atom, the invisible base of all aggregate bodies; thirty of them are supposed to form a mote in a sunbeam; the lowest measure of weight; in Logic, six of them form the first perceptible object. 	 2. A measure of time, the sun's passage past an atom of matter.  E. परम first, and अणु an atom.
परमाण्वङ्गक: परमाण्वङ्गक m. (-कः) A name of VISHṆU.  E. परमाणु an atom, अङ्ग the body, कप् aff., deriv. irr.; smaller than the smallest; as he is larger than the largest, &c.
परमात्मन्: परमात्मन् m. (-त्मा) The Supreme Being, considered as the soul of the universe.  E. परम first, आत्मन् spirit or soul.
परमाद्वैत: परमाद्वैत n. (-तं) Pure unitarianism. 	 m. (-तः) VISHṆU, the only supreme. E. परम, and अद्वैत without duality.
परमान्न: परमान्न n. (-न्नं) An oblation of rice to progenitors or gods, boiled with milk and sugar.  E. परम best, and अन्न boiled rice; or परम the best, the supreme, (deities, &c.) and अन्न food.
परमापम: परमापम m. (-मः) 	 1. The inclination of a planet's orbit to the ecliptic. 2. The sine of the sun's greatest declination.  E. परम, and अपम declination.
परमायुष: परमायुष m. (-षः) A particular tree: see असन ।
परमायुस्: परमायुस् m. (-युः) The longest period of life, either in men or animals. E. परम and आयुस life.
परमार्थ: परमार्थ m. (-र्थः) 	 1. Truth, fitness. 	 2. Spiritual knowledge. 	 3. Any excel-lent or important aim or object. 	 4. The best sense. 	 5. The best kind of wealth  E. परम, and अर्थ object.
परमार्थविद्: परमार्थविद् m. (-वित्) A sage, a philosopher, one who knows the truth. E. परमार्थ, and विद् who knows.
परमार्थविन्द्: परमार्थविन्द् mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) Who or what acquires knowledge of truth, the best kind of wealth, &c.  E. परमार्थ, and विद् to acquire, श aff. मुम् augment.
परमावधि: परमावधि f. (-धिः) Utmost term or limit.  E. परम, and अवधि limit.
परमार्हत: परमार्हत m. (-तः) A king and holy saint, apparently the same as SĀLI-BĀHANA.  E. परम excellent, अर्हत a Jina.
परमृत्यु: परमृत्यु m. (-त्युः) A crow.  E. पर another, and मृत्यु death; having many enemies.
परमेश्वर: परमेश्वर m. (-रः) 	 1. The Supreme Being. 	 2. SĪVA. 	 3. VISHṆU. 	 f. (-री) DURGĀ.  E. परम best, ईश्वर lord.
परमेष्ठ: परमेष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Supreme, superior. 	 m. (-ष्ठः) 	 1. BRAMHĀ. 	 2. A deity.  E. परमे, in heaven, and स्थ who stays or is.
परमेष्ठिन्: परमेष्ठिन् m. (-ष्ठी) 	 1. A name of BRAMHĀ. 	 2. A Jina or deified teacher of the Jaina sect. 	 3. A kind of Sālagrām stone. 	 4. A Guru or spiritual guide.  E. परमे in the most exalted place, in heaven, स्था to be, Unādi aff. निन्.
परम्पद: परम्पद n. (-दं) 	 1. Eternal felicity. 	 2. The abode of VISHṆU.  E. पर् an-other, पद degree.
परम्पर: परम्पर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Successive, proceeding from one to another, from father to son, &c. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A sort of deer. 	 2. A great-great-grand-son. 	 f. (-रा) 	 1. Race, progeny, lineage. 	 2. Order, method, continu-ous arrangement, regular series or succession. 	 2. Hurting, killing, injury.  E. पर subsequent, repeated, and the nasal augment.
परम्परतस्: परम्परतस् ind. Mutually.  E. परम्पर, and तसि aff.
परम्पराक: परम्पराक n. (-कं) Immolating animals in sacrifice.  E. परम्पर tradi-tionary or successive, and अक going or worshipping; or परम् much, पर the best, and अक going, custom.
परम्परीण: परम्परीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. Hereditary, what has come by inheritance or descent. 	 2. Traditional.  E. परम् another, and पर again, another, ख aff.
पररु: पररु m. (-रुः) A potherb, (Eclipta prostrata;) also केशराज.  E. पर much, रुह् to grow, डु aff.
पररूप: पररूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) परस्य रूपमिव रूपमस्य । स्वोत्तरवर्त्तिपरस्येव रूपवति “एङिपररूपम्” पानिनि ।
परलोक: परलोक m. (-कः) Heaven, paradise.  E. पर another, and लोक world.
परलोकगम: परलोकगम m. (-मः) Death, dying.  E. पर another, लोक world, and गम going.
परवत्: परवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Dependent, subject.  E. पर another, मतुप् aff.
परवश: परवश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 	 1. Subservient, dependant, subject. 	 2. Deceived. E. पर another, and वश subjection.
परवाच्य: परवाच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) Reprehensible, blamable. 	 n. (-च्यं) Fault, defect.  E. पर, and वाच्य to be named, not to be spoken of.
परवाणि: परवाणि m. (-णिः) 	 1. A Judge, a ruler. 	 2. A year. 	 3. The peacock on which the god KĀRTIKEYA rides.  E. पर best, वा to go, णि aff,
परव्रत: परव्रत m. (-तः) A name of DHRITARĀSHTRA.  E. पर best, व्रत, religi-ous observance.
परश: परश m. (-शः) A kind of stone, the touch of which turns iron into gold, the philosopher's stone.
परशव्य: परशव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Fit or proper for a hatchet.  E. परशु an axe, यञ् aff.
परशु: परशु m. (-शुः) An axe, a hatchet.  E. पर another, शु to injure, Unādi aff. कु, डिच्च ।
परशुधर: परशुधर m. (-रः) 	 1. A soldier armed with an axe. 	 2. A name of GANESA. 3. PARASURĀMA: see the next.  E. परशु an axe, धर who holds.
परशुराम: परशुराम m. (-मः) A hero and demigod; the first of the three RĀMAS, and the sixth Avatāra or descent of the deity VISHṆU: who appeared in the world as the saint JAMADAGNI, for the purpose of repressing the tyranny and punishing the violence of the Kshetriya, or military tribe; PARASURĀMA appears to typify the tribe of Brāmhans and their contests with the Kshetrityas. E. परशु an axe, and राम who delights in; also with कन् added, परशुरामक; and with the first member, पर्शु, पर्शुराम, q. v.
परश्व: परश्व(स्व)ध m. (-धः) An axe, a hatchet.  E. पर another, an enemy, श्व derived from श्वि, to grow or thrive; परश्व the prosperity of a foe, धे to drink, क aff.; what drinks the blood or destroys the life of an enemy; also पारश्वध and परस्वध.
परश्वस्: परश्वस् ind. The day after to-morrow.  E. पर after, अवस् to-morrow; also परःश्वस्.
परस्: परस् ind. Beyond, further, more than, on the other side of, &c. (Not used by itself in classical Sanskrit.)  E. पर, पञ्चम्याद्यर्थे बा असि ।
परसङ्गत: परसङ्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Associated with another. 	 2. Fighting or engaged with another.  E. पर, and सङ्गत gone with.
परसंज्ञक: परसंज्ञक m. (-कः) The soul.  E. पर best, संज्ञा name or title; aff. कप्.
परसम्बन्ध: परसम्बन्ध m. (-न्धः) Relation or connexion with another.  E. पर, and सम्बन्ध connexion.
परसम्बन्धिन्: परसम्बन्धिन् mfn. (-न्धी-न्धिनी-न्धि) 	 1. Related to another. 	 2. Belonging to another.  E. परसम्बन्ध, and इनि aff.
परस्तात्: परस्तात् ind. 	 1. Subsequently, afterwards. 	 2. Behind.  E. पर, and अस्ताति aff.
परस्पर: परस्पर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Mutual, interchanging.  E. पर another repeated: from one to another.
परस्परज्ञ: परस्परज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A friend, an intimate.  E. परस्पर, and ज्ञ who know.
परस्परानुमति: परस्परानुमति f. (-तिः) Mutual concurrence or assent.  E. परस्पर, and अनुमति agreement.
परस्पराम: परस्पराम ind. Mutually.  E. परस्पर, and आम् aff.
परस्परोपकार: परस्परोपकार m. (-रः) 	 1. Mutual assistance. 	 2. Offensive and defensive alliance.  E. परस्पर, उपकार aid.
परस्परोपकारिन्: परस्परोपकारिन् m. (-री) 	 1. An ally. 	 2. An associate, a helper.  E. इनि added to the last.
परस्मैपद: परस्मैपद n. (-दं) The transitive or active verb.  E. परस्मै to another, पद an inflected word.
परस्व: परस्व n. (-स्वं) Another person's property.  E. पर, and स्व own.
परस्वत्व: परस्वत्व n. (-त्वं) Another's right.  E. पर, and स्वत्व own right.
परस्वत्वापादन: परस्वत्वापादन n. (-नं) Conferring a right upon another as by gift, &c. E. परस्वत्व, and आपादन producing.
परस्वध: परस्वध m. (-धः) An axe: see परश्वध.
परस्वादायिन्: परस्वादायिन् mfn. (यी-यिनी-यि) Extortionary, extortioner.  E. परस्व, and आदायिन् taking.
परस्वोपजीविक: परस्वोपजीविक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Dependent, living on the property of others.  E. परस्व, and उपजीविक subsisting.
परहित: परहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Friendly, benevolent. 	 2. Good or profitable form for another.  E. पर, and हित favourable.
परा: परा ind. A participle and prefix implying, 1. Supremacy. 	 2. Libera-tion. 	 3. Inverted order. 	 4. Pride, contumely. 	 5. Encounter, mutual presence. 	 6. Excess, exceeding. 	 7. Overcoming, surpass-ing. 	 8. Going. 	 9. Killing, destroying, injuring. As पराक्रम supe-rior power or valour; पराजय defeat; पराभव disgrace; परावर्त्त turning back, &c. see the following.  E. पॄ to fill, aff. अप्, and आ added.
पराक्: पराक् ind. Crooked, crookedly.  E. परा away, अच् to go, aff. क्विप्.
पराक: पराक m. (-कः) 	 1. A religious obligation of an expiatory kind, fasting for twelve days and nights, and keeping the mind attentive, and organs subdued. 	 2. A sacrificial sword or scimitar.  E. परा best, अक what goes.
पराकरण: पराकरण n. (-णं) Disdaining, disregarding, rejecting.  E. परा before, कृ to do, ल्युट् aff.
पराकुर्व्वन्: पराकुर्व्वन् mfn. (-र्व्वन्-र्व्वन्ती-र्व्वत्) Throwing off or aside, rejecting, dis-daining.  E. परा, and कुर्व्वन् making.
पराकृत: पराकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rejected, set aside, thrown off, disdained. E. पर, and कृत made.
पराक्रम: पराक्रम m. (-मः) 	 1. Power, strength. 	 2. Exertion. 	 3. Valour, prowess. 4. Going out or forth, exit or issue. 	 5. Attacking an enemy. 6. Attempt, enterprise. 	 7. A name of Vishṇu.  E. परा supremacy, opposition, &c. and क्रम going, करणे घञ् aff.
पराक्रमज्ञ: पराक्रमज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Knowing the power, (of the enemy.) E. पराक्रम, and ज्ञ who knows.
पराग: पराग m. (-गः) 	 1. The pollen or farina of a flower. 	 2. Dust. 	 3. Fra-grant powder used after bathing. 	 4. Sandal. 	 5. The name of a mountain. 	 6. Fame, celebrity. 	 7. An eclipse of the sun or moon. 8. Following one's own inclinations.  E. परा implying supremacy, &c. and ग who goes, ड aff.
परागवत्: परागवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Laden with pollen.  E. पराग, and मतुप् aff.
परागत: परागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Spread, expanded. 	 2. Budded, blown.  E. पर, and आङ् before, गम् to go, aff. क्त.
परागिन्: परागिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Laden with pollen.  E. पराग, and इनि aff.
पराङ्गद: पराङ्गद m. (-दः) A name of ŚIVA.  E. पर another, (DURGĀ,) अङ्ग form and द who gives; forming with the goddess a deity, half male and half female; or better, पर an enemy, KĀMADEVA, अङ्ग body, and द who gives; restoring the body of that deity to shape, after having reduced it to ashes in a rage.
पराङ्गव: पराङ्गव m. (-वः) Ocean.  E. पर another, (river,) अङ्ग substance, water, and व who receives.
पराङ्मुख: पराङ्मुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Turning away, having the face averted. E. पराञ्च्, and मुख the face.
पराङ्मुखता: पराङ्मुखता f. (-ता) 	 1. Turning away. 	 2. Regardless of. 	 3. Adverse from. 	 4. Unfavourable.  E. पराङ्मुख, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, पराङ्मुखत्वं.
पराच्: पराच् mfn. (-ङ्ः-ची-क्) 	 1. Situated beyond or on the other side. 	 2. Dis-tant.  E. परा + अञ्चति-क्किप्ः see परञ्च् ।
पराचित: पराचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cherished or fostered by a stranger.  E. पर another, आचित nourished.
पराचीन: पराचीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Turned away, having the face averted. 	 2. Not minding, not caring about. 	 3. Happening subsequently. 	 4. Situated on the other side.  E. पराञ्च् or पराच् turned away, ख aff.
पराजय: पराजय m. (-यः) 	 1. Defeat. 	 2. Overpowering. 	 3. Loss, failure, (as in law suit.) 	 4. The being overcome by, (with an ablative.)  E. परा imply-ing encounter, contest, and जय victory.
पराजयमाण: पराजयमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Overcoming, surpassing, defeating. E. पर before, जि to conquer, शानच् aff.
पराजित: पराजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Conquered, defeated, overcome. 	 2. Won at dice, &c.  E. परा encounter, and जित conquered.
पराञ्च्: पराञ्च् or पराच् mfn. (पराङ् पराची पराक्) Turned away, inverted, reversed.  E. परा away, अञ्च् to go, aff. क्विन्.
पराञ्ज: पराञ्ज m. (ञ्जः) 	 1. An oil mill. 	 2. Froth or foam. 	 3. The blade of a sword or knife: see परञ्ज.
परात्पर: परात्पर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Superior to the best.  E. पर in the fifth case, and repeated in the first.
परात्प्रिय: परात्प्रिय m. (-यः) A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum.) उल इतिभाषा ।
परादन: परादन mf. (-नः-ना) A horse of the Persian breed.  E. परा exceeding, अदन food. (अरवी घोडा) ।
पराधि: पराधि m. (-धिः) Hunting, the chase. अन्यस्याधौकर्म०, परममानसव्यथायाम्च ।
पराधिकार: पराधिकार m. (-रः) Another person's office or post.  E. पर, and अधिकार superintendence.
पराधिकारचर्च्चा: पराधिकारचर्च्चा f. (-र्च्चा) Officiousness, interference with another's con-cerns.  E. पराघिकार, and चर्च्चा searching.
पराधीन: पराधीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Dependant, subject, subservient.  E. पर another, and अधीन humble, docile.
पराधीनता: पराधीनता f. (-ता) Subjection, dependance.  E. तल् added to the last; with त्य, पराधीनत्व n. (-त्वं)
परान: परान(ण)सा f. (-सा) The practice of medicine, administering remedies. E. परान् enemies, (disease,) षो to destroy, aff. ड; form irr; or correctly: परा + अन-करणे वा अस ।

परान्नभोजिन्: परान्नभोजिन् mfn. (-जी-जिनी-जि) Living at another's cost.  E. परान्न, and भोजिन् who eats.
पराप: पराप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) A place, &c. whence water has retired.  E. पर away, अप water; also परेप.
परापतत्: परापतत् mfn. (-तन्-तन्ती-तत्) Coming back quickly, returning hastily E. पर, and आङ् before, पत् to go, शतृ aff.
परापर: परापर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Best and worst, prior and posterior, in front and behind, earlier and later, &c. 	 n. (-रं) (In Logic,) Community of property intermediate between the greatest and smallest num-bers: a species, as being between genus and individual. 	 m. (-रः) A Guru of an intermediate class, a term applied in the Tantras to the goddess DURGĀ.  E. पर, and अपर another.
पराभ: पराभ(भा)व m. (वः) 	 1. Discomfiting, overcoming. 	 2. Contempt, disres-pect, disgrace. 	 3. Destruction. 	 4. Mortification, humiliation. E. परा disgrace, भू to be, अप् aff. or rarely घञ् ।
पराभूत: पराभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Defeated, discomfited, overcome. 	 2. Degrated, humbled, treated with contempt.  E. परा disgrace, and भू been, become, from भू with क्त aff.
परामर्श: परामर्श m. (-र्शः) 	 1. Discrimination, discriminating, distinguishing, judgment. 	 2. (In Logic,) Drawing conclusions from analogy or experience: knowledge of the existence of hetu in the Paksha. 	 3. Seizing, pulling. 	 4. Violence, assault, attack. 	 5. Hindrance. 	 6. Reflection, consideration, investigation.  E. परा implying supre-macy, &c. मृश् to deliberate, भावे घञ् aff.
परामर्ष: परामर्ष m. (-र्षः) Forbearance.  E. परा, and मृष् to bear, aff. घञ् ।
परामृत: परामृत n. (-तं) Raining.  E. पर best, अमृत water.
परामृष्ट: परामृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Weighed, considered, Judged. 	 2. Con-nected with. 	 3. Touched or affected by. 	 4. Borne, endured. 	 5. Roughly handled, violated.  E. पर, and आङ् before, मृश् to deliber-ate, or मृष् to bear, क्त aff.
परायण: परायण mfn. subst. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. Adherence to any pursuit, attachment to any object. 	 2. Dependance upon. 	 3. Best refuge. adj. 	 1. Adher-ing or attached to. 	 2. परायत्त: परायत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Dependant, subject.  E. पर another, आयत्त tame, humble.
परारि: परारि ind. The year before last.  E. पर another, (last.) अरि aff. in this sense.
परारित्न: परारित्न mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं) Belonging to the year before last.  E. परारि as above, and त्न aff.
परारु: परारु m. (-रु.) A kind of gourd, (momordica charantia.)  E. पृ to fill or satisfy, आरु aff. or परा + ऋ + उण् । (डच्छा) ।
परारुक: परारुक m. (-कः) A stone or rock.  E. परारु a gourd, कन् aff. of comparison.
परार्थ: परार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 	 1. Having another object or sense, &c. 	 2. Designed or purposed by another. 	 3. The highest interest. 	 4. The chief meaning. 	 n. (-र्थं) For the sake or good of another. E. पर, and अर्थ object.
परार्थवादिन्: परार्थवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Officious, intermeddling.  E. परार्थ, and वादिन् who speaks.

परावर: परावर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Before and after, prior and subsequent, far and near, earlier and later, higher and lower. 	 2. All including.  E. पर, and अवर after.

परावर्त्त: परावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 	 1. Retreat, turning back. 	 2. Exchange, barter. 	 3. Reversal of a sentence. 	 4. Restoration.  E. परा, वृत् to be, aff. घञ्.
परावर्त्त्य: परावर्त्त्य mfn. (-र्त्त्यः-र्त्त्या-र्त्त्यं) 	 1. To be turned back. 	 2. To be exchanged. 3. to be reserved, (as a sentence.) 	 4. To be given back or restor-ed.  E. परा, वृत् to be, यत् aff.
परावर्त्त्यव्यवहार: परावर्त्त्यव्यवहार m. (-रः) Appeal, (in law.)  E. परावर्त्त्य to be reserved, व्यवहार judicial procedure.
पराविद्ध: पराविद्ध m. (-द्धः) A name of KUVERA.  E. पर an enemy, आविद्ध frightened; or परा + व्यध-क्त ।

पराशरिन्: पराशरिन् m. (-री) A beggar, a wandering mendicant.  E. पराशर the rules of PĀRĀSARA or VYĀSA, the founder of the tribe, and इनि aff.; also पाराशरिन्.
पराश्रय: पराश्रय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Dependent or relying upon another. 	 m. (-यः) Dependance. 	 f. (-या) A parasite plant.  E. पर another, आश्रय asy-lum.
पराश्रित: पराश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Subject, dependent.  E. पर, and आश्रित having refuge.
परासन: परासन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter.  E. पर an enemy, अस् to throw or cast, aff. भावे ल्युट्.
परासिसिषु: परासिसिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) 	 1. Desirous to throw or send. 	 2. Wishing to overcome.  E. पर before, अस to throw, desid. v., उ aff.
परासु: परासु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) Dead, expired.  E. पर away, remote, असु vital breath.
परासुता: परासुता f. (-ता) 	 1. Death, extinction. 	 2. Drowsiness, sleepiness. E. परासु, and तल् aff. or with त्व, परासुत्वं.
परास्कन्दिन्: परास्कन्दिन् m. (-न्दी) A thief, a robber.  E. पर another's property, स्कन्द to steal, with आङ् prefix, णिनि aff. (डाकाइत) ।
परास्त: परास्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 	 1. Thrown, tossed. 	 2. Expelled, turned out. 3. Defeated. 	 4. Rejected.  E. पर, and अस् to throw, क्त aff.
पराह: पराह m. (-हः) The next day.  E. पर, and अह, for अहन् a day.
पराहत: पराहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Assailed, attacked. 	 2. Struck back. 	 3. Re-pulsed. 	 n. (-तं) A stroke.  E. पर, आहत struck.
पराह्ण: पराह्ण n. (-ह्लं) The afternoon, the latter part of the day.  E. पर after, (past,) अह a day. टच् अह्नादेशः णत्वञ्च ।
परि: परि A particle and prefix to words implying, 1. Ubiquity, (all round, on every side.) 	 2. Part, portion. 	 3. Abandonment, (away.) 	 4. End, term. 	 5. Sickness. infirmity. 	 6. Enforcement, stress, (even, very great.) 	 7. Separateness, several distributions, (each by each, &c.) 8. Embracing, encircling, (round, round about.) 	 9. Depreciation, exposure of faults. 	 10. Homage, respect. 	 11. Rejection, turning off or away. 	 12. Ornament. 	 13. Diffusion, extension. 	 14. Mark or sign. 	 15. Sorrow. 	 16. Cessation, stop, impediment. 	 17. Truth. 18. An exclamation of Pleasure or satisfaction. As परिकर्त्तुं, to adorn; परिक्षिप्नुं, to abandon; परिछेत्तुं, to divide; परिदेवितुं, to lament; परिरब्धुं, to embrace; परिव्रजितुं, to go about, to wander, &c.: see the following compound nouns.  E. पॄ to complete, to satisfy, aff. इन्; in combination with roots forming nouns by घञ्, the इ of परि is sometimes optionally lengthened, as परी.

परि(र)णाम m. (-मः) 	 1. Change of form or state. 	 2. Maturity, fulness, ripeness. 	 3. End, last stage or state. 	 4. Digestion. 	 5. Result. 6. परि(-री)भव m. (-वः) 	 1. Disrespect, contempt, disgrace. 	 2. Defeat, dis-comfiture.  E. परि implying depreciation, and भव being; also परिभाव.

परिकर्त्तृ: परिकर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्तृः) A priest who performs the marriage ceremony for a younger brother, whose elder brother is yet unmarried.

परिवर्त्तित: परिवर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Turned round, revolved. 	 2. Returned, retreated. 	 3. Taken out but on in a wrong direction. 	 4. Ex-changed.  E. परि before, वृत् to be, क्त aff.
परिवर्तिन्: परिवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) 	 1. Revolving, going round. 	 2. Return-ing. 	 3. Flying, retreating. 	 4. Exchanging. 	 5. Requiting, recom-pensing.  E. परि, and वृत् to be, णिनि aff.
परिवर्त्तिन्: परिवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) 	 1. Revolving, going round. 	 2. Return-ing. 	 3. Flying, retreating. 	 4. Exchanging. 	 5. Requiting, recom-pensing.  E. परि, and वृत् to be, णिनि aff.
परिवर्द्धन: परिवर्द्धन n. (-नं) 	 1. Growing, increasing. 	 2. Rearing, breeding, (as of cattle.)  E. परि, and वर्द्धन increasing.
परिवर्द्धित: परिवर्द्धित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Increased, augmented.  E. परि before, वृद्ध to increase, क्त aff.
परिवर्ह: परिवर्ह m. (-र्हः) 	 1. Train, retinue, dependents. 	 2. Royal insignia. E. परि around, वर्ह् to cover, घञ् aff.; also परिबर्ह.
परिवसथ: परिवसथ m. (-थः) A village.  E. परि about, वस to abide, aff. आधारे अथच् ।
परिवह: परिवह m. (-हः) Name of the second of the seven courses of wind. E. परि + वह-अच् ।
परिवाद: परिवाद m. (-दः) 	 1. Abuse reproach, reproof. 	 2. Charge, accusation. 3. The bow or quill of the lute or fiddle.  E. परि censure, &c. and वाद speech.
परिवादक: परिवादक m. (-कः) An accuser, a plaintiff, a complaint or calumnia-tor.  E. परि implying censure, वद् to speak, वुञ् aff.
परिवादिन्: परिवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 	 1. Who or what reproaches, accuses, &c. 2. Censured, abused. 	 3. Calling out, crying, screaming. 	 m. (-दी) An accuser, a reprover; (in Law,) a plaintiff. 	 f. (-नी) A lute or a vinā, with seven strings.  E. परिवाद as above, इनि aff. or परि before, वद् to speak, ताच्छील्ये घिणुन् aff.
परिवाप: परिवाप m. (-पः) 	 1. Shaving, shearing. 	 2. A pool, a pond, a piece of water. 	 3. Train, retinue. 	 4. Sowing. 	 5. Furniture.  E. परि be-fore, वप् to shave, aff. घञ्.
परिवापन: परिवापन n. (-नं) Shaving, shearing.  E. परि before, वप् to cut or shave, causal v. aff. ल्युट्.
परिवापित: परिवापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaven, shorn.  E. परिवाप shaving, aff. इतच्. or परि + वप्-णिच्-क्त ।
परिवार: परिवार m. (-रः) 	 1. Dependent. 	 2. Train or retinue. 	 3. A scabbard, a sheath.  E. परि round, वृ to be, aff. घञ्.
परिवारता: परिवारता f. (-ता) Subjection, dependance.  E. तल् added to परिवार.
परिवारित: परिवारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Surrounded, enclosed or begirt by.  E. परि, and वारित impeded.
परिवास: परिवास m. (-सः) Abiding, abode.  E. परि, and वस् to dwell, घञ् aff.
परिवासित: परिवासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Respectfully attentive to superiors. E. परि respect, वस् to abide, aff. क्त, and इट inserted.
परिवाहवत्: परिवाहवत् m. (-वान्) A pond or pool.  E. परिवाह a drain, and मतुप् poss. aff.
परिवाहित: परिवाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Drained.  E. परिवाह, and इतच् aff.
परिविण्ण: परिविण्ण(न्न) m. (-ण्णः or न्नः) An unmarried elder brother whose junior is married.  E. परि before, विद् to know, क्त aff.
परिवित्ति: परिवित्ति m. (-त्तिः) An unmarried elder brother, the younger being married and a householder.  E. परि abandoning, and विद् to cover, affix क्तिच् ।
परिविन्दक: परिविन्दक m. (-कः) A younger brother married or become a house-holder before the elder.  E. परि, विद् to possess, क्कुन् aff.
परिविन्दत्: परिविन्दत् m. (-न्दन्) An unmarried elder brother.  E. परि before, विद् to know, शतृ aff.
परिविष्ट: परिविष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Surrounded, enclosed 2. Offered, pre-sented.  E. परि, and विष् to enter, क्त aff.
परिविष्णु: परिविष्णु ind. Entirely or every where VISHṆU.  E. परि sound, विष्णु VISHṆU.
परिविह्वल: परिविह्वल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Agitated, bewildered.  E. परि, and विह्वल agitated.
परिविह्वलता: परिविह्वलता f. (-ता) Bewilderment.  E. परिविह्वल, and तल् aff.
परिवीत: परिवीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Surrounded, encompassed, invested. 	 2. Overspread, pervaded. 	 n. (-तं) The bow of BRAMHĀ.  E. परि, and व्येञ् to surround, क्त aff.
परिवृंहण: परिवृंहण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Augmenting, enlarging, what enlarges or adds to. 	 m. (-णः) An appendix, an additional work or section. E. वृहि to increase, with परि prefixed, and ल्युट् aff.
परिवृंहित: परिवृंहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Increased, augmented. 	 2. Improved, thriven. 	 3. Sounded. 	 4. Lightened, illuminated. 	 5. Excited, stimulated.  E. परि before, वृहि to augment, aff. क्त.
परिवृढ: परिवृढ m. (-ढः) A master, an owner, a superior.  E. परि exceeding, वृह to thrive, aff. क्त.
परिवृत: परिवृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Encompassed, surrounded. 	 2. Gained or received entirely. 	 3. Known. 	 4. Concealed. 	 5. Overspread.  E. परि before, वृ to be, aff. क्त.
परिवृत्त: परिवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 	 1. Gone round, revolved. 	 2. Turned back, retreated, retired. 	 3. Exchanged. 	 4. Finished, ended. 	 n. (-त्तं) An embrace.  E. परि before, वृत् to be, aff क्त.
परिवृत्ति: परिवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 	 1. Exchange, barter. 	 2. Revolution, return. 	 3. End, termination. 	 4. An unmarried elder brother. 	 5. Surrounding, encompassing. 	 6. A striking exchange, one producing charm, considered as a figure of speech in rhetoric.  E. परि mutually, वृत् to be, क्तिन aff.
परिवृत्य: परिवृत्य ind. 	 1. Having retreated or retired. 	 2. Having turned round or revolved.  E. परि before, वृत् to be, ल्यप् aff.
परिवृस्ति: परिवृस्ति m. (-स्तिः) An elder brother unmarried: see परिवित्ति ।
परिवृहित: परिवृहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Increased, literally or figuratively, grown, thriven. 	 2. Making effort, exerted.  E. परि much, वृह् to grow, aff. क्त.
परिवेतृ: परिवेतृ m. (-ता) A younger brother married or become a householder before his elder.  E. परि abandoning, (the usual practice,) विद् to know or possess, (a wife,) तृच् aff.
परिवेदन: परिवेदन n. (-नं) 	 1. Anguish, pain, misery. 	 2. Marriage, (especially the marriage of a younger brother before the elder,) marrying. 3. Discussion. 	 4. Gain, acquisition. 	 5. Keeping the household fire. 	 6. Universal existence. 	 f. (-ना) 	 1. Shrewdness, wit. 	 2. Fore-sight, prudence.  E. परि before, विद् to know, &c. aff. ल्युट्, or युच्.
परिवेदिन्: परिवेदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 	 1. Shrewd, knowing. 	 2. Suffering pain. 	 f. (-नी) The wife of a younger brother, the elder brother being unmarried.  E. परि, and विद् to know, aff. घिणुन्.
परिवेश: परिवेश m. (-शः) 	 1. Surrounding, encompassing. 	 2. The circumference of a circle. 	 3. The disk of the sun or moon, a halo round the sun or moon. 	 4. Waiting at or serving up meals.  E. परि round, विश् or विष् to encompass, aff. घञ्; hence also परिवेष ।
परिवेष: परिवेष m. (-षः) 	 1. Surrounding, encircling. 	 2. The circumference of a circle. 	 3. The disk of the sun or moon. 	 4. Distributing rice, &c. to a party, serving up a meal: see the last.
परिवेषण: परिवेषण n. (-णं) 	 1. Surrounding, enclosing. 	 2. Serving up dinner, distributing food to guests, &c. 	 3. A halo round the sun or moon.  E. परि round, वेषण encompassing.
परिवेष्टन: परिवेष्टन n. (-नं) 	 1. Surrounding, encompassing. 	 2. Circumference. E. परि before, वेष्ट् to surround, ल्युट् aff.
परिवेष्टित: परिवेष्टित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Enclosed, surrounded, encompassed. 	 2. Covered, veiled.  E. परि around, and वेष्टित surrounded.
परिव्याध: परिव्याध m. (-धः) 	 1. A tree, (Pteros permum acerifolia.) 	 2. A sort of reed growing in water, (Calamus fasciculatus.)  E. परि much, व्याध pain. परि + व्यध्-कर्त्तरि-ण ।
परिव्रज्या: परिव्रज्या f. (-ज्या) 	 1. Ascetic devotion, religious austerity, abandon-ment of the world. 	 2. Leading the life of a mendicant.  E. परि about, व्रज्या religious wandering. परि + व्रज्-भावे क्यप् ।
परिव्रढिमन्: परिव्रढिमन् m. (-मा) Masterhood, superiority.  E. परिवृढ, and इमनिच् aff., ऋ changed to र ।
परिव्राज्: परिव्राज् m. (-ड् or ट्) The man of the last religious order, the mendi-cant devotee.  E. परि about, व्रज् to go, aff. क्किप्, and the vowel made long; also with घञ् aff. परिव्राज.
परिव्राज: परिव्राज m. (-जः) An ascetic: परि + व्रज्-सज्ञायां-कर्त्तरि घञ् ।
परिव्राजक: परिव्राजक m. (-कः) A religious mendicant.  E. परि about, व्रज् to wander, ण्वुल् aff.
परिव्राज्य: परिव्राज्य n. (-ज्यं) The state or condition of an ascetic.  E. परिव्राज् as above, and यत् aff.
परिशङ्कनीय: परिशङ्कनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be doubted, to be feared or apprehend-ed.  E. परि completely, शकि to doubt, अनीयर् aff.
परिशाप: परिशाप m. (-पः) Cursing, reviling.  E. परि before, शप् to curse, घञ् aff.
परिशिष्ट: परिशिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Left, remaining. 	 2. Finished. 	 n. (ष्टं) A supplement, an appendix.  E. परि, and शिष्ट left. or परि + शिष्-क्त ।
परिशीलन: परिशीलन n. (-नं) 	 1. Intercourse, correspondence. 	 2. Steady pursuit, study.
परिशुद्ध: परिशुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 	 1. Cleaned. 	 2. Purified. 	 3. Discharged, paid.  E. परि before, शुघ् to be pure, क्त aff.
परिशुष्क: परिशुष्क mfn. (-ष्कः-ष्का-ष्कं) Dry, dried. 	 n. (ष्कं) Meat fried, first with ghee, washed well with warm water, and dressed with spice, &c. E. परि much, शुष्क dried.
परिशेष: परिशेष m. (-षः) 	 1. Remainder. 	 2. Completion. 	 3. Supplement.  E. परि, and शेष end. परि + शिष्-घञ् ।
परिशोध: परिशोध m. (-धः) 	 1. Cleansing, purifying, correcting. 	 2. Discharging a debt or obligation.  E. परि, and शोध purifying; also परिशोधन.
परिशोष: परिशोष m. (-षः) Drying, evaporation.  E. परि before, शुष् to be dry, घञ् aff.
परिश्रम: परिश्रम m. (-मः) 	 1. Labour, trouble, pain. 	 2. Distress, fatigue. E. परि exceeding, श्रम weariness.
परिश्रय: परिश्रय m. (-यः) 	 1. An assembly, a meeting. 	 2. An asylum.  E. परि before, श्री to serve, &c. aff. अच्.
परिश्रान्त: परिश्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Overcome with distress or fatigue, ex-hausted, wearied.  E. परि before, श्रम् to be weary, aff. क्त.
परिश्रान्ति: परिश्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 	 1. Labour, trouble. 	 2. Fatigue, exhaustion.  E. परि before, श्रम् to be weary, क्तिन् aff.
परिश्रत: परिश्रत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Heard.  E. परि, and श्रुत heard.
परिश्लिष: परिश्लिष m. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Embraced, clasped.  E. परि before, श्लिष् to embrace, क्त aff.
परिश्लेष: परिश्लेष m. (-षः) Embracing, an embrace.  E. परि, and श्लेष embracing.
परिषत्त्व: परिषत्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) The formation or collection or functions of an assembly.  E. त्त्व added to the next.
परिषद्: परिषद् f. (षद् or षत्) An assembly, a meeting, an audience or congre-gation.  E. परि around, सद् to go, aff. आधारे क्विप्.
परिषद: परिषद m. (-दः) A spectator at a play, one of an assembly or congre-gation.  E. परिषद् as above, and अण् aff.; whence it is more usually परिषद । or परि + सद्-अच् ।
परिषद्य: परिषद्य m. (-द्यः) One of a party or assembly, a spectator, a guest. E. See परिषद, यत् being added.
परिषद्वल: परिषद्वल m. (-लः) 	 1. An assistant in an assembly, an associate. 	 2. A spectator, &c.  E. परिषद as above, वलच् aff.
परिष्क: परिष्क(स्क)न्द m. (-न्दः) 	 1. A foster child, one nourished by a stranger. 2. A servant. see परिस्कन्द ।
परिष्कन्न: परिष्कन्न(ण्ण) m. (-न्नः -or -ण्णः) A foster child, or one nourished by a stranger: see परिस्कन्न.  E. परि + स्कन्द-क्त ।
परिष्कार: परिष्कार m. (-रः) 	 1. Decoration, embellishment. 	 2. Cooking, dressing. 3. Finishing, polishing. 	 4. Initiation, purification by essential rites. 	 5. Surrounding. 	 6. Furniture.  E. परि implying ornament, and कार making, स inserted, and changed to ष; also in the same sense परिस्कार.
परिष्कृ: परिष्कृ(स्कृ)त mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Adorned, decorated, embellished. 	 2. Highly finished or polished. 	 3. Cooked, dressed. 	 4. Purified by initiatory rites. 	 5. Surrounded, encompassed.  E. परि before, कृ to make, aff. क्त. see the last.
परिष्कृतभूमि: परिष्कृतभूमि f. (-मिः) An altar, or ground prepared for a sacrifice, or for the victim and the untensils employed.  E. परिष्कृत, and भूमि ground.
परिष्कृति: परिष्कृति f. (-तिः) Finished, polishing, &c. see परिष्कार.
परिष्टोम: परिष्टोम m. (-मः) An elephant's coloured housings: see षरिस्तोम ।
परिष्ठल: परिष्ठल n. (-लं) Surrounding place or site.  E. परि, and स्थल place.
परिष्वङ्ग: परिष्वङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Embracing, an embrace.  E. परि before, ष्वजि to embrace, aff. घञ् ।
परिष्वज्य: परिष्वज्य ind. Having embraced.  E. परि, ष्कजि to embrace, ल्युप् aff.
परिसङ्ख्या: परिसङ्ख्या f. (-ङ्ख्या) 	 1. Total or complete enumeration or specification, implying exclusion of any other. 	 2. Reckoning, enumerating. E. परि, and सङ्ख्या a number.
परिसङ्ख्यात: परिसङ्ख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Counted, enumerated. 	 2. Reckoned up or specified exclusively of any more.  E. परि, and सङ्ख्यात counted.
परिसङ्ख्यान: परिसङ्ख्यान n. (-नं) 	 1. Exclusive enumeration or specification. 	 2. Cor-rect judgment.  E. परि, and सङ्ख्यान reckoning.
परिसञ्चर: परिसञ्चर m. (-रः) Time of universal destruction.  E. परि + सम-चर-अच् ।
परिसभ्य: परिसभ्य m. (-भ्यः) An assistant at an assembly.  E. परि about, सभ्य a fellow guest.
परिसमापन: परिसमापन n. (-नं) Finishing entirely.  E. परि, and सम् before, आप् to get, ल्युट् aff.
परिसमाप्त: परिसमाप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Finished, done entirely.  E. परि, and समाप्त finished.
परिसमाप्ति: परिसमाप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Entire completion.  E. परि, and सम before, आप् to obtain, क्तिन् aff.
परिसमूहन: परिसमूहन n. (-नं) 	 1. Heaping up. 	 2. Sprinkling water round the sacri-ficial fire.  E. परि + सम-उह-भावे-ल्युट् ।
परिसर: परिसर m. (-रः) 	 1. Ground on the skirts of a river or mountain, or contiguous to a town, &c. 	 2. Death, dying. 	 3. Rule, precept, prescribed mode. 	 4. Part, place, site. 	 5. Width, breadth.  E. परि about, or end, term, &c. सर going, from सृ to go, aff. अप्.
परिसर्प: परिसर्प m. (-र्पः) 	 1. Encompassing, surrounding. 	 2. Going, proceeding. 3. following, pursuing.  E. परि around, and सर्प going.
परिसर्पण: परिसर्पण n. (-णं) 	 1. Creeping about. 	 2. Running to and fro. 	 3. Cons-tantly moving.
परिसाधन: परिसाधन n. (-नं) 	 1. Accomplishing, effecting. 	 2. Determining, ascer-taining.  E. परि before, साध् to accomplish, aff. ल्युट्.
परिसार: परिसार m. (-रः) Wandering about.  E. परि before, सृ to go, aff. अण्.
परिसारिन्: परिसारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Wandering.  E. परि before, सृ to go, धिणुन् aff.
परिसीमन्: परिसीमन् m. (-मा) Boundary, extreme term or limit.  E. परि and सीमन् a limit.
परिसेधत्: परिसेधत् mfn. (-धन्-धन्ती-धत्) Opposing.  E. परि against, षिध् to effect, शतृ aff.

पह्लिक: पह्लिक m. plu. (-कः) Name of a people, (perhaps the Persians.)
पांक्त: पांक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Linear, in or by line, or row.  E. पंक्ति a line, aff. अण्.
पांश: पांश(स)न mfn. (-नः-ना-नी-नं) 	 1. Vitiating, spoiling. 	 2. Wicked. 	 f. (ना or नी; generally used at the end of a compound.) 	 1. Disgraceful, dishonouring, as in कुलपांशन.
पांश(स)व mf. (-वः-वी) 	 1. Rock or fossile salt. 	 2. Consisting of dust. E. पांशु dust, and अण् aff.
पांशु: पांशु(सु) m. (-शुः or सुः) 	 1. Dust. 	 2. Manure. 	 3. Landed property. 	 4. A kind of camphor.  E. पशि to bind, Unādi aff. कु; also पांसु.
पांशु(सु)चत्वर m. (-रः) Hail.  E. पांशु dust, चत्वर a level space.
पांशु(सु)ज n. (-जं) Salt extracted from soil, rock or fossile salt.  E. पांशु dust, ज born.
पांशुका: पांशुका f. (-का) 	 1. A menstruous woman. 	 2. A fragrant plant, (Panda-nus odoratissimus.)
पांशुकासीस: पांशुकासीस n. (-सं) Sulphate of iron.  E. पाशु dust, and कासीस the same.
पांशुकुली: पांशुकुली f. (-ली) A principal road,  E. पांशु dust, कुल a heap.
पांशुकूल: पांशुकूल n. (-लं) 	 1. A dust-heap. 	 2. A black lease, a title deed, one not made out in any person's name.  E. पांशु landed property, कूल a mound, (as it were.)
पांशुचन्दन: पांशुचन्दन m. (-नः) A name of ŚIVA.  E. पांशु dust, चन्दन Sandal.
पांशुचामर: पांशुचामर m. (-रः) 	 1. A tent. 	 2. A bank overgrown with Durbā grass. 3. A Praise. 	 4. A heap of dust. 	 5. A small cucumber.  E. पांशु dust, चामर a chowri.
पांशुपत्र: पांशुपत्र n. (-त्रं) A potherb, (Chenopodium.)  E. पांशु dust, and पत्र leaf.
पांशुमर्दन: पांशुमर्द्दन m. (-नः) A channel or basin for water, near or about the root of a tree.  E. पांशु dust, and मर्द्दन destroying. “केदारक्षेत्रेच” ।
पांशुमर्द्दन: पांशुमर्द्दन m. (-नः) A channel or basin for water, near or about the root of a tree.  E. पांशु dust, and मर्द्दन destroying. “केदारक्षेत्रेच” ।
पांशुव: पांशुव m. (-वः) A cripple: see पीठसर्पिन्.
पांशुर: पांशुर m. (-रः) 	 1. A gadfly. 	 2. A cripple carried or moving about in a chair.  E. पांशु dust, and रा to get, क or ड aff. (डांश)
पांशुल: पांशुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Dusty, covered or spotted with dust. 	 2. Sullied, defiled. 	 3. Disgracing. 	 m. (-लः) 	 1. A name of ŚIVA. 2. One of SĪVA'S weapons; a sort of pole armed at the upper end with transverse pieces, representing the breastbone and ribs adjoining, and surmounted by a skull; also खट्वाङ्ग. 	 3. A paramour, a gallant. 	 4. A kind of tree, (Cæsalpinia bonducella.) f. (-ला) 	 1. An unchaste woman. 	 2. A woman during mens-truation. 	 3. The earth.  E. पांशु dust, लच् aff.
पांशुवर्ष: पांशुवर्ष m. (-र्षः) A shower or fall of dust.  E. पांशु, and वर्ष rain.
पांसक: पांसक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Contemptible, vile. 	 2. Vitiating, spoiling. E. पसि to destroy, ण्वुल् aff.
पांसन: पांसन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Contemptible, wicked, bad, infamous. 	 2. Vitiating, spoiling, destructive.  E. पसि to destroy, &c. aff. ल्युट्.
पांसु: पांसु m. (-सुः) 	 1. Dust. 	 2. Manure. 	 3. A kind of camphor.  E. पसि to bind, &c., aff. कु, also पांशु.
पा: पा r. 1st. cl. (पिवति) To drink. r. 2nd. cl. (पाति) To cherish, to nourish, to protect or preserve. पाने, भ्वा-पर-सक-अनिट् । रक्षणे, अदा-पर-सक-सेट् ।
पा mfn. (पाः-पाः-पं) 	 1. Who drinks. 	 2. Who protects or cherishes. 	 3. To feast on, (with the eyes or ears.) 	 4. To absorb, to swallow up, to destroy.  E. पा to drink, &c. क्विप् aff.
पाक: पाक m. (-कः) 	 1. Maturity, natural or artificial, as the state of being cooked or ripened. 	 2. Cooking, baking, boiling, dressing food. 	 3. A vessel in which any thing is dressed, a saucepan, a boiler, &c. 	 4. Digestion, assimilation of food. 	 5. Suppuration, ripeness of a boil. 	 6. Greyness of the hair. 	 7. General panic, or the sub-version of a country. 	 8. Fear. 	 9. An owl. 	 10. The name of a demon. 	 11. Completion. 	 12. The consequence of an act done. 13. Domestic fire. 	 14. Grain, corn. 	 15. Fruit, fruition. 	 mf. (-कः-का) The young of animals.  E. पच् to be or become ripe, aff. भावे-घञ्; or पा to nourish, Unādi aff. कन्.
पाककृष्ण: पाककृष्ण m. (-ष्णः) The Caronda tree, (Carissa carondas.)  E. पाक ripen-ing, कृष्ण black; bearing a black fruit when ripe; also other similar compounds, पाककृष्णफल, कृष्णपाक, &c. “पानाम्ला” ।
पाकज: पाकज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced by cooking, maturing, &c. 	 n. (-जं) 1. Black-salt. 	 2. Flatulence.  E. पाक, and ज born.
पाकपात्र: पाकपात्र n. (-त्रं) A cooking utensil, a boiler, &c.  E. पाक, and पात्र a vessel.
पाकपुटी: पाकपुटी f. (-टी) A potter's kiln.  E. पाक backing, पुट् to heap, affs. क and ङीप्.
पाकफल: पाकफल m. (-लः) The Caronda.  E. पाक ripe, फल fruit, (black under-stood;) see पाककृष्णफल; also पाकफलकृष्ण, फलपाक, &c.
पाकभाण्ड: पाकभाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A culinary utensil.  E. पाक, and भाण्ड a vessel.
पाकमत्स्य: पाकमत्स्य m. (-त्स्यः) Fish sauce.  E. पाक cooking, मत्स्य fish.
पाकयज्ञ: पाकयज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) An oblation offered on building a house, liberating a bull, &c. or a religious rite of four kinds, oblation to the VISWADEVAS, offerings to the spirits, the permanent obsequial rites, and hospitality.  E. पाक, and यज्ञ sacrifice; the distribu-tion of food being a part of each of these ceremonies.
पाकयज्ञिक: पाकयज्ञिक m. (-कः) The performer of the ceremony called Pāk-yajna, E. पाकयज्ञ, aff. ठञ्.
पाकरञ्जन: पाकरञ्जन n. (-नं) The leaf of the Laurus cassia.  E. पाक cooking, रञ्ज् to colour, aff. णिच्-ल्यु “तेजपत्रे” ।
पाकल: पाकल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Producing maturity. 	 2. Suppurative, pro-ducing suppuration in a boil. 	 n. (-लं) A sort of Costus, (C. spe-ciosus.) 	 m. (-लः) 	 1. Fine. 	 2. Wind. 	 3. Fever in an elephant. f. (-ली) A sort of cucumber, (C. utilatissimus.)  E. पाक ripeness, ला to get, aff. ड.
पाकलि: पाकलि m. (-लिः) A sort of plant, (Bauhinia candida.) रोहिणीवृक्षे ।
पाकशाला: पाकशाला f. (-ला) A kitchen.  E. पाक cooking, शाला a hall.
पाकशासन: पाकशासन m. (-नः) INDRA.  E. पाक a demon, शासन ruling, overcoming.
पाकशासनि: पाकशासनि m. (-निः) 	 1. “Jayanta” the son of INDRA. 	 2. A name of Vāli. 	 3. A name of Arjuna.  E. पाकशासन INDRA, इञ् aff. of descent.
पाकशुक्ला: पाकशुक्ला f. (-क्ला) Chalk.  E. पाक cooking, burning, शुक्ल white.
पाकस्थान: पाकस्थान n. (-नं) A kitchen.  E. पाक cooking, स्थान a place.
पाकिम: पाकिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Cooked, dressed, ripened, naturally or artificially.  E. पाक cooking, इमनिच् aff.
पाकुक: पाकुक m. (-कः) A cook.  E. पच् to cook, Unādi aff. उकञ्, चस्य कश्च ।
पाक्य: पाक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) What may or is to be cooked, matured, &c. n. (क्यं) Bit-Labana, a medicinal salt, impregnated with iron. 	 m. (-क्यः) Nitre, salt-petre.  E. पच् to cook, aff. कर्मणि ण्यत्.
पाक्ष: पाक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) 	 1. Belonging to a half month. 	 2. Relating to a side or party, &c.  E. पक्ष, and अण् aff.
पाक्षायण: पाक्षायण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Belonging to or occurring in a Pakhsa or fortnight, &c.  E. पक्ष half month, &c. and फक् aff.
पाक्षिक: पाक्षिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Belonging to a bird, to a fortnight, to an argument, &c. 	 2. Favouring a party or faction. 	 3. Optional, allowed but not prescribed. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A fowler, a bird-catcher. 	 2. An alternative.  E. पक्ष a fortnight, or पक्षिन् a bird, aff. ठञ्.
पाखण्ड: पाखण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A heretic, a heterodox Hindu, adopting the exterior marks of the classes, but not respecting the ordinances of the Vedas.  E. पा for पाल what nourishes, (mankind, as virtue may be said to do,) and खडि to subvert or destroy, aff. अण्; also पाषण्ड.
पाङ्क्त्य: पांक्त्य m. (-क्त्यः) A Brāhman who is or may be worthy to eat in a res-pectable society at sacrifices, &c.  E. पंक्ति an assembly, and अञ् aff.
पांक्त्य: पांक्त्य m. (-क्त्यः) A Brāhman who is or may be worthy to eat in a res-pectable society at sacrifices, &c.  E. पंक्ति an assembly, and अञ् aff.
पाचक: पाचक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. What produces maturity. 	 2. What cooks or dresses. 	 3. Digestive, tonic, what effects digestion. 	 n. (-कं) The bile which assists in digestion. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. Fire. 	 2. A cook.  E. पच् to ripen or concoct, ण्वुल् aff.
पाचकस्त्री: पाचकस्त्री f. (-स्त्री) A she-cook.  E. पाचक cooking, स्त्री a woman.
पाचन: पाचन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) 	 1. What cooks or ripens, &c. 	 2. Disgestive. Suppurative. 	 n. (-नं) 	 1. A medicinal preparation, an infu-sion, a decoction, &c. of various drugs, chiefly carminatives or gentle stimuli given to bring the vitiated humours in fever, &c. to maturity, a sort of diet drink. 	 2. Penance, expiation. 3. The act of cooking, or ripening. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. Fire. 	 2. Acidity, sourness. 	 f. (-नी) 	 1. A sort of myrobalan, (Terminalia, chebula.) 2. Cooking, ripening,  E. पच् to dress, in the causal form, aff. ल्युट् ।
पाचनक: पाचनक m. (-कः) 	 1. Borax. 	 n. (-कं) A sort of diet drink: see the last. E. पच् to mature, (metals,) in the causal form, ल्युट् aff., and कन् added. “सोहागा” ।
पाचल: पाचल n. (-लं) Cooking, maturing. 	 m. (-लः) 	 1. Fire. 	 2. Wind. 	 3. A thing dressed or matured without the aid of fire. 	 4. What-ever ripens, cooks, causes digestion, &c.  E. पच् in the causal form, णिच्वा-कलन् aff.
पाचा: पाचा f. (-चा) Cooking, maturing.  E. पच् to cook, causal v. अङ् and टाप् affs.
पाचि: पाचि f. (-चिः) Cooking, maturing.  E. पच् to cook, इञ् aff.
पाचिका: पाचिका f. (-का) Cooking, maturing.  E. पच् to cook, ण्वुल् aff.
पाजस्: पाजस् n. (-जः) Strength, power.  E. पा to nourish, असुन् Unādi aff., and जुट् augment.
पाञ्चकपाल: पाञ्चकपाल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Relating to or part of that oblation which is offered in five cups.  E. पञ्चकपाल, q. v. अण् aff.
पाञ्चजन्य: पाञ्चजन्य m. (-न्यः) 	 1. KRISHṆA'S conch. 	 2. A name of fire. 	 3. Any shell. 	 4. A sort of fish, commonly Garāi.  E. पञ्चजन a demon, from whose bones the shell was made, यत् aff.
पाञ्चजन्यधर: पाञ्चजन्यधर m. (-रः) A name of KRISHṆA.  E. पञ्चजन्य the conch, and धर who has.
पाञ्चयाज्ञिक: पाञ्चयाज्ञिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or belonging to, or included in the five great ceremonies. 	 n. (-कं) Either of the five great sacra-ments.  E. पञ्चयज्ञ, and ठञ् aff.
पाञ्चभौतिक: पाञ्चभौतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Consisting or made of the five elements. E. पञ्चभूत, and ठञ् aff.
पाञ्चलिका: पाञ्चलिका f. (-का) A doll, a puppet: see पाञ्चालिका ।
पाञ्चशब्दिक: पाञ्चशब्दिक n. (-कं) Musical instruments in general, or of five sorts. E. पञ्च, शव्द sound, and ठञ् aff.
पाञ्चार्थिक: पाञ्चार्थिक m. (-कः) A follower or votary of ŚIVA.
पाञ्चाल: पाञ्चाल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Belonging to, dwelling in, ruling over, &c. the country of Panchāla. 	 m. (-लः) 	 1. The sovereign of Panchāla. plu. The people of that country. 	 2. The company or association of five trades, the carpenter, weaver, barber, washerman, and shoemaker.  E. पञ्चाल the country so called, and स्वार्थे अण् aff. &c.
पाञ्चालिका: पाञ्चालिका f. (-का) A doll, a puppet: see पाञ्चाली ।
पाञ्चाली: पाञ्चाली f. (-ली) 	 1. A name of DRAUPADĪ, the wife of the five Pāṇḍu princes. 	 2. A woman of the Panchālas. 	 3. A puppet, a doll. 4. Melodious combination of five or six words, (In rhetoric). E. पाञ्चाल the country so called, अण्, aff. of descent or reference, and fem. aff. ङीप्; coming from that region; also with कन् added पाञ्चालिका, and by making the second vowel short पाञ्चलिका ।
पाट्: पाट् ind. A vocative particle or interjection used in calling.  E. पट् to go, in the causal form, aff. णिच् क्विप् ।
पाट: पाट m. (-टः) Breadth, expanse, extension. 	 f. (-टा) Regular or successive order, series, succession.  E. पट् to spread, aff. घञ् ।
पाटक: पाटक m. (-कः) 	 1. The half of a village. 	 2. A shore, a bank, a flight of steps leading to water. 	 3. Casting dice. 	 4. A musical instru-ment. 	 5. A large span. 	 6. Expense or loss of capital or stock. 7. A splitter, a divider.  E. पट् to go, ल्युल् aff.
पाटच्चर: पाटच्चर m. (-रः) A thief.  E. पटच्चर the same, and अण् pleonastic aff.
पाटन: पाटन n. (-नं) Cutting, breaking.  E. पट् to go, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
पाटल: पाटल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Of a pink or pale-red colour. 	 m. (-लः) 	 1. Pale-red, rose colour. 	 2. Rice ripening in the rains. 	 f. (-ला) 	 1. The Trumpet-flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) 	 2. Red Lodh. 	 3. A name of DURGĀ. 	 4. Pale-red. 	 nf. (-लं-ला) 	 1. The flower of the Bignonia snave-olens. 	 2. Rice. 	 3. Saffron.  E. पाट extension, and ला to get, aff. ड; also पाटलि; or पट-णिच्-कलच् ।
पाटलि: पाटलि mf. (-लिः) Trumpet-flower. 	 m. (-लिः) Rice ripening in the rains. E. पाटल pale-red, aff. इन्. पट-णिच्-अलि “पारुल पुष्पे”
पाटलित: पाटलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made red, tinted red, reddened.  E. पाटल, and इतच् aff.
पाटलिपुत्र: पाटलिपुत्र n. (-त्रं) The name of an ancient city, supposed to be the an-cient Palibothra, and the modern Pātnā; It was the capital of Magadha, situated near the confluence of the Sona and the ganges, and is also known by the name of Pushpapura in Sans-krit literature.  E. पाटलि the trumpet flower, पू to be pure, त्रन् aff.; also with कन् added, पाटलिपुत्रक; it is also said to be named after its founder and sovereign, पाटलिपुत्र being a proper name.
पाटलोपल: पाटलोपल n. (-लं) A ruby.  E. पाटल, and उपल, a stone.
पाटव: पाटव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Clever, sharp, dexterous. 	 n. (-वं) 	 1. Cleverness, talent. 	 2. Health. 	 3. Eloquence.  E. पटु clever, &c. aff. अण्.
पाटविक: पाटविक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Cunning, crafty, fraudulent. 	 2. Clever, dexterous.  E. पटु clever, ठक् aff.
पाटहिका: पाटहिका f. (-का) A small shrub, (Abrus, precatorius.) see गुञ्जा.
पाटित: पाटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Torn, broken, divided. 	 2. Pierced.  E. पट् to divide, in the causal form, aff. क्त.
पाटिन्: पाटिन् m. (-टी) A sort of fish described as having many teeth.
पाटी: पाटी f. (-टीः) 	 1. Arithmetic. 	 2. A kind of shrub called Bālā. 	 3. Regular order.  E. पट to go, इन् or ङीप् aff.
पाटीर: पाटीर m. (-रः) A field. 	 2. A pungent root, a sort of radish. 	 3. The pith or manna of the bamboo. 	 4. A cloud. 	 5. A sieve, a cribble. 6. Tin. 	 7. Disease arising from wind. 	 8. Sandal.  E. पट् to go, &c. in the causal form, ईरन् aff.; or पटीर + स्वार्थे अण् ।
पाटूपट: पाटूपट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Going, who or what goes.  E. पट् to go, अच् aff. and the root repeated, form irr.
पाठ: पाठ m. (-ठः) 	 1. Studying the Vedas scriptures, considered as one of the five great sacraments of the Hindus. 	 2. Reading, perusal or study in general. 	 f. (-ठा) A plant, commonly Akanādi.  E. पठ् to read, aff. भावे घञ्.
पाठक: पाठक m. (-कः) 	 1. A lecturer, a public reader of the Puraṇās or other sacred works, or a Paṇḍit who declares what is the law or custom according to the scriptures. 	 2. A spiritual preceptor. 3. A reader, a student.  E. पठ् to read, ण्वुल् aff., or पठ, causal v. वुन् aff.
पाठन: पाठन n. (-नं) Lecturing, teaching.  E. पठ् to read, causal v. भावे ल्युट् aff.
पाठभू: पाठभू f. (-भूः) A place where the Vedas are read or studied.  E. पाठ reading, (the Vedas,) and भू place.
पाठमञ्जरी: पाठमञ्जरी f. (-री) A small bird, commonly Sāri, (Gracula religiosa.)
पाठशाला: पाठशाला f. (-ला) A college, a school.  E. पाठ study, शाला a hall.
पाठशालिनी: पाठशालिनी f. (-नी) A small bird: see पाठमञ्जरी. पाठेन शलते, शल-णिनि-ङीप्.
पाठान: पाठान m. (-नः) 	 1. Bdellium. 	 2. kind of fish.
पाठित: पाठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Instructed, taught, lectured.  E. पठ् to read. causal v., क्त aff.
पाठिन्: पाठिन् m. (-ठी) 	 1. A plant. (Plumbago zeylanica.) 	 2. A Brāhman, especially one who has finished his sacred studies.  E. पाठ perusal, and इनि aff.; the virtues of the plant are to be read of in medical works.
पाठीन: पाठीन m. (-नः) A sort of fish, (Silurus boalis, Ham.) 	 2. A public reader or lecturer on the Purāṇās, &c. 	 3. A tree: see गुग्गुल. E. पाठी a Brāhman, and ईन् added. “वोयाल” ।
पाठ्य: पाठ्य mfn. (-ठ्यः-ठ्या-ठ्यं) To be read or studied.  E. पठ् to read, ण्यत् aff.; also पठनीय, &c.
पाडिनी: पाडिनी f. (-नी) An earthen pot or boiler.
पाण: पाण m. (-णः) 	 1. Trade, traffic. 	 2. A trader. 	 3. An agreement. 	 4. Praise. 	 5. The hand.  E. पण् to be of price, &c. भावे घञ् aff.
पाणि: पाणि m. (-णिः) The hand. 	 f. (-णिः) A place of sale, a shop, a market. E. पण् to be of price, &c. Unādi aff. इण्.
पाणिका: पाणिका f. (-का) A sort of spoon or ladle.  E. पाणि the hand, कन् aff.
पाणिगृहीती: पाणिगृहीती f. (-ती) A bride, one wedded according to the ritual. E. पाणि the hand, and गृहीत taken: see the next: when the com-pound means merely taken by the hand, the form is पाणिगृहीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं).
पाणिग्रहण: पाणिग्रहण n. (णं) 	 1. Marriage. 	 2. Laying hold of the hand.  E. पाणि the hand, and ग्रहण taking, the junction of the hands of the bride and bridegroom, forming a part of this ceremony.
पाणिग्रहणिक: पाणिग्रहणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Matrimonial.  E. पाणिग्रहण, and ठक् aff.
पाणिग्राह: पाणिग्राह m. (-हः) 	 1. Laying hold of the hand. 	 2. Marriage.  E. पाणि, and ग्राह taking.
पाणिघ: पाणिघ m. (-घः) 	 1. A drummer, one who plays on a tabor, &c, with his hands. 	 2. Playing upon a hand instrument. 	 3. A workman, a handicraftsman.  E. पाणि the hand, हन् to strike, ठक् aff. and घ substituted for the root.
पाणिघात: पाणिघात m. (-तः) 	 1. Striking with the hands, boxing. 	 2. A boxer, or one who strikes with his hand.  E. पाणि the hand, and घात blow.
पाणिचापल्य: पाणिचापल्य n. (-ल्यं) Fighting with the hand, snapping the fingers, &c.  E. पाणि the hand, चापल्य unsteadiness.
पाणिज: पाणिज m. (-जः) A finger-nail.  E. पाणि the hand, जन् to be born, aff. ड.
पाणितल: पाणितल n. (-लं) 	 1. The palm of the hand. 	 2. A measure of two Tolās. E. पाणि, and तल below.
पाणिन: पाणिन m. (-नः) A name of Pāṇini: see the next.
पाणिनि: पाणिनि m. (-निः) Pāṇini, a Muni and inspired grammarian.  E. पाणिन् a proper name and इञ् aff. of descent.
पाणिनीय: पाणिनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Connected with or derived from Pāṇini, the grammarian, (as a scholar, a rule, &c.)  E. पाणिनि the saint, and छ aff.
पाणिधम: पाणिधम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 	 1. Who blows through the hands. 	 2. Obscure. dark, (as a path, where a noise is made with the hands, to frighten away snakes, &c.)  E. पाणि the hand, ध्मा to blow or breathe, aff. स्वञ्.
पाणिन्धय: पाणिन्धय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Who or what drinks from the hand.  E. पाणि, and धे to drink, खश् aff.
पाणिपाद: पाणिपाद n. (-दं) The hands and feet  E. पाणि the hand, and पाद the foot.
पाणिपीडन: पाणिपीडन n. (-नं) Marriage.  E. पाणि the hand, पीडन paining, taking: see पाणिग्रहण.
पाणिभुज्: पाणिभुज् m. (-भुक्) The glomerous fig tree, (F. glomerata.)  E. पाणि the hand, and भुज् what eats.
पाणिप्तत्: पाणिप्तत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Possessed of hands.  E. पाणि, and मतुप् aff.
पाणिमुक्त: पाणिमुक्त n. (-क्तं) A missile weapon, one thrown with the hand, as a dart, a spear.  E. पाणि the hand, and मुक्त loosed.
पाणिरुह्: पाणिरुह् m. (-रुट्) A finger-nail.  E. पाणि, and रुह् to grow, क्विप् aff.
पाणिवाद: पाणिवाद m. (-दः) 	 1. A drummer, playing on a drum or tabor with the hand. 	 2. Clapping the hands together.  E. पाणि the hand, and वाद who sounds; also with कन् added पाणिवादक.
पाणिसर्ग्या: पाणिसर्ग्या f. (-र्ग्या) A rope, a cord.  E. पाणि, the hand, सृज् to go, aff. कर्मणि-ण्यत्.
पाणिस्थ: पाणिस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Held in the hand.  E. पाणि, and स्थ what stays.
पाणिहोम: पाणिहोम m. (-मः) Offerings made to Brāhmans where consecrated fire is not used.  E. पाणि, and होम burnt offering.
पाणीतल: पाणीतल n. (-लं) A measure of two Tolās.
पाणौकरण: पाणौकरण n. (-णं) Marriage.  E. पाणौ with the hand, and करण making.
पाण्डर: पाण्डर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Pale or yellowish white. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. Pale or yellowish white, (the colour.) 	 2. A plant, commonly Marūa or Marūvaka. 	 n. (-रं) 	 1. Many-flowered jasmine. 	 2. Red chalk. E. पडि to go, अर् Unādi aff., and the radical vowel made long; also पाण्डुर.
पाण्डरपुष्पिका: पाण्डरपुष्पिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly Sitalā, (perhaps phrynium dichotomum:) see शीतला.  E. पाण्डर pale white, पुष्पी flower, aff. कप्.
पाण्डव: पाण्डव m. (-वः) A Pāṇḍava or descendant of PĀṆḌU; especially ap-plied to YUDHISṬHIRA and his four brothers.  E. पाण्डु a proper name, and patronymic aff. ओरञ् ।
पाण्डवाभील: पाण्डवाभील m. (-लः) A name of KRISHṆA.  E. पाण्डव a Pāṇḍava, and अभी courage, (not fear,) ल who gives.
पाण्डवायन: पाण्डवायन m. (-नः) A name of KRISHṆA.  E. पाण्डव a Pāṇḍava, and अयन going, accompanying; being the friend and ally of the Pāṇḍu princes.
पाण्डवेय: पाण्डवेय m. (-यः) A descendant of Pāṇḍu  E. पाण्ड, and ढक् aff.
पाण्डित्य: पाण्डित्य nf. (-थं-ती) Scholarship, learning. 	 2. Dexterity, cleverness. E. पण्डित a teacher, aff. ष्यञ् the semivowel rejected before the feminine aff.
पाण्डु: पाण्डु mfn. (-ण्डुः-ण्डुः-ण्डु) Pale of yellowish white. 	 m. (-ण्डुः) 	 1. Pale or yellowish white, (the colour.) 	 2. the name of a sovereign of ancient Delhi, and nominal father of YUDHISHṬHIRA and he other four Pāṇḍava princes; he was a son of Vyāsa by the wife of Bichitrabirya. 	 3. The jaundice. 	 4. A white elephant. f. (-ण्डुः) A plant, commonly Māshaparni, (Glycine debilis.) E. पडि to go, aff. कु, and the penultimate vowel made long.
पाण्डक: पाण्डक m. (-कः) 	 1. The jaundice. 	 2. A name of Pāṇḍu. 	 3. Pale or yellowish white, (the colour.)  E. कन् added to the preceding.
पाण्डुकम्बल: पाण्डुकम्बल m. (-लः) 	 1. A sort of blanket or warm upper garment. 2. A kind of stone, (Limestone or marble). 	 3. The housings of a royal elephant.  E. पाण्डु pale, and कम्बल blanket.
पाण्डुकम्बलिन्: पाण्डुकम्बलिन् m. (-ली) 	 1. A carriage covered with a sort of blanket. 2. The housings of a royal elephant.  E. पाण्डुकम्बल a blanket, and इनि aff.
पाण्डुनाग: पाण्डुनाग m. (-गः) A plant, (Rottleria tinctoria.) 	 2. A white elephant. 3. A white species of serpent.  E. पाण्डु pale, नाग a plant, a snake, or elephant.
पाण्डुपुत्र: पाण्डुपुत्र m. (-त्त्रः) Either of the Pāṇḍava princes.  E. पाण्डु, and पुत्त्र son; also similar compounds, as पाण्डुनन्दन, &c.
पाण्डुपृष्ठ: पाण्डुपृष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Having unlucky marks on the back &c. E. पाण्डु pale, &c. and पृष्ठ back.
पाण्डुभूम: पाण्डुभूम m. (-मः) A country with a light-coloured soil.  E. पाण्डु pale, and भूमि earth, aff. अच्.
पाण्डुमृत्: पाण्डुमृत् f. (-मृत्) 	 1. A country in which the soil is of a whitish colour. 	 2. Chalk.  E. पाण्डु pale, and मृत् earth.
पाण्डुमृत्तिका: पाण्डुमृत्तिका f. (-का) 	 1. The opal. 	 2. A pale soil.  E. पाण्डु pale, and मृत्तिका earth.
पाण्डुर: पाण्डुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Of a yellowish white colour. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A pale or yellowish white. 	 2. The jaundice. 	 3. A tree: see मरुवक. 	 n. (-रं) The white leprosy, vitiligo.  E. पाण्डु pale, and र added.
पाण्डुरपृष्ठ: पाण्डुरपृष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं) Having unlucky marks on the back, &c. E. पाण्डुर pale, and पृष्ठ the back.
पाण्डुराग: पाण्डुराग m. (-गः) Whiteness, pallor.  E. पाण्डु, and राग colour.
पाण्डुलेख: पाण्डुलेख m. (-खः) A sketch made with chalk, a draft.
पाण्डुलोमा: पाण्डुलोमा f. (-मा) 	 1. A plant, (Glycine debilis.) 	 2. Having white hair on the body, &c.  E. पाण्डु pale, लोमन् hair or fibres: see पाण्डु. “माषपर्ण्याम्” ।
पाण्डुवर्ण: पाण्डुवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-णं) White. 	 m. (-र्णः) Whiteness.  E. पाण्डु, and वर्ण colour.
पाण्डुशर्क्क: पाण्डुशर्क्क(र्क)रा f. (-रा) Light-coloured gravel, (disease.)  E. पाण्डु, and शर्क्करा sugar. सितानामक प्रमेह रोगे ।
पण्डुशर्म्मिला: पण्डुशर्म्मिला f. (-ला) A name of DRAUPADI.  E. पाण्डु a Pāṇḍu prince, शर्म्म fortune, aff. इलच्.
पाण्डुसोपाक: पाण्डुसोपाक m. (-कः) The offspring of a Chandāla by a Vaidehī woman, a maker of mats, baskets, &c. a worker with bamboos, and reeds.
पाण्ड्य: पाण्ड्य m. (-ण्ड्य) plu. 	 1. Name of a country and its inhabitants. 	 2. Sing. A king of that country.
पाण्य: पाण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) Excellent, praise-worthy.  E. पण् to praise, aff. ण्यत्.
पाण्यास्य: पाण्यास्य m. (स्यः) A Brāhman who reads the Vedas upon receiving a gift at a Shrāddha.  E. पाणि, and आस्य face or mouth, having his mouth in his hand.
पात्: पात् m. (-पात्) 	 1. Falling. 	 2. Sin, wickedness.  E. पत् to fall, aff. क्किप, and the radical vowel made long.
पात् mfn. (-पान्-पान्ती-पात्) Who or what defends or preserves, a guardian, a protector, &c.  E. पा to preserve, aff. शतृ.
पात: पात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Preserved, protected.  E. पा to preserve, aff. क्त. m. (-तः) 	 1. Falling, alighting, descending. 	 2. A name of Rāhu. 3. The node of a planet's orbit. 	 4. Flying, flight. 	 5. A stroke, as in खङ्गपात । 6. Shedding, emitting, discharging. 	 7. An attack, an inroad. 	 8. Happening. 	 9. Failing, defect. 	 10. Destruction, dissolution.  E. पत् to fall, aff. घञ्.
पातक: पातक n. (-कं) 	 1. Sin, crime. 	 2. The cause of falling, literally or figuratively. For particulars see पञ्चपातक.  E. पत् to fall or des-cend, (from virtue,) causal form, aff. ण्वुल्.
पातकयोग: पातकयोग m. (-गः) Incurring guilt, acting sinfully.  E. पातक, and योग accession.
पातकिन्: पातकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) Wicked, sinful, a sinner.  E. पातक, and इनि aff.
पातङ्कि: पातङ्कि m. (-ङ्किः) 	 1. Saturn. 	 2. Yama. 	 3. Karṇa. 	 4. Sugrīva.  E. पतङ्ग the sun, इञ् aff. of descent.
पातञ्जल: पातञ्जल f. (-ली) Composed by Patanjali “पातञ्जले महाभाष्ये कृत भूरि परिश्रमः” Nagogibhatta. 	 n. (लं) The Yoga system of philosophy. (It is an open question whether the author of the Mahā-bhāsya was identical with this Patanjali.)  E. पतञ्जलि the sage by whom it was first taught, अण् aff.
पातन: पातन n. (-नं) Bringing down, causing to fall. 	 2. Lowering, humbling, 3. Felling, knocking down. 	 4. Nodding, (as in sleep.) 	 5. Causing an abortion, as गर्भस्य पातनम्. 	 6. Beating, as in दण्डस्य पातनम् &c. E. पत् to fall in the causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
पातव्य: पातव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 	 1. To be drunk. 	 2. To be preserved or protected.  E. पा to drink, to preserve, तव्य aff.
पाताल: पाताल n. (-लं) The regions under the earth, and the abode of the Nāgas or serpents. 	 2. A hole, a chasm. 	 3. Submarine fire. 	 4. The fourth sign from that in which the sun is present. 	 m. (-लः) A sort of apparatus for calcining and subliming metals, formed of two earthen pots, the upper one inverted over the lower, and the two joined together by their necks with cement, and placed in a hole containing fire.  E. पत् to alight, Unādi aff. आलञ्.
पातालगङ्गा: पातालगङ्गा f. (-ङ्गाः) The ganges of the lower world.
पातालनिलय: पातालनिलय m. (-यः) 	 1. A demon, a Daitya. 	 2. A Nāga or infernal serpent.  E. पाताल hell, and निलय abode.
पातालौकस्: पातालौकस् m. (-काः) An Asur, a demon.  E. पाताल hell, ओकस् a house.
पाति: पाति m. (-तिः) A master, a lord, a husband.  E. पा to nourish, Unādi aff. अति.
पातिक: पातिक m. (-कः) The Gangetic porpoise.  E. पात trembling, falling,
पातित: पातित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Felled, struck down. 	 2. Lowered, depressed, humbled.  E. पत् to fall, causal v., क्त aff.
पातित्य: पातित्य n. (-त्यं) Loss of caste or position.
पातिली: पातिली f. (-ली) 	 1. A trap or snare for catching deer. 	 2. A small earthen vessel or pot, especially used by religious mendicants. 3. A woman of a particular class.  E. पात falling, इलच् aff. fem. aff. ङीप्.
पातुक: पातुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Falling frequently or habitually, disposed to fall. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. The declivity of a mountain, a precipice. 	 2. An aquatic animal of a large size; figuratively, the water-elephant. E. पत् to fall, aff. उकञ्.
पातृ: पातृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what protects or nourishes. 	 m. (-ता) A plant, (Ocymum pilosum.)  E. पा to nourish, तृच् aff.
पात्य: पात्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) To be fallen, to be alighted.  E. पत् to fall, ण्यत् aff.
पात्र: पात्र n. (-त्रं) A preservative from sin, a preserver, a saviour.  E. पात्, and त्र who or what saves.

पात्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) A vessel in general, a plate, a cup, a jar, &c. 	 n. (-त्रं) 	 1. A sacrificial vase or vessel, comprising various forms of cups, plates, spoons, ladles, &c. so used. 	 2. The channel of a river, or its course between the near and opposite bank. 	 3. A king's counsellor or minister. 	 4. Propriety, fitness. 	 5. A leaf. 	 6. The persons of a drama. 	 7. An order, a command. 	 8. The body. 9. A fit or competent person. 	 10. A measure of one Ārhaka or of eight Seers. 	 11. A receptacle of any kind, what holds or supports. 	 f. (-त्री) A small or portable furnace.  E. पा to pro-serve or retain, aff. त्रन्.
पात्रता: पात्रता f. (-ता) The quality or property of a preservative from sin. E. पात, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, पातत्वं.

पात्रता f. (-ता) 	 1. Capacity, fitness. 	 2. Appropriate state or circums-tance. 	 3. The property or capacity of a cup or vessel. 	 4. Dignity, honor.  E. पात्र capable, and तल् aff. of the abstract, quality; also with त्व aff., पात्रत्वं.
पात्रट: पात्रट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Spare, emaciate, thin. 	 m. (-टः) Ragged gar-ments.  E. पातेव पिवन्निव अटति, अट्-अच् ।
पात्रटीर: पात्रटीर m. (-रः) 	 1. An able or competent minister. 	 2. A vessel of metal, as silver, brass, &c. 	 3. Rust of iron. 	 4. Fire. 	 5. A heron. 6. A crow.  E. पात्र a vessel, &c. and टीर aff.
पात्रपाल: पात्रपाल m. (-लः) A large oar used as a rudder. 	 2. The rod of a balance.  E. पात्र a vessel, (a boat,) and पाल what cherishes, affix. अण्.
पात्रभूत: पात्रभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) The object of a present or of respectful treat-ment.  E. पात्र fit, and भूत become.
पात्रभृत्: पात्रभृत् m. (-भृत्) A servant.  E. पात्र, and भृत् who takes care of.
पात्रसंस्कार: पात्रसंस्कार m. (-रः) 	 1. The current of a river. 	 2. Cleaning a vessel that has been used.  E. पात्र the channel, and संस्कार completion.
पात्रिक: पात्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Measured by a vessel, or the measure Pātra, sown with it, preparing it, &c. 	 2. Fit, adequate, appro-priate. 	 n. (-कं) A vessel, a cup, a dish.  E. पात्र, and ष्ठन् aff.; also with घ aff. पात्रिय, and with यत्, पात्र्या, &c.
पात्रिन्: पात्रिन् mfn. (-त्री-त्रिणी-त्रि) 	 1. Having a vessel. 	 2. Having fit or worthy persons.  E. पात्र, and इनि aff.
पात्रिय: पात्रिय f. (-या) Worthy to partake of a meal.
पात्रीण: पात्रीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Measured, sown, cooked, &c. by a Pātra. E. पात्र, and ख aff.
पात्रीय: पात्रीय n. (-यं) A sacrificial vessel.  E. पात्र, the same, and छ aff.
पात्रीर: पात्रीर(व) m. (-रः or -वः) An oblation.  E. पात्र, a sacrificial vessel, ईर to go, क aff.
पात्रेसमित: पात्रेसमित m. (-तः) 	 1. A parasite, a person constant at dinners, or feasts, but good for nothing else. 	 2. A connoisseur in eating. 	 3. A hypocrite.  E. पात्रे in a vessel, plate, &c and समित collected.
पात्रोपकरण: पात्रोपकरण n. (-णं) Decorations of an inferior class, as bells, chowris, &c.  E. पात्र, and उपकरण instrument.
