पापति: पापति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Who or what alights, goes or falls much or frequently.  E. पत् to alight, &c. frequent. v., किन् aff. or पत-यङ् लुक्-इन् ।
पापदर्शिन्: पापदर्शिन् mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिनी-र्शि) Malevolent, looking at faults.  E. पाप, and दर्शिन् who sees.
पापदृश्वन्: पापदृश्वन् mfn. (-श्वा-श्वा-श्व) Conscious of guilt, knowing an act to be wicked.  E. पाप, and दृश् to see, क्वनिप् aff.
पापनापित: पापनापित m. (-तः) A vile, cunning or bad barber.  E. पाप sinful, नापित a barber.
पापनाशिन्: पापनाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Purifying, sin-destroying  E. पाप, and नाशिन् destroying.
पापनिरति: पापनिरति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Wicked, villainous, a wretch. 	 f. (-तिः) Wickedness.  E. पाप, and निरति attachment.
पापपति: पापपति m. (-तिः) A paramour, a gallant.  E. पाप wicked, and पति husband.
पापपुरुष: पापपुरुष m. (-षः) A personification of all sin, or a male, whose head is Brāhmanicide, whose arms are theft, whose heart is wine drinking, &c.  E. पाप, and पुरुष a man.
पापबुद्धि: पापबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Evil-minded, wicked.  E. पाप, and बुद्धि intellect.
पापमति: पापमति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Of a corrupt mind, depraved.  E. पाप, and मति mind.
पापमुक्त: पापमुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Freed from sin, liberated from all crime. E. पाप, and मुक्त set free.
पापयोनि: पापयोनि f. (-निः) Birth in some inferior state, as an animal, &c. as the punishment of sin.  E. पाप, and योनि womb.
पापरोग: पापरोग m. (-गः) A disease, considered as the punishment of sin in former life. 	 2. Small box.  E. पाप sin, and रोग disease.
पापर्द्धि: पापर्द्धि f. (-र्द्धिः) Hunting, chase.  E. पाप sin, and ऋर्द्धि thriving.
पापल: पापल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Giving or taking sin. 	 n. (-लं) A measure. E. पाप, and लच् aff.
पापविनिग्रह: पापविनिग्रह m. (-हः) Restraining or punishing wickedness.  E. पाप, and विनिग्रह restraint.
पापशमन: पापशमन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Palliating or removing crime. 	 n. (-नं) A sin-offering.  E. पाप, and शमन appeasing.
पापसम्मित: पापसम्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Equal in sin, of like guilt.  E. पाप, and सम्मित measured.
पापात्मन्: पापात्मन् m. (-त्मा) A sinner, a reprobate, an evil-minded person, a wretch.  E. पाप, and आत्मन् soul.
पापानुवसित: पापानुवसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Addicted to sin.  E. पाप, and अनुवसित dwelling with.
पापापनुत्ति: पापापनुत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Expiation.  E. पाप, and अपनुत्ति removing.
पापाशय: पापाशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Wicked, sinful,  E. पाप, and आशय abode.
पापिन्: पापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Wicked, sinful, bad, a sinner.  E. पाप, and इनि aff.
पापिष्ठ: पापिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठ) Very wicked.  E. पाप, and इष्ठन् aff.
पापीयस्: पापीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very wicked.  E. पाप, and ईयसुन् aff.
पाप्मन्: पाप्मन् m. (-मा) Sin, wickedness.  E. पा to preserve (from it,) मनिन् Unādi aff., deriv. irr.
पामघ्न: पामघ्न m. (-घ्नः) Sulphur.  E. पामन् scab, and घ्न destroying.
पामन्: पामन् nf. (-म-मा) Cutaneous eruption, herpes, scab.  E. पै to dry, aff. मनिन्. “खोस्पाच्डा” ।
पामन: पामन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Diseased with herpes.  E. पामन् herpes, and न aff.
पामर: पामर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 	 1. Wicked, vile, low, base. 	 2. Stupid, an idiot, fool. 	 3. Poor, helpless. 	 m. (-रः) A fool.  E. पाम scab, and रा to get, क aff.
पामरोद्धारा: पामरोद्धारा f. (-रा) A plant: see गुडुची.  E. पामर here said to mean bile, उद् before, हृ to take away, affs. अण् and टाप्.
पामारि: पामारि m. (-रिः) Sulphur.  E. पामा scab, and अरि an enemy.
पाम्प: पाम्प mfn. (-म्पः-म्पी-म्पं) Belonging to the river, (Pampā.)  E. पम्पा, and अण् aff.
पाय: पाय n. (-यं) Water.  E. पा to drink, अच् aff. and युक् augment.
पायना: पायना f. (-ना) Whetting, sharpening, (as a weapon).  E. पा-णिच् भावे युच्.
पायस: पायस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Made of or from milk or water. 	 mn. (-सः-सं) 1. An oblation of milk, rice, and sugar. 	 2. Turpentine. 	 n. (-सं) Milk.  E. पयस् milk or water, aff. अण्.
पायसिक: पायसिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Fond of or relating to a mixture of milk, &c. E. पायस, and ठक् aff.
पायिक: पायिक m. (-कः) A foot-soldier, a footman.  E. पा to cherish, ण्वुल् aff., and युक् and इट् augments.
पायु: पायु m. (-युः) The anus.  E. पा to preserve, Unādi aff. उण् and युक inserted.
पाय्य: पाय्य mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं) Low, vile, reprehensible, contemptible. 	 n. (-य्यं) 1. Measure. 	 2. Water. 	 3. Drinking. 	 4. Practice, profession.  E. पा to drink, ण्यत् aff.
पार: पार r. 10th cl. (पारयति-ते) To accomplish, to finish, to get through or over. अद० चु० उभ० सक० सेट् ।

पार n. (-रं) The further or opposite bank of a river. 	 mn. (-रः-रं) The end, the extremity, the last. 	 m. (-रः) Quicksilver. 	 f. (-रा) The name of a river, said to flow from the Pariyatra mountains, or the centrical and western portion of the Vindhya chain. 	 f. (री) 1. A quantity of water. 	 2. A rope for tying an elephant's feet. 	 3. A small water jar. 	 4. The pollen of a flower. 	 5. A drinking vessel, a glass, a cup. 	 6. A milk pail,  E. पर another, ईर् to go to or towards; or पार to cross over; or प to fill aff. अच्.
पारक: पारक mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं) 	 1. What purifies, protects, cherishes, pleases, &c. 	 2. What enables one to cross, (a river or the world.) 	 3. Ser-ving, delivering.  E. पॄ to please, ण्वुल् aff.
पारक्य: पारक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) 	 1. An enemy, hostile, inimical. 	 2. Alien, belonging to another. 	 n. (-क्यं) Pious conduct, doing any thing for the sake of future happiness.  E. परक or पारक, and ष्यञ् aff.
पारग: पारग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) 	 1. Crossing, crossing over. 	 2. Going over or beyond the world. 	 3. Completely familiar or conversant with. 	 4. Profoundly learned.  E. पार the opposite bank, and ग who goes.
पारगत: पारगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Crossed. 	 2. Gone over the world, pure, holy. m. (-तः) A Jina or Jaina deified teacher.  E. पार the further bank, (of the world,) and गत attained, gone to.
पारग्रामिक: पारग्रामिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Hostile, inimical.  E. पर an enemy, ग्राम a number, ठक् aff.
पारज्: पारज् m. (-रक्) Gold.  E. प to satisfy, Unādi aff. अजि.
पारजायिक: पारजायिक m. (-कः) An adulterer.  E. पर another जाया wife, ठक् aff.
पारटीट: पारटीट(न) m. (-टः or नः) A stone, a rock.  E. पर across, and टीट aff.
पारण: पारण m. (-णः) 	 1. A cloud. 	 nf. (-णं-णा) 	 1. Eating or drinking after a fast, breaking a fast. 	 2. Satisfying, satisfaction. 	 3. Accomplishing. 4. Reading through. 	 5. Carrying across. 	 6. Saving.  E. प to satisfy, aff. ल्युट्.
पारत: पारत(द) m. (-तः or दः) Quicksilver.  E. पार fulness, (from पॄ to please,) and तन् to spread or diffuse, aff. ड, also पारद.
पारतन्त्र्य: पारतन्त्र्य n. (न्त्र्यं) Subservience, slavery, dependence.  E. परतन्त्र depen-dent, aff. ष्यञ्.
पारत्रिक: पारत्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to the next world.  E. परत्र, and ठक् aff.
पारत्र्य: पारत्र्य n. (-त्र्यं) Reward in a future state.
पारद: पारद(त) m. (-दः or तः) Quicksilver.  E. पार as in पारत, and द what gives, from दा with क aff.
पारदण्डक: पारदण्डक m. (-कः) The name of a country, a part of Orissa.  E. पार be-yond, दण्डक the Dandaka forest.
पारदारिक: पारदारिक m. (-कः) An adulterer.  E. पर another, दार wife, aff. ठक्.
पारदार्य: पारदार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Adultery.  E. पर another, दार a wife, ष्यञ् aff.
पारदार्य्य: पारदार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Adultery.  E. पर another, दार a wife, ष्यञ् aff.
पारदेशिक: पारदेशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Foreign, abroad. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A traveller. 2. A foreigner.  E. परदेश, and ठक् aff.
पारदेश्य: पारदेश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्यी-श्यं) Belonging to another country. 	 m. (-श्यः) 	 1. A traveller, one gone to a foreign country. 	 2. A foreigner.  E. पर another, देश country, ष्यञ् aff.
पारदृश्वन्: पारदृश्वन् mfn. (-श्वा-श्वा-श्व) Long-sighted, far-seeing, wise.  E. पार, and दृश् to see, क्वनिप् Unādi aff.
पारधेनु: पारधेनु m. (-नुः) A particular and low cast, the Ayogava. Also, पारधेनुक.
पारभृत: पारभृत n. (-तं) A present, an offering.  E. पर, भृत prepared, अण् aff. Ac-cording to some it is a misreading of प्राभृत ।
पारभृतीय: पारभृतीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Belonging or relating to a present.  E. पारमृत, and छ aff.
पारमार्थिक: पारमार्थिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Preferable, best, most desirable. 	 2. Re-lating to the spiritual knowledge. 	 3. Real, true, existing. 	 4. Loving truth.  E. पारमार्थ chief object, and ठक् aff.
पारमिक: पारमिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Supreme, chief, best.  E. परम best, ठञ् aff.
पारमित: पारमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Crossed, traversed. 	 2. Transcendant, (as spiritual knowledge.)  E. पारम् across, and इत gone.
पारम्पर्य: पारम्पर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 	 1. Traditional instruction, tradition. 	 2. Continueous order or succession.  E. परम्पर from one to another, aff. ष्यञ्.
पारम्पर्य्य: पारम्पर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 	 1. Traditional instruction, tradition. 	 2. Continueous order or succession.  E. परम्पर from one to another, aff. ष्यञ्.
पारम्पर्योपदेश: पारम्पर्य्योपदेश m. (-शः) Traditional instruction.  E. पारम्पर्य्य, and उपदेश instruction.
पारम्पर्य्योपदेश: पारम्पर्य्योपदेश m. (-शः) Traditional instruction.  E. पारम्पर्य्य, and उपदेश instruction.
पारय: पारय mfn. (यः-या-यं) 	 1. Able, adequate, fit for. 	 2. Satisfying.  E. प to satisfy, श aff.
पारयत्: पारयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 	 1. Satisfying, filling. 	 2. Being able or com-petent to. 	 3. Being alive, living.  E. पॄ to satisfy, शतृ aff.
पारयिष्णु: पारयिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Gratifying, pleasing, satisfying.  E. पॄ to please, causal. v. इष्णु aff.
पारलौकिक: पारलौकिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging or relating to the next world. E. परलोक another world, aff. ठक्, and both vowels changed by special rule.
पारवत: पारवत m. (-तः) A pigeon. See पारावत.
पारशव: पारशव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) 	 1. Made or derived from an axe. 	 2. Made of iron. 	 m. (वः) 	 1. The son of a Sūdra woman by a Brāhman. 2. A son by another's wife, an adulterine, a bastard. 	 3. An iron weapon.  E. पर another, शव् to go, अच् aff. and अण् implying descent, added; or पार crossing, शव a corpse, a living corpse; or परशु an axe, aff. अञ्.
पारशीक: पारशीक m. (-कः) 	 1. Persia. 	 2. A native of Persia. 	 3. A Persian horse. also पारसीक.
पारश्वध: पारश्वध m. (-धः) One armed with an axe, a hatchet-man, a pioneer, &c.  E. परश्वध an axe, aff. अण्.
पारश्वधिक: पारश्वधिक m. (-कः) A soldier, or any other man armed with an axe. E. परश्वध an axe, ठञ् aff.
पारसिक: पारसिक m. (-कः) Persia; plu. The Persians also पारसीक.
पारसीक: पारसीक m. (-कः) 	 1. The kingdom of Persia. 	 2. A Persian, an inhabi-tant of Persia. 	 3. A Persian horse.
पारस्त्रैणेय: पारस्त्रैणेय m. (-यः) An adulterine, the son of another's wife.  E. पर another, स्त्री woman, ढञ् aff. of descent, and इणङ् augment.
पारा: पारा f. (-रा) Name of a river.
पारापत: पारापत m. (-तः) A pigeon; also पारावत.
पारापा: पारापा(वा)र m. (-रः) The ocean. 	 n. (-रं) The two banks of a river. E. पार the further bank, and अपार near bank.
पारायण: पारायण n. (-णं) 	 1. Totality, entireness, completeness. 	 2. Going over, reading or doing any thing completely. 	 3. Going across. 	 4. Reading a Purāna, or causing it to be read. 	 f. (-णी) 	 1. The goddess SARA-SWATĪ. 	 2. Action, act. 	 3. Considering, meditating. 	 4. Light.  E. पार the boundary or limit, and अयन going to, extending: when used attributively it remains always neuter.
पारायणिक: पारायणिक m. (-कः) 	 1. A pupil, a scholar. 	 2. A lecturer, a reader of the Purānas.  E. पारायण reading through, ठक् aff.
पारारुक: पारारुक m. (-कः) A rock.  E. पार the further bank, ऋ to go to, aff. डकञ्. Also पारारुप ।
पारावत: पारावत m. (-तः) 	 1. A dove, a pigeon. 	 2. A monkey. 	 3. A sort of ebony, (Diospyros glutinosa.) 	 4. A mountain. 	 f. (-ती) 	 1. The name of a river in the peninsula. 	 2. The fruit of the Annona reticulata. 	 3. A form of song, peculiar to the cowherds.  E. पर another, (life, &c.) अव् to go, to preserve, शतृ participial aff., and अण् added.
पारावतपदी: पारावतपदी f. (-दी) Heart-pea: see पारावताङ्घ्रि । काकजङ्घायाम्च ।
पारावताङ्घ्रि: पारावताङ्घ्रि f. (-ङ्घ्रि) Heart-pea, (Cardiospermum haliacacabum.) E. पारावत a pigeon, अङ्घ्रि a foot, the root being compared to a pigeon's foot; also similar compounds, as पारावतपदी.
पारावार: पारावार m. (-रः) The ocean. 	 n. (-रं) The near and opposite banks of a stream.  E. पार the further bank, वृ to surround, with आङ् pre-fix, and अण् aff.
पारावारीण: पारावारीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. On both sides of a river, &c. 	 2. One who goes to both sides.  E. पार the opposite side, अवार this side, aff. खञ् ।
पाराशर: पाराशर m. (-रः) A name of the poet VYĀSA. 	 n. (-रं) The rules of PARĀSARA, or VYĀSA, the conduct of the mendicant orders. E. पराशर, and अण् added.
पाराशरकल्पिक: पाराशरकल्पिक m. (-कः) A follower of PARĀSARA, the institutor of rules for the mendicant order.  E. पराशर the sage, कल्प aff., and ठक् added.
पाराशरि: पाराशरि m. (-रिः) 	 1. VYĀSA. 	 2. An epithet of Sūkra.  E. पराशर, and इञ् patronymic aff.
पाराशरिन्: पाराशरिन् m. (-री) 	 1. A recluse. Plu. The religious mendicant or Brāhman, who having passed through the three stages of student, house-holder, and ascetic leads a vagrant life, and subsists upon alms; or the class of ascetics who study the Shā-riraka Sutra of Vyāsa.  E. पाराशर्य्य VYĀSA, the author of the rules of this order, and इनि aff.
पाराशर्य: पाराशर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) The poet VYĀSA.  E. पाराशर the father of the poet, and यञ् aff.
पाराशर्य्य: पाराशर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) The poet VYĀSA.  E. पाराशर the father of the poet, and यञ् aff.
पारिकाङ्क्षिन्: पारिकाङ्क्षिन् m. (-ङ्क्षी) 	 1. An ascetic, one who devotes his days to devout contemplation. 	 2. The religious mendicant.  E. परि imply-ing secession, (abandoning worldly wishes,) काङ्क्षि to desire, and णिनि aff.; or पारि derived from पर, supreme felicity, and काङ्क्षिन् who desires.
पारिखेय: पारिखेय f. (-यीः) Surrounded by a ditch.  E. परिखा, affix, ढक् ।
पारिजात: पारिजात m. (-तः) 	 1. Name of one of the five trees of paradise sup-posed to have been produced at the churning of the ocean. 	 2. The coral tree, (Erythrina fulgens.)  E. पारि said to mean, above, and जात produced.
पारिजातक: पारिजातक m. (-कः) 	 1. A tree of paradise. 	 2. The coral tree.  E. कन् added to the last.
पारिणाय्य: पारिणाय्य mfn. (य्यः-य्यी-य्यं) Belonging to specifically or peculiarly. 	 n. (-य्यं) Property received at the time of marriage by a woman. 	 f. (य्यी) 	 1. Relating to marriage.  E. परि about, around, णी to get, aff. ष्यञ् ।
पारिणाह्य: पारिणाह्य n. (-ह्यं) Household furniture and utensils.  E. परिणाह, and ष्यञ् aff.
पारितथ्या: पारितथ्या f. (-थ्या) A trinket worn on the forehead, where the hair is parted; or a string of pearls for binding the hair.  E. परि every way (splendid), तथा there, ष्यञ् added.
पारितोषिक: पारितोषिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Delighting, making happy. 	 n. (-कं) A reward, a gratuity.  E. परितोष satisfaction, ठञ् aff.
पारिन्द्र: पारिन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A lion: see परिन्द्र.
पारिपन्थिक: पारिपन्थिक m. (-कः) A robber, a thief, a highwayman.  E. परि around, पथिन् the road, aff. ठक्.
पारिपाठ्य: पारिपाठ्य n. (-ठ्यं) Regularity, methodicalness, successiveness.  E. परि-पाटी orderly course, ष्यञ् aff.
पारिपात्र: पारिपात्र m. (-त्रः) The name of a mountain, apparently the centrical or western portion of the “Vindhya” chain, which skirts the province of Mālwā.  E. परि every way, पा to cherish, ष्ट्रन् aff.; or with कन् added, पारिपात्रक; also read पारियात्र.
पारिपात्रक: पारिपात्रक m. (-कः) A mountain so called: see the last.
पारिपार्श्विक: पारिपार्श्विक m. (-कः) 	 1. An actor, who serves as a sort of chorus to the drama, and is one of the interlocutors in the prologue. 	 2. An attendant.  E. परि about, पार्श्व the side, (of the manager, &c.) aff. ठक्.
पारिप्लव: पारिप्लव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 	 1. Perturbed, troubled in mind. 	 2. Trembling, tremulous, unsteady. 	 3. Swimming, floating. 	 m. (-वः) A boat. E. परिप्लव, and अण् added.
पारिप्लाव्य: पारिप्लाव्य m. (-व्यः) A goose. 	 n. (-व्यं) 	 1. Perplexity, agitation. 	 2. Tre-mulousness.  E. परिप्लव, and ष्यञ् aff.
पारिभद्र: पारिभद्र m. (-द्रः) 	 1. The coral tree, (Erythrina fulgens.) 	 2. The Nimba tree. 	 3. A sort of pine, (Pinus Devadāru.) 	 4. The Sarala, also a sort of pine, (P. longifolia.)  E. परि completely, भद्र auspicious, aff. अण्; also with कन् added, पारिभद्रक.
पारिभाव्य: पारिभाव्य n. (-व्यं) 	 1. Surety, security, bail. 	 2. A drug, a sort of cos-tus, (C. speciosus.)  E. परिभू a surety, or परिभव overcoming, (dis-ease) aff. ष्यञ् ।
पारिभाषिक: पारिभाषिक f. (-की) 	 1. Current, common, universally received 2. Techni-cal, (as a word.)  E. परिभाषा, and ठञ् affix.
पारिमाण्डल्य: पारिमाण्डल्य n. (-ल्यं) An atom, as a measure of space, a mote in a sun beam.  E. परिमण्डल a ball, and ष्यञ् aff.
पारिमुखिक: पारिमुखिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Present, before or about the face.  E. परि about, मुख the face, ठक् aff.
पारिमुख्य: पारिमुख्य n. (-ख्यं) Presence, being before the face.  E. परिमुख, and ष्यञ् aff.
पारियात्र: पारियात्र m. (-त्रः) The name of one of the seven principal mountains: see पारिपात्र, also with कन् added, पारियात्रक, or with ठक aff. पारियात्रिक.
पारियानिक: पारियानिक m. (-कः) A travelling cart or carriage.  E. पारि every way, यान going, aff. ठक्.
पारिरक्षक: पारिरक्षक m. (-कः) An ascetic or religious mendicant.  E. पारि said to mean, future happiness, from परि and रक्षक who preserves.
पारिश: पारिश m. (-शः) A tree: see गर्द्धभाण्ड । पलाशपिपुल ।
पारिशील: पारिशील n. (-लं) That which is left, remainder.
पारिषद: पारिषद mfn. (-दः-दी-दं) Belonging or relating to an assembly. 	 m. (-दः) 1. A spectator, a person present at an assembly or congregation. 2. A king's companion. plu. The retinue of a god.  E. परिषद् an assembly, aff. अण्; or with ण्य aff. पारिषद्य.
पारिषद्य: पारिषद्य m. (-द्यः) A spectator: see the last.
पारिहारिक: पारिहारिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Taking away, seizing. 	 2. Surrounding. m. (-कः) A maker of garlands. 	 f. (-की) A kind of riddle.  E. परिहार seizure, ठक aff.
पारिहार्य: पारिहार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A bracelet. 	 n. (-र्य्यं) Taking, seizure.  E. परिहार, and ष्यञ् aff. also परिहार्य्य.
पारिहार्य्य: पारिहार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A bracelet. 	 n. (-र्य्यं) Taking, seizure.  E. परिहार, and ष्यञ् aff. also परिहार्य्य.
पारी: पारी f. (-री) 	 1. A rope for tying an elephant's feet. 	 2. A quantity of water. 	 3. A drinking cup. 	 4. A milk-pail.  E. पा + क्किप्-रा-क-ङीष् ।
पारीक्षित: पारीक्षित m. (-तः) 	 1. The name of a sovereign, to whom the Sri-Bhā-gavat, or life of KRISHṆA, is supposed to have been addressed. 2. The successor of the preceding; also JANAMEJAYA.  E. परीक्षित् the king so called, and अण् pleonasm or patronymic.
पारीण: पारीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. On the opposite side. 	 2. Who goes or crosses to the other side. 	 3. Completely versed in.  E. पार the other side, aff. खञ् ।
पारीन्द्र: पारीन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 	 1. A lion. 	 2. A large snake, (Boa.)  E. पर another, (animal,) and इन्द्र lord, form irr.
पारीरण: पारीरण m. (-णः) 	 1. A tortoise. 	 2. A stick, a staff. पार्य्यां रणति, रण + अच् ।
पारु: पारु m. (-रुः) 	 1. The sun. 	 2. Fire.  E. पा or nourish, Unādi aff. रु.
पारुष्य: पारुष्य n. (-ष्यं) 	 1. Abuse, reproach, scurrilous, opprobrious or un-friendly speech. 	 2. The property of harshness, &c. in speaking. 3. The forest or grove of INDRA. 	 4. Aloe wood or Agallochum. 5. Severity, violence, either in word or deed, as वाक्षारुष्यं defama-tion, abuse, or violence words, and दण्डपारुष्यं personal injury, assault or violence of blows. 	 m. (-ष्यः) A name of VRIHASPATI. E. परुष harsh, contumelious, &c. aff. ष्यञ्.
पारेरक: पारेरक m. (-कः) A sword, a scimitar.  E. पार collectively, foes, from पर an enemy, ईर् to penetrate, aff. वुन्.
पार्घट: पार्घट n. (-टं) 	 1. Ashes. 	 2. Dust.  E. पार from पर another, घट् to endeavour, aff. अच्, and the final vowel of पार rejected.
पार्ण: पार्ण f. (-र्णी) Relating to leaves. 	 2. Raised from leaves (as a tax.)
पार्थ: पार्थ m. (-र्थः) 	 1. A king, a prince. 	 2. A name of the Pāndu prince ARJUNA. 	 3. A name of KĀRTAVĪRYA. 	 4. A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.)  E. पृथा a proper name, अण् aff. of descent.
पार्थक्य: पार्थक्य n. (-क्यं) Severalty, individuality, difference.  E. पृथक् separate, ष्यञ् aff.
पार्थव: पार्थव n. (-वं) Greatness, immensity.  E. पृथु great, अण् aff.; also पृथुता, पृथुत्व, &c.
पार्थिव: पार्थिव mfn. (-वः-वा or वी-वं) 	 1. Earthen, made or derived from earth. 	 2. Ruling or possessing the earth. 	 3. Princely, royal. m. (-वः) 	 1. A king, a prince. 	 2. An earthen vessel. 	 3. An inhabi-tant of the earth. 	 f. (-वी) 	 1. A name of ŚITA. 	 2. An epithet of Lakshmi.  E. पृथिवी the earth, अण् aff.
पार्पर: पार्पर m. (-रः) 	 1. A name of YAMA. 	 2. Consumption. 	 3. A handful of rice.
पार्व: पार्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वी-र्व्वं) Relating to a Parva, a particular day of the month, &c.  E. पर्व्वन्, and अण् aff.
पार्व्व: पार्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वी-र्व्वं) Relating to a Parva, a particular day of the month, &c.  E. पर्व्वन्, and अण् aff.
पार्वण: पार्व्वण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) 	 m. (-णः) A sort of deer. 	 n. (-णं) The gene-ral funeral ceremony to be offered to all the manes at the Parva, or conjunction of the sun and moon, at which double oblations are offered; three cakes to the father, paternal grand-father, and great grandfather; and three to the maternal grand-father, his father, and grandfather; and the crumbs of each set to the remoter ancestors in each line. 	 f. (-णी) 	 1. Belonging or relating to a Parvan. 	 2. Waxing, increasing.  E. पर्व्व a knot, &c. aff. अण् ।
पार्व्वण: पार्व्वण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) 	 m. (-णः) A sort of deer. 	 n. (-णी) 	 1. Belonging or relating to a Parvan. 	 2. Waxing, increasing.  E. पर्व्व a knot, &c. aff. अण् ।

पार्वतीनन्दन: पार्व्वतीनन्दन m. (-नः) 	 1. A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. 	 2. A name of GANE-ŚHA.  E. पार्व्वती the goddess, and नन्दन a son.
पार्व्वतीनन्दन: पार्व्वतीनन्दन m. (-नः) 	 1. A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. 	 2. A name of GANE-ŚHA.  E. पार्व्वती the goddess, and नन्दन a son.
पार्वतीय: पार्व्वतीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Mountain, mountaineer. 	 m. plu. Name of a mountain tribe.  E. पर्व्वतीय, and अण् added.
पार्व्वतीय: पार्व्वतीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Mountain, mountaineer. 	 m. plu. Name of a mountain tribe.  E. पर्व्वतीय, and अण् added.
पार्वतेय: पार्व्वतेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Mountain or mountain-born, &c. 	 n. (-यं) 	 1. Antimony. 	 2. A plant bearing a pungent fruit.  E. पर्व्वत a moun-tain, and ढक् aff.
पार्व्वतेय: पार्व्वतेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Mountain or mountain-born, &c. 	 n. (-यं) 	 1. Antimony. 	 2. A plant bearing a pungent fruit.  E. पर्व्वत a moun-tain, and ढक् aff.
पार्वायनान्तीय: पार्व्वायनान्तीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Occurring at the end of a Parva or a solstice, (a sacrifice, &c.)  E. पर्व्व, and अयन solstice, अन्त end, छण् aff.
पार्व्वायनान्तीय: पार्व्वायनान्तीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Occurring at the end of a Parva or a solstice, (a sacrifice, &c.)  E. पर्व्व, and अयन solstice, अन्त end, छण् aff.
पार्शव: पार्शव m. (-वः) A warrior armed with an axe.  E. पर्शु an axe, and अण् aff.

(-र्श्वः) The twenty-third Jina or Jaina pontiff. E. स्पृश् to touch, श्वण् Unādi aff., and पृ substituted for the root; or पर्शु a rib, aff. अण्.

पार्श्वगत: पार्श्वगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Close to, beside.  E. पार्श्व, and गत gone to.
पार्श्वतस्: पार्श्वतस् ind. By or from the side of, &c.  E. पार्श्व the side, and तसिल् aff.
पार्श्वतीय: पार्श्वतीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Belonging to the side of.  E. पार्श्वतस्, and छ aff.; the final अस् rejected.
पार्श्वपरिवर्तन: पार्श्वपरिवर्त्तन n. (-नं) 	 1. Turning round from one side to the other in a bed. 	 2. A festival held in the eleventh day of the first half of Bhādra when VISHṆU is supposed to turn upon the other side in his sleep.  E. पार्श्व, and परिवर्त्तन turning.
पार्श्वपरिवर्त्तन: पार्श्वपरिवर्त्तन n. (-नं) 	 1. Turning round from one side to the other in a bed. 	 2. A festival held in the eleventh day of the first half of Bhādra when VISHṆU is supposed to turn upon the other side in his sleep.  E. पार्श्व, and परिवर्त्तन turning.
पार्श्वभाग: पार्श्वभाग m. (-गः) The side, the flank.  E. पार्श्व the side, and माग part.

पार्श्वशूल: पार्श्वशूल n. (-लं) Spasm of the chest, stitch.  E. पार्श्व, and शूल sharp pain.

पार्श्वास्थि: पार्श्वास्थि n. (-स्थि) A rib.  E. पार्श्व the side, and अस्थि a bone.

पार्श्वोदरप्रिय: पार्श्वोदरप्रिय m. (-यः) A crab.  E. पार्श्व the side, उदर the belly, and प्रिय fond of; going sidelong.
पार्षत: पार्षत m. (-तः) A Pāṇḍu prince. 	 f. (-ती) 	 1. A name of DRAUPADĪ. 2. Belonging to the spotted antelope. 	 3. An epithet of DURGĀ. E. पृषत the name of a king, अण् aff. of descent.
पार्षद: पार्षद m. (-दः) 	 1. A spectator, a person present in a congregation or assembly. 	 2. A companion, an attendant. 	 3. A retinue, a train. E. पर्षद an assembly, अण् aff.; also with ण्य aff., पार्षद्यः or derived from परिषद, पारिषद.
पार्ष्णि: पार्ष्णि mf. (-र्ष्णिः) 	 1. The heel. 	 2. The rear of an army. 	 3. The back. 4. Enquiry, asking. 	 5. A kick. 	 f. (-र्ष्णिः) 	 1. A horse, probably a bay or chesnut horse. 	 n. (-रं) 1. Gold. 	 2. Yellow orpiment. 	 3. A cage. 	 4. The ribs or the cavity formed by them, the thorax: see पञ्जर.  E. पिजि to dye or tinge, अरच् aff.
पिञ्जल: पिञ्जल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Confounded, overcome with terror or grief. m. (-लः) An army panic-struck, or in great disorder. 	 n. (-लं) 	 1. The leaf of the Kusa grass. 	 2. Yellow orpiment. 	 f. (-ली) Two blades of Kusa grass, used as a vessel, or to take up articles with, at sacrifices.  E. पिजि to hurt, &c. aff. कलच् ।
पिञ्जाल: पिञ्जाल n. (-लं) Gold.  E. पिजि, आलच् aff.
पिञ्जिका: पिञ्जिका f. (-का) A roll of cotton, from which the threads are spun. E. पिञ्जा cotton, कन् added in the fem. form. “पाइज” ।
पिञ्जूल: पिञ्जूल n. (-लं) The wick of a lamp.  E. पिजि to hurt, &c. Unādi aff. ऊलव्.
पिञ्जूष: पिञ्जूष m. (-षः) The wax of the ear.  E. पिजि to stain, ऊषन् aff.
पिञ्जेट: पिञ्जेट m. (-टः) The excretion, or concrete rheum of the eyes.
पिञ्जोला: पिञ्जोला f. (-ला) The noise, or rustling of leaves.  E. पिजि, ओल aff.
पिट: पिट r. 1st cl. (पेटति) 	 1. To sound. 	 2. To assemble or heap together. भ्वा० पर० अक० सेट् ।
पिट m. (-टः) 	 1. A basket for holding grain, a sort of cupboard or granary made of bamboos or canes. 	 2. A basket, a box. 	 n. (-टं) 	 1. A house, a hovel. 	 2. A roof.  E. पिट् to collect, क aff.
पिटक: पिटक mfn. subst. (-कः-का-कं) A boil, an ulcer. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A basket, a box. 	 2. A large basket, or receptacle of basket work, for keeping grain, &c.; a granary. 	 3. An ornament on Indra's banner.  E. पिट् to collect, aff. क्कुन्; also पिट and पेटक ।
पिटङ्काश: पिटङ्काश m. (-शः) A species of pike, (Esox scolopax.)
पिटाक: पिटाक m. (-कः) 	 1. The name of a saint. 	 2. A basket, a box.  E. पिट् to collect, and काक Unādi aff.
पिट्टक: पिट्टक n. (-कं) The tartar or excretion of the teeth.  E. पिट् to collect, aff. ण्वुल् ।
पिठ: पिठ r. 1st cl. (पेठति) 	 1. To hurt or kill. 	 2. To feel pain or affliction. क्लेशे अक० वधे सक० भ्वा० पर० सेट् ।
पिठ m. (-ठः) Pain, distress.  E. पिठ, and क aff.
पिठर: पिठर mf. (-रः-री) A pot, a pan. 	 n. (-रं) 	 1. A churning stick. 	 2. A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) 	 3. A sort of building, a hut or watch box made of bamboos and mats, or as it is sometimes explained, a kind of store room or scullery.  E. पिठ pain, रा to take, aff. क; or पिठ-करन् ।
पिठरक: पिठरक m. (-कः) A kind of serpent. E. see the last.
पिड: पिड(इ,)पिडि r. 1st and 10th cls. (पिण्डति-ते पिण्डयति-ते) To accu-mulate, to assemble, to heap together. राशीकरणे भ्वा० आत्म० सक० सेट्० इदित् । चुरादेरुभयपदी ।
पिडक: पिडक mf. (-कः-वा) A small boil, a pimple.  E. पीड-ण्वुल् ।
पिण्ड: पिण्ड mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं) A lump, a heap, a cluster, a quantity or collec-tion. 	 mf. (-ण्डः-ण्डी) An oblation to deceased ancestors as a ball or lump of meat, or rice, mixed up with milk, curds, flowers, &c. and offered to the manes at the several Shrāddhas. by the nearest surviving relations. 	 m. (-ण्डः) 	 1. A ball, a globe. 	 2. A mouthful, or roundish lump of food, considered as equivalent to a mouthful. 	 3. Presenting water or cake to a deceased relation. 	 4. The body. 	 5. The side immediately below the armpit. 	 6. A part of a house; a sort of portico or shed, in front of the door. 	 7. Coarse, gross, thick, solid. 	 8. Strength, power. 	 9. Myrrh. 	 10. Franki-ncense. 	 11. The China rose. 	 12. Food. 	 13. Flesh, meat. 	 14. The projection of an elephant's frontal sinus. 	 15. The embryo or fetus in an early stage of gestation. 	 16. A sum, (in arith-metic.) 	 17. Thickness, (In geometry.) 	 18. (In astronomy,) The twenty-fourth part of the quadrant of a circle, or 30-45’. 	 n. (-ण्डं) 	 1. Livelihood, means, means of living. 	 2. Iron. 	 3. Fresh butter. 	 4. Power, strength. 	 5. An army. 	 f. (-ण्डी) 	 1. A long gourd, (Cucurbita lagenaria.) 	 2. A sort of palm, (Phœnix dactyli-fera.) 	 3. A flowering shrub, (Tabernæmontana coronaria flor. plen.) 	 4. Performance of certain gesticulations, accompanying the silent repetition of prayers, &c. in meditation on real or divine knowledge. 	 5. The nave of a wheel. 	 6. A house. 	 7. Solid, compact, close. 	 8. The calf of the leg. 	 9. A round mass.  E. पिडि to heap, to gather, to collect, &c. aff. अच् fem. aff. ङीप् ।
पिण्डक: पिण्डक mn. (-कः-कं) 	 1. Incense. 	 2. Carrot. 	 3. The calf of the leg. 	 4. A lump of food. 	 5. A lump or ball. 	 m. (-कः) A goblin, a demon. E. पिण्ड as above, and कन् added.
पिण्डखर्जूर: पिण्डखर्ज्जूर mf. (-रः-री) A sort of date tree.  E. पिण्ड a lump, a cluster, and खर्ज्जूर the date. “छोहारा” ।
पिण्डखर्ज्जूर: पिण्डखर्ज्जूर mf. (-रः-री) A sort of date tree.  E. पिण्ड a lump, a cluster, and खर्ज्जूर the date. “छोहारा” ।
पिण्डगोस: पिण्डगोस m. (-सः) Gum myrrh; also पिण्ड, and गोस severally. “गन्धरसे” ।
पिण्डद: पिण्डद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 	 1. Who or what gives the funeral cake to deceased ancestors. 	 2. One who supports or feeds another. 	 m. (-दः) 	 1. The nearest male relation who offers the funeral cake. 	 2. A patron, a master.  E. पिण्ड, and द who or what gives.
पिण्डदान: पिण्डदान n. (-नं) 	 1. Presentation of the obsequial cake. 	 2. The funeral oblation made to deceased ancestors on the evening of the new-moon day.  E. पिण्ड, and दान giving.
पिण्डन: पिण्डन m. (-नः) A mound or bank. 	 n. (-नं) Forming globes.
पिण्डनिर्वपन: पिण्डनिर्वपन n. (-नं) Presenting obsequial cake to the manes.  E. पिण्ड, and निर्वपन offering funeral oblations.
पिण्डपात: पिण्डपात m. (-तः) Collecting or giving alms.
पिण्डपाद: पिण्डपाद m. (-दः) An elephant.  E. पिण्ड a lump of flesh, and पाद a foot: also पिण्डपाद्य.
पिण्डपुष्प: पिण्डपुष्प mn. (-ष्पः-ष्पं) 	 1. The flower of the Asoka tree, (Jonesia Asoca.) 2. The China rose. 	 3. A lotus. 	 4. A flower, (Tabernæmontana coronaria.) 	 5. The pomegranate.  E. पिण्ड a cluster, and पुष्प a flower.
पिण्डपुष्पक: पिण्डपुष्पक m. (-कः) A potherb, (Chenopodium album.)  E. पिण्ड a lump, पुष्प a flower, कन् added. वास्तूकशाके ।
पिण्डफला: पिण्डफला f. (-ला) A bitter gourd.  E. पिण्ड a lump, फल fruit.
पिण्डमात्रोपजीविन्: पिण्डमात्रोपजीविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Living, breathing, having no intellectual existence.  E. पिण्ड, मात्र only, उपजीविन् subsisting.
पिण्डमुस्ता: पिण्डमुस्ता f. (-स्ता) A sort of grass, (Cyperus pertenuis.)  E. पिण्ड a lump, and मुस्ता Cyperus. नागरमुस्तायाम् ।
पिण्डमूल: पिण्डमूल n. (-लं) The carrot, (Daucus carota.)  E. पिण्ड lump of flesh, and मूल a root; also with कन् added, पिण्डमूलक. “गांँजर” ।
पिण्डल: पिण्डल m. (-लः) A bridge, a causeway, a passage over a stream or ravine, &c. or a mound raised to form a path across inundated fields.  E. पिण्ड a heap, (of earth, &c.) and ला to get, aff. ड; or पिडि वा कलच् ।
पिण्डलेप: पिण्डलेप m. (-पः) 	 1. The fragments of the obsequial cake which cling to the hand.
पिण्डलोप: पिण्डलोप m. (-पः) Interruption in offering the funeral cakes.
पिण्डवीज: पिण्डवीज m. (-जः) A flowering shrub, (Oleander odorum.)  E. पिण्ड, and वीज seed.
पिण्डस: पिण्डस m. (-सः) A beggar, a mendicant living upon alms.  E. पिण्ड a ball of rice, &c. सद् to go or get, aff. ड.
पिण्डसम्बन्ध: पिण्डसम्बन्ध m. (-न्धः) Relationship between a living person and one deceased, near enough to qualify the former to offer the obsequial cake to the latter.
पिण्डात: पिण्डात m. (-तः) Incense.  E. पिण्ड the same, अत् to be, aff. मातत्ये-अच्.
पिण्डाभ्र: पिण्डाभ्र n. (-भ्रं) Hail.  E. पिण्ड a lump, and अभ्र a cloud.
पिण्डायस: पिण्डायस n. (-सं) Steel.  E. पिण्ड, and अयस iron.
पिण्डार: पिण्डार m. (-रः) 	 1. A keeper or attendant on buffaloes. 	 2. A cow-herd. 	 3. A beggar, a religious mendicant. 	 4. The vikankata tree, (Trewia nudiflora.)  E. पिण्ड a heap, ऋ to go, aff. अण्.
पिण्डाल: पिण्डाल m. (-लुः) An esculent and medical root, described as sweet, cooling, and diuretic.  E. पिण्ड a lump, and आलु an esculent root. “गोलआलु” ।
पिण्डाश: पिण्डाश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) A beggar.  E. पिण्ड a piece of meat, आश who eats; also पिण्डाशनः, and पिण्डाशिन् m. (-शी ।)
पिण्डि: पिण्डि f. (-ण्डि) 	 1. The have of a wheel. 	 2. The Asoka tree, &c: see पिण्डी.  E. पिडि to collect, (the spokes,) aff. इन्; also पिण्डी and पिण्डिका ।
पिण्डिका: पिण्डिका f. (-का) 	 1. The nave of a wheel. 	 2. The instep. 	 3. A stool or seat of various shapes and dimensions.  E. पिण्डी as above, and कन् added.
पिण्डित: पिण्डित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Multiplied, added. 	 2. Counted, numbered. 3. Thick, massy, lumpish. 	 4. Collected, heaped together.  E. पिण्ड a lump, a heap, and इतच् aff.; or पिडि-क्त ।
पिण्डिन्: पिण्डिन् mfn. (-ण्डी-ण्डिनी-ण्डि) Having a Pinda or ball of food, (a ceremony, an ancestor, &c.) 	 m. (-ण्डी) 	 1. A beggar. 	 2. An offerer of oblations.  E. पिण्ड, and इनि aff.
पिण्डिल: पिण्डिल m. (-लः) 	 1. A bridge, a mound, a causeway. 	 2. An astrologer, an arithmetician, a calculator of nativities, &c. 	 f. (-ला) A sort of cucumber, (C. madraspatanus.)  E. पिण्ड a heap, &c. इलच् Unādi aff.
पिण्डीकरण: पिण्डीकरण n. (-णं) Heaping, making up into a lump or ball.  E. पिण्ड, and करण making, च्वि augm.
पिण्डीकृत: पिण्डीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made into a lump or ball.  E. पिण्ड, and कृत made, च्वि augm.
पिण्डीतक: पिण्डीतक m. (-कः) 	 1. A tree, (Vangueria spinosa, Rox.) 	 2. A shrub, (Tabernæmontana coronaria.) 	 3. A plant, commonly marua: see मरुवक ।  E. पिण्डी a plant, तन् to spread, to resemble, aff. ड and कन् added.
पिण्डीतगर: पिण्डीतगर m. (-रः) A plant, a species of Tabernæmontana.  E. पिण्डी the same, and तगर T. coronaria.
पिण्डीभूत: पिण्डीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Lumped, heaped, made up in a lump or ball.  E. पिण्ड, and भूत become, च्वि augm.
पिण्डीर: पिण्डीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Sapless, juiceless, arid, dry. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. The pomegranate. 	 2. Cuttle-fish-bone considered to be the foam of the sea.  E. पिण्ड a ball, &c. ईर to go, to resemble, aff. अण्.
पिण्डीशूर: पिण्डीशूर m. (रः) A cot queen, an effeminate braggart.  E. पिण्ड a house, and शूर a hero.
पिण्डोद्धरण: पिण्डोद्धरण n. (-णं) Participating in obsequial offerings, presenting them to common ancestors.  E. पिण्ड, and डद्धरण sharing.
पिण्डोलि: पिण्डोलि f. (-लिः) Orts, leaving of a meal, or fragments dropped from the mouth.  E. पिडि to heap, aff. ओलि.
पिण्या: पिण्या f. (ण्या) Heart-pea, (Cardiospermum haliacacabum.)  E. पण् to praise, ण्यत् aff., and इ substituted for the radical vowel: see पण्या.
पिण्याक: पिण्याक m. (-कः) 	 1. The sediments of seeds, &c. ground for oil; oil-cake, or the seeds after expression. 	 2. Saffron. 	 3. Asafœtida. 4. Incense.  E. पिषु to pound or bruise, deriv. irr.
पितामह: पितामह m. (हः) 	 1. A paternal grandfather. 	 2. A name of BRAHMĀ. the great father of all. 	 f. (-ही) A paternal grandmother.  E. पितृ a father, and डामह aff.
पितृ: पितृ m. (-ता) A father, dual, (-रौ) Mother and father, parents. plu. always, (-रः) 	 1. Paternal ancestors. 	 2. The manes, or the deceased and deified progenitors of mankind, inhabiting a peculiar region or heaven, or according to some, the orbit of the moon.  E. पा to nourish, Unādi aff. तृच्.
पितृक: पितृक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Paternal, ancestral, parental, obsequial, relating or belonging to parents or progenitors.  E. पितृ a sire, and कन् aff.
पितॄक्थ: पितॄक्थ n. (-क्थं) Paternal property.  E. पितृ, and ऋक्थ wealth.
पितृकर्मन्: पितृकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Obsequial rites.  E. पितृ, and कर्म्मन् act.
पितृकर्म्मन्: पितृकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Obsequial rites.  E. पितृ, and कर्म्मन् act.
पितृकार्य: पितृकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Obsequial rites.  E. पितृ, and कार्य्य to be done.
पितृकार्य्य: पितृकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Obsequial rites.  E. पितृ, and कार्य्य to be done.
पितृकानन: पितृकानन n. (-नं) A cemetery.  E. पितृ an ancestor, and कानन a wood.
पितृक्रिया: पितृक्रिया f. (-या) Obsequial rites.  E. पितृ, and क्रिया ceremony.
पितृगण: पितृगण m. (-णः) A class of progenitors, the sons of the Rishis or Prajāpatis: the principal classes are the Somasads descended from VIRĀT, the Agnishwattās from MARĪCHI, Bārhishads from ATRI, Somapās from BHRIGU, Havishmats from ANGIRAS, Ājyapas from PULASTYA, Sukālins from VASHISTHA; there are also the Agnidaghas and Anagnidagdhas, Kavyas and Saumyas. E. पितृ father, (of mankind,) गण a troop.
पितृगामिन्: पितृगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Belonging to, or pertaining to a father.  E. पितृ, and गामिन् what goes.
पितृगृह: पितृगृह n. (-हं) 	 1. A paternal mansion. 	 2. A burying ground, a cemetery.  E. पितृ a deceased ancestor, and गृह a house.
पितृघातक: पितृघातक m. (-कः) A parricide.  E. पितृ and घातक a slayer.
पितृतर्पण: पितृतर्पण n. (णं) 	 1. The part of the hand between the middle finger and thumb, sacred to the manes. 	 2. Gifts in honour of deceased relations, distributed at the Śrāddhas or funeral ceremonies. 	 3. The act of throwing water out of the right hand at seasons of ablution, by way of offering to the manes or deceased ancestors in general.  E. पितृ a father, a progenitor, and तर्पण satisfying.
पितृतस्: पितृतस् ind. From or by the father.  E. पितृ, and तसि aff.
पितृतिथि: पितृतिथि m. (-थिः) Day of new moon, on which she rises invisible. E. पितृ a progenitor, and तिथि a lunar day, sacred to the manes.
पितृतीर्थ: पितृतीर्थ n. (-र्थं) 	 1. Gaya, the city so called, where the performance of funeral sacrifices is peculiarly efficacious and meritorious. 	 2. The part between the forefinger and thumb, sacred to the manes.  E. पितृ a progenitor, and तीर्थ a place of pilgrimage.
पितृत्व: पितृत्व n. (-त्वं) 	 1. Paternity. 	 2. The state or condition of a Pitṛ, or deified progenitor.  E. त्व added to पितृ.
पितृदान: पितृदान n. (-नं) Gift in honour of deceased ancestors.  E. पितृ a pro-genitor, and दान giving or gift; also with कन् added, पितृदानक n. (-कं).
पितदैवत: पितदैवत n. (-तं) The tenth lunar asterism or Maghā.  E. पितृ, and दैवत divinity, presiding over the asterism.
पितृपक्ष: पितृपक्ष m. (-क्षः) 	 1. The paternal side. 	 2. The second half of the month of Bhādrapada peculiarly appointed for the celebration of obsequial rites to the manes.
पितृपति: पितृपति m. (-तिः) YAMA, regent of the dead.  E. पितृ a deceased pro-genitor, and पति lord.
पितृपद: पितृपद n. (-दं) The world or state of the manes.  E. पितृ, and पद degree.
पितृपात्र: पितृपात्र n. (-त्रं) A cup or vessel used at obsequial rites.  E. पितृ, and पात्र a cup.
पितृपितृ: पितृपितृ m. (-ता) A paternal grandfather.  E. पितृ a father, and पितृ the same, father's father.
पितृप्रसू: पितृप्रसू f. (-सूः) 	 1. Twilight. 	 2. A father's mother.  E. पितृ a deceased progenitor, and प्रसू the parent; the first is the time when manes are abroad.
पितृप्राप्त: पितृप्राप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 	 1. Received from a father. 	 2. Inherited patrimonially.  E. पितृ, and प्राप्त obtained.
पितृबन्धु: पितृबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) A remote or cognate kinsman by the father's side, as the son of the paternal grandfather's sister, of the paternal grandmother's sister, and of the father's maternal uncle. E. पितृ, and बन्धु a kinsman.
पितृबान्धव: पितृबान्धव m. (-वः) A remote kinsman of the paternal line: see the last.  E. पितृ, and बान्धव a kinsman.
पितृभक्ति: पितृभक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Filial duty to a father.  E. पितृ, and भक्ति devotion.
पितृभोजन: पितृभोजन n. (-नं) 	 1. Food offered to the manes. 	 2. A father's food. 3. A kind of pulse: see Māsha.  E. पितृ, and भोजन food.
पितृभ्रातृ: पितृभ्रातृ m. (-ता) A father's brother.  E. पितृ, and भ्रातृ a brother.
पितृमन्दिर: पितृमन्दिर n. (-रं) 	 1. The paternal mansion. 	 2. A cemetery.  E. पितृ, and मन्दिर a dwelling.
पितृमेध: पितृमेध n. (-धं) Obsequial rites.  E. पितृ, and मेध sacrifice.
पितृयज्ञ: पितृयज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) 	 1. Obsequial rites. 	 2. Oblations of water daily offered to the manes.  E. पितृ a progenitor, and यज्ञ sacrifice.
पितृयाण: पितृयाण n. (णं) The carriage of the manes, a car to convey holy persons after their decease to heaven.  E. पितृ a progenitor, and यान a vehicle. पितरो यान्ति अनेन या-करणे ल्युट् संज्ञात्वात् णत्वम् ।
पितृराज: पितृराज m. (-जः) An epithet of Yama.
पितृरुप: पितृरुप m. (-पः) An epithet of SĪVA.
पितृलोक: पितृलोक m. (-कः) The world or sphere of the manes: it is variously situated, but principally in I huva region or midheaven.  E. पितृ, and लोक world.
पितृवत्: पितृवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having a father living, &c.  E. पितृ, and मतुप् poss. aff.
पितृवन: पितृवन n. (-नं) A cemetery, a place where dead bodies are burnt or buried.  E. पितृ a deceased progenitor, वन a wood.
पितृवनेचर: पितृवनेचर m. (-रः) 	 1. SĪVA. 	 2. A goblin.  E. पितृवन a cemetery, in the seventh case, and चर who goes.
पितृवसति: पितृवसति f. (-तिः) A cemetery.  E. पितृ a deceased progenitor, and वसति an abode.
पितृवाक्पर: पितृवाक्पर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Obedient to parents.  E. पितृ, वाच् speech, पर attentive to.
पितृव्य: पितृव्य m. (-व्यः) 	 1. A paternal uncle. 	 2. Any elderly relation.  E. पितृ a father, व्यत् aff.
पितृव्रत: पितृव्रत m. (-तः) Who worships the manes. 	 n. (-तं) Worship of ancestors, obsequial rites.  E. पितृ, and व्रत obligation.
पितृश्राद्ध: पितृश्राद्ध n. (-द्धं) The obsequial ceremony of a father.  E. पितृ, and श्राद्ध the rite.
पितृष्वसृ: पितृष्वसृ f. (-सा) A father's sister.  E. पितृ father, and स्वसृ a sister, स changed to ष; the compound may also be पितुःष्वसृ, पितुःखसृ, and पितृस्वसृ.
पितृसन्निभ: पितृसन्निभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Fatherly.  E. पितृ, सन्निभ like.
पितृसामान्य: पितृसामान्य n. (-न्यं) Ancestors collectively.  E. पितृ, and सामान्य uni-versality.
पितृमू: पितृमू f. (-मूः) 	 1. Twilight. 	 2. A father's mother.  E. पितृ a ghost, and मू producing: see पितृपसू.
पितृस्थान: पितृस्थान m. (-नः) A guardian, a protector. 	 n. (-नं) The abode of the manes.  E. पितृ, and स्थान like, or in place of; or a place, an abode.
पितृस्थानीय: पितृस्थानीय m. (-यः) A guardian.  E. पितृस्थान, and छ aff.
पितृस्वस्रीय: पितृस्वस्रीय mf. (-यः-या) A maternal aunt's son or daughter.  E. पितृ, and स्वस्रीय sister's son, &c.
पितृहन्: पितृहन् m. (-हा) A parricide.  E. पितृ, and हन् who kills.
पित्त: पित्त n. (-त्तं) Bile, the bilious humour.  E. अपि certainly, दो to des-troy, or देङ् to nourish, aff. क्त, deriv. irr., or तप् to inflame, aff. क्त, and the radical letters transposed.
पित्तघ्न: पित्तघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Anti-bilious. 	 f. (-घ्नी) A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) 	 n. (घ्नं) Ghee.  E. पित्त bile, and घ्न what destroys.
पित्तज्वर: पित्तज्वर m. (-रः) Bilious fever.  E. पित्त bile, and ज्वर fever.
पित्तद्राविन्: पित्तद्राविन् mfn. (-वी-विणी-वि) Removing bile, causing it to flow.  E. पित्त, and द्राविन् what disperses.
पित्तरक्त: पित्तरक्त n. (-क्तं) Plethora. See रक्तपित्त.  E. पित्त, and रक्त blood.
पित्तल: पित्तल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Bilious, relating to the bilious humour. 	 n. (-लं) 	 1. Brass. 	 2. The Bhūrjapatra or Birch tree, of which the bark is used for writing upon, &c. 	 f. (-ला) A plant, (Jussieua repens.)  E. पित्त bile, ला to get, to resemble, (in colour,) aff. ड.
पित्र्य: पित्र्य mfn. (-त्र्यः-त्र्या-त्र्यं) 	 1. Paternal, ancestral. 	 2. Obsequial, relating to deceased progenitors. 	 m. (-त्र्यः) 	 1. An elder brother. 	 2. The month of māgha. 	 n. (-त्र्यं) The part of the hand between the forefinger and thumb, sacred to the manes. 	 f. (-त्र्या) 	 1. One of the lunar asterisms, called Maghā. 	 2. Day of full moon. 	 3. Ceremonies performed in honour of the deceased on the day of full or new moon.  E. पितृ a father, and यत् aff., रीङ् substituted for ऋ.
पित्सत्: पित्सत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) 	 1. Habitually falling or coming down. 	 2. Obtained, gained. 	 m. (-सन्) A bird.  E. पत् to fall or alight, शतृ aff., and desiderative form; the reduplicate syllable omitted.
पित्सल: पित्सल n. (-लं) A road, a path, &c.  E. पत् to go, Unādi aff. सल, form irr; or correctly पत् सन् पित्स + आधारे कलच् ।
पिदधत्: पिदधत् mfn. (-धन्-धन्ती-धत्) Covering, veiling, hiding.  E. अपि before, धा to have, श तृ aff. and the initial rejected.
पिधान: पिधान n. (-नं) 	 1. A covering, a cover or concealment. 	 2. A lid, a top or cover. 	 3. A sheath. 	 4. A wrapper, a cloak, &c.  E. अपि certainly, धा to have or hold, (from sight,) ल्युट् aff., and the initial rejected.
पिधानक: पिधानक n. (-कं) A sheath, a scabbard.
पिनद्ध: पिनद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 	 1. Clothed. 	 2. Accoutred. 	 3. Dressed. 	 4. Con-cealed. 	 5. Pierced.  E. अपि, and नह् to bind, aff. क्त.
पिनस: पिनस m. (-सः) Cold, catarrh: see पीनस.
पिनह्य: पिनह्य ind. Having put on or dressed.  E. अपि before, नह् to tie, ल्यप् aff.
पिनाक: पिनाक mn. (-कः-कं) 	 1. The bow of ŚIVA. 	 2. A trident or three-pronged spear. 	 3. The trident of ŚIVA. 	 4. A shower of dust. 	 f. (-की) A musical instrument, a sort of viol.  E. पा to preserve, (the world,) Unādi aff. आकन्, the radical vowel changed to इ, and नुम् augment.
पिनाकिन्: पिनाकिन् m. (-की) ŚIVA.  E. पिनाक ŚIVA'S bow or trident, and इनि aff.
पिन्यास: पिन्यास n. (-सं) Asafœtida.  E. अपि before, न्यस् (compounded of नि and अस् to throw,) to be given or placed in condiments, aff. घञ्.
पिपतिषत्: पिपतिषत् mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्) Inclined or addicted to falling repeatedly. m. (-षन्) A bird.  E. पत् to come down, in the desiderative form, and शतृ participial aff.
पिपतिषा: पिपतिषा f. (-षा) Wish or inclination to come down, to fall, &c.  E. पत् to fall, desid. form, अङ् and टाप् affs.
पिपतिषु: पिपतिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Disposed to fall or descend. 	 m. (-षुः) A bird. E. पत् to fall, desid. form, उ aff.
पिपविषु: पिपविषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to purify.  E. पू to be pure, desid. v., उ aff.
पिपासत्: पिपासत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) Thirsty, thirsting.  E. पा to drink, desid. v., शतृ aff.
पिपासा: पिपासा f. (-सा) Thirst.  E. पा to drink, in the desiderative form, अङ् and टाप् affs.
पिपासित: पिपासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Thirsty, athirst.  E. पिपासा thirst, and इतच् aff.
पिपासु: पिपासु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) Thirsty, athirst.  E. पा to drink, desid. form, and उ aff.
पिपीतकी: पिपीतकी f. (-की) The twelfth of the month Vaisākha, when giving away water is an act of merit.  E. पिपीतक the name of a Brāhman, said to have instituted the rite, ङीष् aff.
पिपीलक: पिपीलक m. (-कः) A large black ant. 	 f. (-लिका) The common small red ant.  E. अपि, पील to stop, ण्वुल् aff. and the initial rejected.
पिपीलिक: पिपीलिक m. (-कः) An ant. 	 n. (कं) A kind of gold.
पिपृच्छिषु: पिपृच्छिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to ask.  E. प्रच्छ् to ask, desid. v., उ aff.
पिप्पटा: पिप्पटा f. (-टा) A kind of sweetmeat.
पिप्पल: पिप्पल m. (-लः) 	 1. The holy fig-tree, (Ficus religiosa.) 	 2. A bird. 3. The sleeve of a jacket or coat. 	 4. A nipple. 	 n. (-लं) 	 1. Water. 	 2. A berry of the holy fig-tree. 	 3. A berry in general. 	 4. Sensual enjoyment. 	 f. (-ली) Long-pepper.  E. पा to preserve, aff. कलच् and the root reiterated.
पिप्पलक: पिप्पलक n. (-कं) 	 1. A nipple. 	 2. Sewing thread.
पिप्पलीमूल: पिप्पलीमूल n. (-लं) The root of long-pepper.  E. पिप्पली, and मूल the root.
पिप्पिका: पिप्पिका f. (-का) The tartar of the teeth.  E. पाय् to increase, aff. इक, deriv. irr.
पिप्लु: पिप्लु m. (-प्लुः) A freckle, a mark, a mole.  E. अपि certainly, प्लुष् to burn or inflame, aff डु ।
पिब्दमाना: पिब्दमाना f. (-ना) Noising.  E. अपि certainly, शब्द sound, and शानच् aff.
पियाल: पियाल m. (-लः) A tree, called in Hindi also Chironji, (whence it has been named Chironjia sapida, Rox. in the catalogue it is termed Buchanania, latifolia, Rox.;) in Bengal, commonly Piya or Piyal.  E. पीय a sautra root, to regard, Unādi aff. कालन्.
पिल: पिल r. 10th cl. (पेलयति-ते) 	 1. To throw, to cast or send. 	 2. To incite. चु० उभ० सक० स्रेट् ।
पिलुक: पिलुक m. (-कः) A tree: see पीलु.  E. पिल् to send, aff. कु, and कन् added.
पिलनी: पिलनी f. (-नी) A plant; see मूर्वा.
पिल्ल: पिल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ली-ल्लं) Blear-eyed. 	 m. (-ल्लः) A bleared eye.  E. पिल्ल considered as a substitute for क्लिन्न wet. &c.
पिल्लका: पिल्लका f. (-का) A female elephant.  E. पिल्ल blear-eyed, aff. कन्; the elephant's eye being usually moist.
पिव: पिव(इ,)पिवि r. 1st cl. (पिन्वति) To sprinkle, to wet or moisten. भ्वा० पर० सक० सेट्-इदित् ।
पिव mfn. (-व-वा-वं) Who or what drinks.  E. पा to drink, अच् aff.
पिवत्: पिवत् mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वत्) Drinking.  E. पा to drink, शत aff.
पिश: पिश r. 1st. cl. (पिंशति) 	 1. To be decomposed, to be reduced to consti-tuent parts. 	 2. To be organised. 	 3. To enlighten, to light. अवयवे समूहस्यांशभावे अक० दीपनायांसक० तुदा० मुचा० पर० सेट् ।
पिश(स) mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Free from sin. 	 n. (शं) Having many forms. E. पिश to organise, aff. क ।
पिशङ्ग: पिशङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Of a tawny or brown colour. 	 m. (-ङ्गः) Tawny, (the colour.)  E. पिश् to be a component part, अङ्गच् aff.
पिशङ्गक: पिशङ्गक m. (-क) An epithet of VISHṆU.  E. पिशङ्ग, स्वार्थे क aff.
पिशङ्गता: पिशङ्गता f. (-ता) Tawniness.  E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, पिशङ्गत्व ।
पिशङ्गिन्: पिशङ्गिन् mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि) Brown, tawny.  E. पिशङ्ग, and इनि aff.
पिशाच: पिशाच m. (-चः) A goblin, a fiend, a malevolent being something between an infernal imp and a ghost, but always described as fierce and malignant. 	 f. (-ची) A female imp, a she-demon.  E. पिश for पिशित flesh, and अश् to eat, aff. अण्, deriv. irr.; According to Vāchaspatya:--पिशितमाचामति आ + चम-बा-ड० पृषो० । also with कन् added, पिशाचक, पिशाचिका.
पिशाचकिन्: पिशाचकिन् m. (-की) KUVERA, the god of wealth.  E. पिशाच a demon, इनि aff., and कुक् augment; the treasures of this deity being guarded by Pīshāchas, and other malignant beings.
पिशाचद्रु: पिशाचद्रु m. (-द्रुः) A tree, (Trophis aspera.)  E. पिशाच a goblin, and द्रु a tree; the favourite haunt of these beings.
पिशाचवृक्ष: पिशाचवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The Śākhoṭa tree: see the last.  E. पिशाच, and वृक्ष a tree.
पिशाचभाषा: पिशाचभाषा f. (-षा) One of the lowest Prākrita dialects used in plays.
पिशाचसभ: पिशाचसभ n. (-भं) 	 1. An assemblage of goblins or fiends. 	 2. The place or hall of their assembly, pandemonium.  E. पिशाच a goblin, and सभा assembly, but neuter in this compound.
पिशित: पिशित n. (-तं) Flesh. 	 f. (-ता) Spikenard. 	 m. (-तः) 	 1. A goblin. 	 2. A cannibal  E. पिश् to be a component part, participial aff. क्त ।
पिशिताशन: पिशिताशन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Eating meat. 	 m. (-नः) A demon, a fiend, a cannibal.  E. पिशित, and अशन food.
पिशिताशिन्: पिशिताशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Eating flesh or meat, carnivorous. 	 m. (-शी) A goblin, a cannibal.  E. पिशित, and अश् to eat, aff. घिणुन्.
पिशील: पिशील n. (-लं) A shallow earthen dish.  E. पिस, ईल aff.
पिशुन: पिशुन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Cruel, wicked. 	 2. Vile, low, contemptible. 3. Stupid, a fool. 	 n. (-नं) Saffron. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. A spy, an informer, a tale-bearer, a slanderer, a traitor. 	 2. A name of NĀRADA. 	 3. A crow. 	 4. Cotton. 	 f. (-ना) A gramineous plant, “पिडिङ्शाक” (Trigonella corniculata.) 	 2. Indicating, making known, evincing. 3. Calumniating, back-biting. 	 4. unkind.  E. पिश् to be a part, उनन् Unādi aff., and the vowel unchanged.
पिशुनवचन: पिशुनवचन n. (-नं) Evil speech, abuse, detraction, slander.  E. पिशुन and वचन speech.
पिशुनवाक्य: पिशुनवाक्य n. (-क्यं) Evil speech, bad report, detraction, slander. E. पिशुन, and वाक्य speech.
पिष: पिष r. 	 7. th cl. (पिनष्टि) To grind, to pound, to bruise or powder. r. 10th cl. (पेषयति-ते) 	 1. To injure. 	 2. To give. 	 3. To be strong. 	 4. To dwell. r. 1st and 10th cls. (पेषति पेषयति-ते) To go or move. चूर्णने रु० पर० सक० अनिट् ।
पिष्ट: पिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Ground, pounded, bruised. 	 2. Clasped, (as the hands,) squeezed, rubbed together. 	 3. Kneaded. 	 n. (-ष्टं) 	 1. Lead. 2. The flour or meal of any thing that is ground.  E. पिष् to pound or bruise, aff. क्त.
पिष्टक: पिष्टक m. (-कः) 	 1. A cake made of the flour or meal of any grain. 2. A disease of the eyes, opacity of the cornea. 	 n. (-कं) Oil-cake. E. पिष्ट what is pound, कन् aff.
पिष्टप: पिष्टप mn. (-पः-पं) A world, a division of the universe.  E. पिश् to go, अप् Unādi aff., and टन् augment; or विश-कप् dev. irr. also विष्टप.
पिष्टपचन: पिष्टपचन n. (-नं) A boiler, a seether, a sauce-pan, a pan for parch-ing flour.  E. पिष्ट meal, &c. and पचन cooking.
पिष्टपशु: पिष्टपशु m. (-शुः) A type or effigy of a victim, made with flour.  E. पिष्ट, and पशु an animal.
पिष्टपाकभृत्: पिष्टपाकभृत् m. (-भृत्) A boiler.  E. पिष्ट meal, पाक cooking, and भृत् what makes.
पिष्टपाचक: पिष्टपाचक n. (-कं) A boiler.  E. पिष्ट, and पाचक what cooks.
पिष्टपूर: पिष्टपूर n. (-रं) Meal, made up into a sort of cake with clarified butter.  E. पिष्ट meal, and पॄ to complete, aff. अच्.
पिष्टपेषण: पिष्टपेषण n. (-णं) 	 1. Grinding flour, (literally.) 	 2. Vain repetition, useless occupation, (figuratively.)  E. पिष्ट, पिष् to grind ल्युट् aff.
पिष्टमय: पिष्टमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of meal or flour, &c.  E. पिष्ट that which is ground, मयट् transformative aff.
पिष्टमेह: पिष्टमेह m. (-हः) A kind of urinary disease.  E. पिष्ट, मिह् to pass as urine, aff. घञ् ।
पिष्टवर्ति: पिष्टवर्त्ति m. (-र्त्तिः) A small cake, made of barley, rice or pulse ground to meal.  E. पिष्ट meal, and वृत् to be, इन् aff.
पिष्टवर्त्ति: पिष्टवर्त्ति m. (-र्त्तिः) A small cake, made of barley, rice or pulse ground to meal.  E. पिष्ट meal, and वृत् to be, इन् aff.
पिष्टसौरभ: पिष्टसौरभ n. (-भं) Sandal.  E. पिष्ट ground, and सौरभ fragrant.
पिष्टात: पिष्टात m. (-तः) Perfumed powder, for scenting rooms, garments, &c. especially the scented dust, which the Hindus sprinkle over each other at the Holi or spring festival.  E. पिष्ट pounded, (saffron &c.) and अत् to go or be, aff. अच्.
पिष्टिक: पिष्टिक n. (-कं) A cake made of rice flour. 	 f. (-का) The meal of pulse steeped in water, peeled and ground.  E. पिष्ट ground, ठन् aff.
पिस: पिस(ऋ)पिसृ r. 1st cl. (पेसति) To go or move. r. 10th cl. (पेसयति-ते) 	 1. To go. 	 2. To be strong. 	 3. To injure or hurt. 	 4. To give. 	 5. To dwell. (इ) पिसि r. 10th cl. (पिंसयति) 	 1. To speak. 	 2. To shine. 	 3. To destroy. गतौ भ्वा० पर० सक० सेट् । दींप्तौ चु० उम० पक्षे भ्वा० पर० अक० सेट्-इदित् । वासे वलेच अक० वधे दाने गतौच सक० चुरा० उभ० सेट् ।

पीच: पीच n. (-चं) The lower jaw, the chin.

पीठगर्भ: पीठगर्भ m. (-र्भः) The cavity in the Pedestal of an idol.
पीठचक्र: पीठचक्र n. (-क्रं) A car or carriage.
पीठनायिका: पीठनायिका f. (-का) A girl of fourteen who personates Durgā on the occasion of the festival of that goddess.
पीठमर्द: पीठमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) 	 1. A parasite, a companion. 	 2. A dancing master who gives instruction in that art to courtezans.  E. पीठ a seat, and मृद् to rub, aff. घञ्
पीठमर्द्द: पीठमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) 	 1. A parasite, a companion. 	 2. A dancing master who gives instruction in that art to courtezans.  E. पीठ a seat, and मृद् to rub, aff. घञ्
पीठसर्पिन्: पीठसर्पिन् m. (-र्पी) A cripple, who moves about on a wheeled chair, &c.  E. पीठ a seat, and सर्पिन् who moves.

पीठिका: पीठिका f. (-का) 	 1. A bench. 	 2. A festival. 	 3. A chapter of a book.

A fault in the pronounciation of vowels. E. पीड् to give pain, aff. ल्युट्.

पीडाकर: पीडाकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Giving pain, afflicting, tormenting. Adj. Painful.  E. पीडा, and कर who makes.
पीडाकरण: पीडाकरण n. (-णं) Torturing, tormenting.  E. पीडा, and करण making.
पीडित: पीडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Bound, tied. 	 2. Pained, suffering pain or dis-tress. 	 3. Laid waste, destroyed, devastated. 	 4. Rubbed, chafed. 	 5. Squeezed, pressed. 	 6. Espoused: see पीडन. 	 7. Violated. 	 8. Op-pressed, harassed. 	 9. Eclipsed. 	 n. (-तं) 	 1. Injuring, harassing. 	 2. A mode of sexual enjoyment.  E. पीडा pain, इतच् aff. or पीड-क्त ।
पीडितम: पीडितम It is used as an indeclinable in the sense of “fast,” “closely.”
पीड्यमान: पीड्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Being pained or afflicted. 	 2. Suffering from. 3. Being squeezed or pressed.  E. पीड् to pain, pass. v., शानच् aff.
पीत: पीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Of a yellow colour. 	 2. Drank, quaffed. 	 m. (-तः) 1. Yellow, the colour. 	 2. Safflower. 	 3. A topaz, a yellow gem. 4. A medical plant, commonly Ātāich, (Betula.) 	 3. Saturated, steeped. 	 4. Drunk.  E. पा to drink, aff. क्त; imbibed, literally, or figuratively, by the eye sight, &c.
पीतक: पीतक n. (-कं) 	 1. Yellow orpiment. 	 2. Saffron. 	 3. Aloe-wood. 	 4. Brass. 	 5. Honey. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A sort of gentian, (G. Cherayta.) 2. The Ṭun tree.  E. पीत yellow, aff. कन्.

पीतकन्द: पीतकन्द n. (-न्दं) The carrot.  E. पीत yellow, and कन्द root. “ग्ॐजर” ।

पीतचन्दन: पीतचन्दन n. (-नं) 	 1. A yellow fragrant wood, considered as a yellow species of Sandal wood. 	 2. Turmeric. 	 3. Saffron.  E. पीत yellow, and चन्दन Sandal.
पीतचम्पक: पीतचम्पक m. (-कः) A lamp.  E. पीत yellow, चम्पक a flower, and कन् aff. of comparison; like the Champaka in colour.
पीतता: पीतता f. (-ता) Yellowness.  E. पीत, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, पीतत्वं.

पीतदारु: पीतदारु m. (-रुः) 	 1. A sort of pine, (P. Devadāru.) 	 2. Another kind of pine, (Pinus longifolia.)  E. पीत yellow, and दारु wood.
पीतदुग्धा: पीतदुग्धा f. (-ग्धा) 	 1. A cow tied up to be milked. 	 2. Any milch cow. E. पीत drank, दुग्ध milk.
पीतद्रु: पीतद्रु m. (-द्रुः) 	 1. A sort of Curcuma, (C. zanthorrhizon.) 	 2. A species of pine, (P. longifolia.)  E. पीत yellow, and द्रु a tree.

पीतफल: पीतफल m. (-लः) A tree, (Trophis aspera.)  E. पीत yellow, फल fruit.
पीतबालुका: पीतबालुका f. (-का) 	 1. Turmeric. 	 2. Yellow sand.  E. पीत yellow, and बालुका sand or dust.
पीतमणि: पीतमणि m. (-णिः) A yellow gem, a topaz.  E. पीत yellow, and मणि a gem.
पीतमाक्षिक: पीतमाक्षिक n. (-कं) The common Pyritic iron.
पीतमस्तक: पीतमस्तक m. (-कः) A small bird, (Loxia philippensis.)  E. पीत yellow, and मस्तक the head.
पीतमुण्ड: पीतमुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A gallinule.  E. पीत yellow, मुण्ड the head.

पीतमूलक: पीतमूलक n. (-कं) The carrot.  E. पीत, मूल the root, aff. कप् ।
पीतयूथी: पीतयूथी f. (-थी) Yellow jasmine.  E. पीत, and यूथी jasmine.
पीतरक्त: पीतरक्त n. (-क्तं) A yellow coloured gem, perhaps the topaz.  E. पीत yellow, and रक्त coloured.
पीतराग: पीतराग m. (-गः) 	 1. The fibres of the lotus. 	 2. A yellow colour. 	 n. (कं) Wax.  E. पीत and राग colour.
पीतल: पीतल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Of a yellow colour. 	 m. (-लः) Yellow, the colour. 	 n. (-लं) Brass.  E. पीत, and लच् aff.
पीतलक: पीतलक n. (-कं) Brass.  E. पीतल yellow, कन् added.

पीतशाल: पीतशाल m. (-लः) A tree, (Pentaptera.)  E. पीत yellow, and शाल the Sāl tree.
पीतसार: पीतसार m. (-रः) 	 1. Sandal. 	 2. A yellow gem, a topaz. 	 3. A tree, (Alangium hexapetalum.) 	 n. (-रं) A yellow sort of Sandal wood. E. पीत yellow, and सार essence.
पीतसारि: पीतसारि n. (-रि) Antimony.  E. पीत yellow, सार essence, aff. इन्.

पीताश्मन्: पीताश्मन् n. (-श्म) A topaz or any yellow gem.  E. पीत, and अश्मन् a stone.

पीव: पीव r. 1st cl. (पीवति) To be fat or corpulent. भ्वा० पर-अक० सेट् ।

पुक्कश: पुक्कश(स) m. (-शः- or -सः) A Chaṇḍāla, an outcaste: see पुक्कस.

पुङ्गल: पुङ्गल m. (-लः) The soul.  E. पुं man, and गल् to pervade, aff. अच्; also read पुद्गल.
पुङ्गव: पुङ्गव m. (-वः) 	 1. A bull. 	 2. A drug, commonly Mashāni. 	 3. (In compo-sition,) Excellent, pre-eminent.  E. पुं male, and गौ a cow, aff. अच्.
पुङ्गवकेतु: पुङ्गवकेतु m. (-तुः) An epithet of SĪVA.

पुच्छटि: पुच्छटि(टी) f. (-टि or टी) Snapping or cracking the fingers. E. पुच्छ-अटि वा ङीप् ।

पुञ्ज: पुञ्ज m. (-ञ्जः) A heap, a quantity, a collection.  E. पुं man, जन् to be born, aff. ड; also पुङ्ग and पुञ्जि m. (-ञ्जिः).
पुञ्जिष्ठ: पुञ्जिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Heaped, accumulated.  E. पुञ्जि, and स्थ who or what stays.
पुट: पुट r. 1st cl. (पोटति) To rub, to press, to grind or pound. r. 6th cl. (पुटति) To embrace, to intertwine. r. 10th cl. (पोटयति-ते) 	 1. To be or become small, or shallow. 	 2. To shine. 	 3. पुटभेद: पुटभेद m. (-दः) 	 1. The bend of, or an eddy in a river. 	 2. A city, a town. 	 3. A musical instrument.  E. पुट a contraction, and भेद breaking.
पुटिका: पुटिका f. (-का) Cardamoms.  E. पुटमस्त्यस्याः ठन् ।

पुटोटज: पुटोटज n. (-जं) A white umbrella or parasol.  E. पुट a covering, and उटज a house.
पुटोदक: पुटोदक m. (-कः) The cocoanut.  E. पुट a covering, and उदक water.
पुट्ट: पुट्ट r. 10th cl. (पुट्टयति-ते) To decrease, to diminish, to be or become small, low or shallow. चु० उभ० सक० सेट् ।

पुण्ड: पुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A mark made with sandal &c. on the forehead.  E. पुडि to adorn, aff. अच् ।
पुण्डरिन्: पुण्डरिन् m. (-री) A drug, commonly Puṇderīya.

पुण्डर्य: पुण्डर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A creeper, a medicinal plant, used as a remedy for diseased eyes.  E. पुडि to dissipate, (disease,) अर्य्य aff.
पुण्डर्य्य: पुण्डर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A creeper, a medicinal plant, used as a remedy for diseased eyes.  E. पुडि to dissipate, (disease,) अर्य्य aff.

पुण्ड्रकेलि: पुण्ड्रकेलि m. (-लिः) An elephant.  E. पुण्ड्र sugarcane, and केलि pastime.

पुण्यपुरुष: पुण्यपुरुष m. (-षः) A man rich in moral merit.
पुण्यप्रताप: पुण्यप्रताप m. (-पः) The efficacy of moral merit.

पुण्यलोक: पुण्यलोक m. (-कः) Heaven, paradise.  E. पुण्य virtue, and लोक a world.

पुण्यशील: पुण्यशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Virtuous.  E. पुण्य and शील having.

पुण्यात्मन्: पुण्यात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Holy, pious.  E. पुण्य, and आत्मन् spirit.
पुण्याह: पुण्याह n. (-हं) A holy day.  E. पुण्य holy, and अहन् a day.

(-त्त्री) A daughter. du. always, (-त्त्री) Son and daughter.  E. पुत्, and त्रा to preserve, the hell, (from,) aff. क; or पूज् to purify, aff. त्त्र; one त may be rejected in writing this word, and its derivatives, leaving पुत्र. पुत्त्र्य: पुत्त्र्य mfn. (-त्त्र्यः-त्त्र्या-त्त्र्यं) Belonging to a son, &c.  E. पुत्त्र, and यत् aff.

(-रं) 	 1. A town. 2. A fortress, a castle. 	 3. The female apartments. 	 4. A brothel. 5. A house. 	 6. Pāṭaliputra or modern Pātna. 	 7. The body. 8. The calyx of a flower, or any receptacle or cup formed of leaves. 9. Skin. 	 10. An upper story. 	 11. A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.) m. (-रः) 	 1. A sort of resin, “bdellium.” 2. Yellow barleria. 	 f. (-रा) 1. The east. 	 2. A perfume. 	 3. An epithet of the Ganges.  E. पुर् to precede, क aff.

पुराण n. (-णं) A Purāṇa or sacred poetical work, supposed to be compiled or composed by the poet VYĀSA; and comprising the whole body of Hindu theology: each Purāṇa should treat of five topics especially; the creation, the destruction and renovation of worlds; the genealogy of gods and heroes; the reigns of the Manus, and the transaction of their descendants: but great variety prevails in this respect and few contain historical or genealogical matter. There are eighteen acknowledged Purāṇas. 	 1. BRAHMA. 2. Padma, or the lotus. 	 3. Brahmāṇḍa, or the egg of BRAHMĀ. 4. Āgneya, or Agni, fire. 	 5. VAISHNAVA, or of VISHṆU. 	 6. Garu-da. 	 7. Brahmavaivarta, or transformations of BRAHMĀ, that is of KRISHṆA, identified with the Supreme. 	 8. SAIVA, or of ŚIVA. 	 9. Linga. 	 10. NĀRADĪYA. 	 11. SKANDA. 	 12. MĀRKAṆḌEYA, so called from a Muni of that name. 	 13. Bhavishyat, or prophetic. 	 14. Matsya, or the fish. 	 15. Varāha, or boar. 	 16. Kaurma, or of the Kurma or tortoise. 	 17. Vāmana, or dwarf. 	 18. Bhāgavat, or life of KRISHṆA, which last is by some considered as a spurious and modern work: the Brahmavaivarta is also of very modern origin. The Purāṇas ars reckoned to contain four hundred thousand stanzas: there are also eighteen Upapurāṇas or similar poems of inferior sanctity, and different appellations: the whole constitute the popular or poetical creed of the Hindus, and some of them or particular parts of them, are very generally read, and studied. 	 m.
