पुलिन्द: पुलिन्द m. (-न्दः) A barbarian, a Mlechchha, a savage or mountaineer, one who uses an uncultivated and unintelligible dialect.  E. पुल् to be large, Unādi aff. किन्दच्.
पुलोमजा: पुलोमजा f. (-जा) Sāchi the wife of INDRA and daughter of Puloman. E. पुलोमन् a demon so called, and जा born.
पुलोमजित्: पुलोमजित् m. (-जित्) INDRA.  E. पुलोमन् as below, and जित् who conquers.
पुलोमद्विष्: पुलोमद्विष् m. (-द्विट्) INDRA.  E. पुलोम, and द्विष् hostile; and other similar-compounds.
पुलोमन्: पुलोमन् m. (-मा) The name of a demon, the father-in-law of INDRA
पुलोमभिद्: पुलोमभिद् m. (-भित्) INDRA.  E. पुलोम, and भिद् to tear or destroy; the god. destroyed his father-in-law to prevent his curse, for the violation of his daughter.
पुलोमारि: पुलोमारि m. (-रिः) The god INDRA.  E. पुलोम the demon PULOMA, and अरि enemy.
पुल्कस: पुल्कस m. (-सः) An impure and degraded tribe born of the Brāhmana by Kshetriya female.
पुल्ल: पुल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) Expanded, full-blown or spread. 	 n. (-ल्लं) A flower. E. पुल् to be large, aff. क्त, form irr.: see फुल्ल.
पुल्वघ: पुल्वघ m. (-घः) A sort of deer who can eat much.  E. पुरु much, अत्ति from अद् to eat, aff. अच्; र being interchanged with ल ।
पुष: पुष r. 1st cl. (पोषति) पुष्टौ भ्वा० पर० अक० सेट् । 4th cl. (पुष्यति) and 9th cl. (पुष्णाति) 	 1. To cherish or nurture, to rear, to bring up. 	 2. To cause to thrive, to develop. 	 3. To support, to maintain, to bear. 4. To further, to augment, to enhance, to increase. 	 5. To get, to possess, to have, to enjoy. 	 6. To show, to display, to evince. 	 7. To be increased. पुष्टौ अक० पोषणे सक० क्र्या० प० सेट् । (इर) पुषिर r. 4th cl. (पुष्यति) पुष्टौ दिवा० पर० अक० अनिट् । r. 10th cl. (पोषयति-ते) 	 1. To put on, to wear. 	 2. To promote. 	 3. To maintain. धृतौ चु० उभ० सक० सेट् । With परि or सम् to cherish much, or bring up with care.
पुषा: पुषा f. (-षा) 	 1. Cherishing. 	 2. The lāngali plant: see लाङ्गलिकी.  E. पुष् to cherish, affs. क and टाप्.
पुषित: पुषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Nourished, nurtured.  E. पुष् to nourish, aff. क्त; also without the augment पुष्ट.
पुष्क: पुष्क n. (-ष्कं) To cherish,  E. पुष-बा० भावे क किच्च आद्य कस्य नेत्त्वम् ।
पुष्क(ष्य)लक m. (-कः) 	 1. The musk-deer. 	 2. A bolt, a pin.
पुष्कर: पुष्कर n. (-रं) 	 1. The sky, heaven, atmosphere. 	 2. Water. 	 3. A lotus, (Nelumbium speciosum, or Nymphæa nelumbo.) 	 4. The tip of an elephant's trunk. 	 5. The head of a drum, or place where any musical instrument is struck. 	 6. A drug, (Costus speciosus.) 	 7. The name of a celebrated place of pilgrimage, called Pushkara, about four miles from the city of Ajmere, consisting of a small town on the bank of a lake, whence its name. 	 8. The blade of a sword. 	 9. The sheath of a sword. 	 10. One of the seven great Dwīpas or divisions of the universe. 	 11. An arrow. 12. The art or science of dancing. 	 13. War, battle. 	 14. Intoxica-tion. 	 15. A cage. 	 16. A part. 	 17. Union. 	 18. Water. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A pond or lake. 	 2. A disease. 	 3. The Indian crane. 	 4. A sort of snake. 	 5. The name of a king, the brother of NALA. 	 6. The son of VARUṆA. 	 7. The Sun. 	 8. A kind or drum. 	 9. One of the principal clouds, that which occasions dearth or famine. 	 10. An inauspi-cious astrological combination or a lunation with an lucky day, and three-fourths of a lunar mansion. 	 11. An epithet of Krishṇa. 12. An epithet of Śiva. 	 13. Name of a mountain which is situated on the Pushkara Dwīpa.  E. पुष् to nourish, Unādi aff. करन्.
पुष्करकर्णिका: पुष्करकर्णिका f. (-का) A shrub, (Hibiscus mutabelis.)  E. पुष्करं पद्ममिव कर्णः पुष्पं यस्याः कप् कापि अत इत्त्वम् “स्थलपद्मिन्याम्” ।
पुष्करमूलक: पुष्करमूलक m. (-कः) The root of the Costus speciosus.  E. पुष्कर as above, and मूलक root.
पुष्करशिफा: पुष्करशिफा f. (-फा) The root of the lotus.
पुष्करस्रज्: पुष्करस्रज् n. du. (-जौ) The two sons of ĀshwiNĪ, and physicians of Swarga or paradise. 	 f. (-स्रक् or स्रग्) A chaplet of lotuses.  E. पुष्कर a lotus, and स्रज् a necklace or chaplet; wearing such.
पुष्कराह्व: पुष्कराह्व m. (-ह्वः) The Indian crane.  E. पुष्कर a lotus, and आह्वा an appellation; whence also any name of the lotus is applicable to the bird.
पुष्करिन्: पुष्करिन् m. (-री) An elephant. 	 f. (-णी) 	 1. A square or large pond. 	 2. A piece of water, a lake. 	 3. A pool, where the lotus does or may grow. 	 4. The lotus plant. 	 5. A female elephant.  E. पुष्कर as above, इनि possessive aff.
पुष्कल: पुष्कल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Excellent, eminent, chief, best. 	 2. Much, many 3. Full, filled, complete. 	 4. Near, approached. 	 5. Good, salutary. 	 6. Possessed of all good things. 	 7. Magnificent, splen-did. 	 8. Resounding, resonant. 	 n. (-लं) The mountain Meru. 	 m. (-लः) 	 1. The holy place Pushkara. 	 2. The son of Varuṇa. 3. A measure of eight Kunchis or sixty-four handfuls; in some places it means four times a double handful. 	 4. Alms to the extent of four mouthfuls of food.  E. पुष् to nourish, and कलच् Unādi aff.; otherwise पुष्कर as above, and ल interchanged with र.
पुष्ट: पुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Nourished, cherished, 2. Thriving, strong. 3. Rich, amply provided. 	 4. Complete, perfect. 	 5. Full-sounding. E. पुष् to cherish, aff. क्त.
पुष्टाङ्ग: पुष्टाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Fat, fattened.  E. पुष्ट, and अङ्ग body.
पुष्टि: पुष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 	 1. Cherishing, nourishing. 	 2. Increase, advance, thriving, prosperity. 	 3. Wealth, property. 	 4. Plumpness, fatness. 5. Richness, perfection. 	 6. One of the Mātrikās or divine mo-thers, nourishment personified.  E. पुष् to nourish, aff. क्तिन्.
पुष्टिकर्मन्: पुष्टिकर्मन् n. (-र्म) A religious ceremony performed for the attainment of prosperity.
पुष्टिका: पुष्टिका f. (-का) An oyster, a bi-valve-shell.  E. पुष्ट, and कन् added, fem. form.
पुष्टिकान्त: पुष्टिकान्त m. (-न्तः) GAṆEŚA.  E. पुष्टि prosperity, कान्त friend.
पुष्टिद: पुष्टिद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Nourishing, cherishing. 	 f. (-दा) 	 1. Increase, thriving. 	 2. A plant, (Physalis flexuosa.)  E. पुष्टि, and द what gives.
पुष्प: पुष्प r. 4th cl. (पुष्प्यति) To flower, to blossom. दि० पर० अक० सेट् ।

पुष्प n. (-ष्पं) 	 1. A flower in general. 	 2. The menses. 	 3. Expansion, expanding. 	 4. The vehicle or car of KUVERA. 	 5. A disease of the eyes, specks on the eye, albugo. 	 6. A topaz. 	 7. Gallantry, politeness, (in erotic poetry.) 	 f. (-ष्पा) The capital of KARṆA, or Bhāgalpur. 	 m. (-ष्पः) Blossoming, blooming, expanding.  E. पुष्प to flower, &c. अच् aff.
पुष्प(ष्य)रथ m. (-थः) A car or carriage for travelling or pleasure, or any purpose except war.  E. पुष्प a flower, and रथ a car.
पुष्पक: पुष्पक n. (-कं) 	 1. Calx of brass used as collyrium. 	 2. The chariot of KUVERA. 	 3. A disease of the eyes, albugo, specks on the eye. 4. A bracelet of diamonds or jewels. 	 5. A cup or vessel of iron. 6. A small earthen fire-place or furnace. 	 7. Green vitriol. 	 8. A flower.  E. कन् added to the last.
पुष्पकरण्डक: पुष्पकरण्डक n. (-कं) 	 1. Avantī or Oujein, or the grove in its vicinity considered as sacred to MAHĀDEVA. 	 2. A basket on which flower is collected.  E. पुष्प a flower, and करण्डक a basket.
पुष्पकरण्डिनी: पुष्पकरण्डिनी f. (-नी) Oujein: see the last.
पुष्पकाल: पुष्पकाल m. (-लः) 	 1. The spring. 	 2. The time of the menstrual flux.
पुष्पकासीस: पुष्पकासीस n. (-सं) The green sulphate of iron.  E. पुष्प a flower, and कासीश green vitriol.
पुष्पकीट: पुष्पकीट m. (-टः) 	 1. A large black bee. 	 2. Any insect affecting flowers. E. पुष्प a flower, and कीट an insect.
पुष्पकेतन: पुष्पकेतन m. (-नः) The Hindu Cupid.  E. पुष्प a flower, and केतन a symbol.
पुष्पकेतु: पुष्पकेतु n. (-तुं) Calx of brass. 	 m. (-तुः) The god of love.  E. पुष्प flower and केतु mark or sign.
पुष्पगण्डिका: पुष्पगण्डिका f. (-का) Contrary purpose or effort of a man and woman.
पुष्पगिरि: पुष्पगिरि m. (-रिः) A fabulous mountain, the favourite resort of VARUṆA.  E. पुष्प a flower, and गिरि a mountain, the hill of flowers.
पुष्पवातक: पुष्पवातक m. (-कः) A bamboo.  E. पुप flower, and घातक destroyer; the stem decaying after the plant flowers.
पुष्पचय: पुष्पचय m. (-यः) 	 1. A quantity of flowers. 	 2. Gathering flowers.  E. पुष्प and चय gathering.
पुष्पचाप: पुष्पचाप m. (-पः) KĀMADEVA, the Hindu Cupid.  E. पुष्प a flower, and चाप a bow; who arms his bow with flowers.
पुष्पचामर: पुष्पचामर m. (-रः) 	 1. A plant, (Artemisia.) 	 2. A fragrant plant, (Pan-danus odoratissimus.)  E. पुष्प a flower, and चामर a Chowri, having a large bushy flower. वेत्रवृक्षे, मदनवृक्षेच ।
पुष्पद: पुष्पद mfn. (-दः-दा-द) Who or what gives flowers. 	 m. (-दः) A tree. E. पुष्प a flower, and द what gives.
पुष्पदन्त: पुष्पदन्त m. (-न्तः) 	 1. The elephant presiding over the north-west quarter. 2. A chief of the Gandharbas or Vidyādharas, attendant upons ŚIVA, to whom is ascribed the authorship of the “Mahimna Stotra”. 	 3. One of the Jinas or Jaina teachers. 	 4. A Nāga or ser-pent of the infernal regions. 	 m. dual. (-न्तौ) The sun and moon. E. पुष्प flower, and दन्त a tooth.
पुष्पदन्तक: पुष्पदन्तक m. (-कः) A chief of the Gandharbas.  E. कन् added to the last.
पुष्पदामन्: पुष्पदामन् n. (-म) 	 1. A garland of flowers. 	 2. A kind of metre.
पुष्पद्रव: पुष्पद्रव m. (-वः) 	 1. The exudation or saccharine matter of flower. 2. An infusion of flowers, as rose water, &c.  E. पुष्प, and द्रव oozing, distilling.
पुष्पध: पुष्पध m. (-धः) The offspring of an outcaste Brāhmana.
पुष्पधन्वन्: पुष्पधन्वन् m. (-न्वा) KĀMADEVA.  E. पुष्प, and धनु bow, अनङ् aff. otherwise पुष्पधनु; see पुष्पचाप.
पुष्पधारण: पुष्पधारण m. (-णः) An epithet of Vishṇu.
पुष्पध्वज: पुष्पध्वज m. (-जः) The god of love.
पुष्पनिकर: पुष्पनिकर m. (-रः) Throwing flowers.  E. पुष्प, and नि before, कृ to throw, अच् aff.
पुष्पनिक्ष: पुष्पनिक्ष m. (-क्षः) A bee.  E. पुष्प, and निक्ष who kisses.
पुष्पनिर्यास: पुष्पनिर्यास m. (-सः) Nectar of flowers.  E. पुष्प, and निर्यास extract.
पुष्पनेत्र: पुष्पनेत्र n. (-त्रं) The tube of a flower.
पुष्पन्धय: पुष्पन्धय m. (-यः) A bee,  E. पुष्प a flower, धे to drink, aff. खश्.
पुष्पपत्रिन्: पुष्पपत्रिन् m. (-त्री) The god of love.
पुष्पपथ: पुष्पपथ m. (-थः) The vulva.  E. पुष्प the menses, and पथिन् a road, अप aff.
पुष्पपुर: पुष्पपुर n. (-रं) Pātaliputra or Palibothra.  E. पुष्प flower, and पुर a city.
पुष्पप्रचय: पुष्पप्रचय m. (-यः) 	 1. Gathering fruit or flower, &c. in any way except by the hand. 	 2. Stealing flowers.  E. पुष्प, and प्र before, चि to collect, aff. अच्.
पुष्पप्रचाय: पुष्पप्रचाय m. (-यः) Gathering flowers with the hand.  E. पुष्प, and प्र before, चि to collect, घञ् aff.
पुष्पप्रस्तार: पुष्पप्रस्तार m. (-रः) A bed of flowers.
पुष्पफल: पुष्पफल m. (-लः) 	 1. Elephant or wood apple. 	 2. A pumpkin gourd.  E. पुष्प a flower, and फल fruit.
पुष्पबलि: पुष्पबलि m. (-लिः) An offering of flowers.
पुष्पबा: पुष्पबा(-वा)ण m. (-णः) An epithet of the god of love.
पुष्पभव: पुष्पभव m. (-वः) Nectar of flowers.  E. पुष्प and भव being.
पुष्पमास: पुष्पमास m. (-सः) 	 1. The month of Chaitra. 	 2. Spring.  E. पुष्प flower, and मास a month or season.
पुष्परक्त: पुष्परक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Dyed red with vegetable colour, as safflower, &c. 	 m. (-क्तः) A shrub, (Hibiscus phæniceus.)  E. पुष्प flower, and रक्त coloured, red. “सूर्य्यमणिवृक्षे” ।
पुष्परस: पुष्परस m. (-सः) The nectar or honey of flowers.  E. पुष्प, and रस juice.
पुष्परसाह्वय: पुष्परसाह्वय n. (-यं) Honey, nectar,  E. पुष्परस, and आह्वय a name.
पुष्परा: पुष्परा(ज)ग m. (-ज or गः) A topaz.  E. पुष्प a flower, and राग colour.
पुष्परेणु: पुष्परेणु m. (-णुः) The dust or farina of flowers.  E. पुष्प, and रेणु dust.
पुष्परोचन: पुष्परोचन m. (-नः) A plant, (Mesua ferrea.)  E. पुष्प, and रोचन pleasing.
पुष्पलाव: पुष्पलाव m. (-वः) A flower-seller, a garland-maker. 	 f. (-वी) A female flower-gatherer.  E. पुष्प, and लाव who cuts.
पुष्पलिक्ष: पुष्पलिक्ष m. (-क्षः) A bee.  E. पुष्प a flower, लिह् to lick, स aff.
पुष्पलिह्: पुष्पलिह् m. (-लिट्) A large black bee.  E. पुष्प, and लिह् to lick, क्विप् aff.
पुष्पवत्: पुष्पवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having flowers, flowery. 	 m. always dual. (-न्ती) The sun and moon. 	 f. (-वती) A woman during menstruation. E. पुष्प a flower, or expansion as at rising, &c. and मतुप् aff.
पुष्पवन्त: पुष्पवन्त m. dual. (-न्ती) The sun and moon.  E. पुष्प a flower, अव to prevent, झच् aff.
पुष्पवर्ष: पुष्पवर्ष m. (-र्षः) A rain of flowers, flowers cast from heaven upon a hero or demigod, or on any great occasion.  E. पुष्प, and वर्ष rain-ing; also पुष्पवर्षण, पुष्पवृष्टि, &c.
पुष्पवाटी: पुष्पवाटी f. (-टी) A flower-garden.  E. पुष्प, and वाटी a garden.
पुष्पवेणी: पुष्पवेणी f. (-णी) A garland of flowers.
पुष्पशकटी: पुष्पशकटी f. (-टी) 	 1. Raining flowers, on any great occasion of rejoicing in earth and heaven. 	 2. A heavenly voice.
पुष्पशर: पुष्पशर m. (-रः) KĀMADEVA, the god of love.  E. पुष्प, and शर an arrow.
पुष्पशरासन: पुष्पशरासन m. (-नः) KĀMADEVA,  E. पुष्प, and शरासन a quiver.
पुष्पशून्य: पुष्पशून्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Not bearing flowers, flowerless. 	 m. (-न्यः) The glomerous fig-tree.  E. पुष्प, शून्य void of.
पुष्पशालिन्: पुष्पशालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Flowery.  E. पुष्प, and शालिन् having.
पुष्पश्री: पुष्पश्री f. (-श्रीः) Abundance, or beauty of flowers.  E. पुष्प, श्री wealth.
पुष्पसमय: पुष्पसमय m. (-यः) Spring.  E. पुष्प, and समय a season.
पुष्पसायक: पुष्पसायक m. (-कः) The god of love.
पुष्पसार: पुष्पसार m. (-रः) The nectar, or honey of flowers.  E. पुष्प. and सार essence.
पुष्पस्वेद: पुष्पस्वेद m. (-दः) The nectar, or honey of flowers.  E. पुष्प, and स्वेद sweat, or exudation.
पुष्पहासा: पुष्पहासा f. (-सा) A woman during menstruation.  E. पुष्प, and हास who smiles.
पुष्पहीन: पुष्पहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Flowerless, not flowering. 	 f. (-ना) 	 1. The glomerous fig-tree. 	 2. A woman whose menstruation has ceased a barren woman.  E. पुष्प a flower, &c. and हीन abandoned.
पुष्पा: पुष्पा m. (-ष्पा) The district of Bhāgalpur or the name of its capital champā.
पुष्पाजीव: पुष्पाजीव m. (-वः) A flowerman, a maker of garlands.  E. पुष्प, and आजीव livelihood.
पुष्पाजीविन्: पुष्पाजीविन् m. (-वी) A flowerman, a maker of garlands.  E. पुष्प, आजीव livelihood, इनि aff.
पुष्पाञ्जन: पुष्पाञ्जन n. (-नं) The calx of brass used as a collyrium.  E. पुष्प a flower, and अञ्जन collyrium. “कोम काजल” ।
पुष्पाञ्जलि: पुष्पाञ्जलि mf. (-लिः-ली) Presenting a nosegay or flowers, held in both hands opened, and hollowed.  E. पुष्प, and अञ्जलि the hands joined and opened; also similar compounds, as कुसुमाञ्जलि, प्रसूनाञ्जलि, &c.
पुष्पानन: पुष्पानन m. (-नः) A kind of Spirituous liquor.
पुष्पाम्बुज: पुष्पाम्बुज n. (-जं) The Sap of flowers.
पुष्पायुध: पुष्पायुध m. (-धः) The god of love.
पुष्पावचय: पुष्पावचय m. (-यः) Gathering flowers.  E. पुष्प, and अवचय collecting.
पुष्पावचायिन्: पुष्पावचायिन् mf. (-यी-यिनी) A flower-gatherer.  E. पुष्प, and अवचायिन् who collects.
पुष्पासव: पुष्पासव n. (-वं) Honey.  E. पुष्प, and आसव spirit.
पुष्पासार: पुष्पासार m. (-रः) A shower of flowers.
पुष्पास्त्र: पुष्पास्त्र m. (-स्त्रः) KANDARPA, the Hindu Cupid.  E. पुष्प, and अस्त्र a wea-pon; pointing his darts with flowers.
पुष्पाहर: पुष्पाहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Who or what takes flowers.  E. पुष्प, and आहर who or what takes.
पुष्पिका: पुष्पिका f. (-का) 	 1. The tartar of the teeth. 	 2. The mucus of the glans penis, or urethra. 	 3. The concluding words of a chapter. E. पुष्प a flower, कन् aff. of comparison, fem. form.
पुष्पिणी: पुष्पिणी f. (-णी) A woman in her courses.
पुष्पित: पुष्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Flowered, in flower. 	 2. Florid, flowery. 3. Completely manifested, fully developed. 	 f. (-ता) A woman during menstruation.  E. पुष्प, and इतच् aff.
पुष्पिताग्रा: पुष्पिताग्रा f. (-ग्रा) A form of metre, a mixed kind and a variety of the Aupachandasika; the line consisting of four or six short syllables, a pyrrhic or a dactyl, two trochees and a spondee.
पुष्पिन्: पुष्पिन् mfn. (-ष्पो-ष्पिणी-ष्पि) 	 1. Flowering, bearing flowers. 	 2. A bound-ing in flowers.  E. पुष्प, and इनि aff.
पुष्पेषु: पुष्पेषु m. (-षुः) KĀMADEVA.  E. पुष्प, and इषु an arrow.
पुष्पोद्गम: पुष्पोद्गम m. (-मः) The appearance of flowers.
पुष्प्य: पुष्प्य r. 4th. cl. (पुष्प्यति) To blossom. विकशने कण्ड्रा० पाठान्तरम् सक० सेट् ।.
पुष्य: पुष्य mf. (-ष्यः-ष्या) 	 1. The eighth lunar asterism, comprising three stars, of which one is the Cancer. 	 2. The month Pous, (Dec. and Jan.) 	 3. The Kali, or fourth age.  E. पुष् to nourish, aff. क्यप्.
पुष्यरथ: पुष्यरथ m. (-थः) Any sort of car or carriage, except a war chariot. E. पुष्य the asterism, and रथ a car; also पुष्परथ.
पुष्यलक: पुष्यलक m. (-कः) 	 1. The musk-deer. 	 2. A pin, a bolt, stake. 	 3. A naked mendicant. It is read in some places पुष्कलक.
पुस: पुस r. 10th cl. (पोषयति-ते) 	 1. To rub. 	 2. To damage, चुरा० उभ० सक० सेट् ।
पुस्त: पुस्त r. 10th cl. (पुस्तयति-ते) 	 1. To respect. 	 2. To disregard, to treat with disrespect. 	 3. To bind. 	 4. To smear. चु० उभ० सक० सेट् ।

पुस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 	 1. Filled. 	 2. Covered. 	 n. (-स्तं) 	 1. Smearing, anoin-ting, painting, plastering, &c. 	 2. Any thing made of metal, wood or clay, &c. 	 nf. (-स्तं-स्ती) A book, a manuscript.  E. पुस्त to bind, अच् aff.
पुस्तक: पुस्तक nf. (-कं-की) A book, a manuscript.  E. कन् added to the last.
पुस्तकमुद्रा: पुस्तकमुद्रा f. (-द्रा) A particular position of fingers in religious worship. The posture is thus defined in Tantra sāra. viz.--“वाम मुष्टिं स्वाभिमुखीं कृत्वा पुस्तकमुद्रिका” ।
पुस्तकर्मन्: पुस्तकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Plastering, painting, &c. see पुस्त.  E. पुस्त as above, कर्म्मन् business.
पुस्तकर्म्मन्: पुस्तकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Plastering, painting, &c. see पुस्त.  E. पुस्त as above, कर्म्मन् business.
पुस्फुस: पुस्फुस m. (-सः) The lungs; also पुप्फुस and फुप्फुस.
पू: पू(ङ)पूङ् r. 1st cl. (पवते)शोधे भ्वा० आ० सक० सेट् । (ञ)पूञ् r. 9th cl. (पुनाति-पुनीते) 	 1. To purify, to cleanse, physically or metaphorically. 	 2. To clean from chaff, to winnow. 	 3. To Discriminate, to discern. 	 4. To invent, to think out, to contrive. क्र्यादि० प्वा० उभ० सक० सेट् । r. 4th cl. (पूयते) To grow or become pure. दिवा० आत्म० सक० सेट् ।
पूग: पूग m. (-गः) 	 1. The betel-nut tree, (Areca faufel or catechu.) 	 2. A heap, a quantity, a multitude. 	 3. Disposition, property, nature. 4. The Jack-tree. 	 5. An association, a corporation. 	 n. (-गं) The fruit of the faufel, the betel-nut.  E. पू to cleanse, गन् Unādi aff.
पूगकृत: पूगकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Assembled, collected.  E. पूग, and कृत made.
पूगपात्र: पूगपात्र n. (-त्रं) 	 1. A betel-box. 	 2. A spitting-spot.  E. पूग, and पात्र a vessel.
पूगपीठ: पूगपीठ n. (-ठं) A spitting-pot.  E. पूग betel, and पीठ a stool; chewing the pān producing an increased excretion of saliva.
पूगपुष्पिका: पूगपुष्पिका f. (-का) Flowers and betel presented to the principal guests at a marriage festival.  E. पूग, and पुष्प a flower, कन् added.
पूगफल: पूगफल n. (-लं) The Areca-nut.  E. पूग, and फल fruit.
पूगरोट: पूगरोट m. (-टः) The marshy date tree, (Phænix or Elate paludosa.) E. पूग Areca, and रुट् to shine, to resemble, aff. घञ; also with कन् added पुगरोटक. “हिन्ताल वृक्षे” ।
पूगवैर: पूगवैर n. (-रं) Enmity against a number of men.
पूज्: पूज् r. 10th cl. (पूजयति-ते) 	 1. To adore, to reverence, to worship. 	 2. To present with. With सम्, 1. To pay respect to. 	 2. To present with. चु० उभ० सक० सेट् ।
पूजक: पूजक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Worshiping, a worshiper.  E. पूज् to worship, ण्वुल् aff.
पूजत्: पूजत् mfn. (-जन्-जन्ती-जत्) Worshiping, reverencing.  E. पूज् to wor-ship, शतृ aff.
पूजन: पूजन n. (-नं) Worship, worshiping: see पूजा. 	 f. (-नी) A sparrow.  E. पूज् to worship, and ल्युट् aff.
पूजनीय: पूजनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be worshiped or revered.  E. पूज्, and अनीयर् aff.
पूजयितव्य: पूजयितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be worshiped.  E. पूज् to worship, and तव्य aff.
पूजयितृ: पूजयितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Worshiping, a worshiper.  E. पूज् to wor-ship, तृच् aff.
पूजा: पूजा f. (-जा) Worship, culture, respect, homage of superiors or adora-tion of the gods.  E. पूज् to worship, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
पूजार्ह: पूजार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Worshipful, venerable, respectable, sacred. E. पूजा worship, अर्ह fit, deserving.
पूजित: पूजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Worshiped, adored, reverenced. 	 2. Ac-knowledged. 	 3. Endowed.  E. पूज् to worship, क्त aff.
पूजिल: पूजिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Venerable, respectable, worshipful, &c. 	 m. (-लः) A deity.  E. पूजा, and इलच् aff.
पूज्य: पूज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) Worshipful, venerable, fit for or deserving adoration, &c. 	 m. (-ज्यः) A father-in-law.  E. पूज् to worship, यत् aff.
पूज्यमान: पूज्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being reverenced or respected.  E. पूज् to worship, pass. v., शानच् aff.
पूण्: पूण् r. 10th cl. (पूणयति-ते) To accumulate, to collect or heap together. चु० उभ० सक० सेट् ।
पूत्: पूत् Ind. An imitative word expressive of hard breathing.
पूत्कारी: पूत्कारी f. (-री) 	 1. The capital of the Nāgas. 	 2. A name of SARASWATI.
पूत: पूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Pure, purified. 	 2. Threshed, winnowed. 	 3. Cleaned, cleansed. 	 4. Speaking the truth, sincere, honest. 5. Foul-smelling, stinking, putrid. 	 6. Guarded, defended. 	 7. contrived, composed. 	 n. (-तं) Truth, speaking truth. 	 m. (-तः) 	 1. A conch-shell. 	 2. White Kusa grass. 	 m. du. (-तौ) The buttocks. E. पू to purify, aff. क्त.
पूतक्रतायी: पूतक्रतायी f. (-यी) The wife of INDRA.  E. पूतक्रतु INDRA, ङीप् aff; in place of उ, ऐच् is inserted, and then changed before ई to आय.
पूतक्रतु: पूतक्रतु m. (-तुः) A name of INDRA.  E. पूत, pure, and क्रतु sacrifice.
पूतद्रु: पूतद्रु m. (-द्रुः) The bread-fruit tree, (Butea frondosa.)  E. पूत, and द्रु a tree.
पूतधान्य: पूतधान्य n. (-न्यं) Sesamum.  E. पूत, and धान्य grain.
पूतना: पूतना f. (-ना) 	 1. Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) 	 2. The name of a female demon killed by KRISHṆA, when he was but an infant on her attempting to take his life. 	 3. A disease, atrophy and wasting in a child, ascribed to the malignant operations of the female fiend PŪTANĀ.  E. पूत् to be pure, nominal verb, युच् aff.
पूतनारि: पूतनारि m. (-रिः) KRISHṆA.  E. पूतना a female fiend, and अरि the foe.
पूतनासूदन: पूतनासूदन m. (-नः) KRISHṆA.  E. पूतना, and सूदन destroyer.
पूतनाहन्: पूतनाहन् m. (-हा) KRISHṆA.  E. पूतना, and हन् who kills: see the three words preceding.
पूतपाप: पूतपाप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Purified, freed from sin.  E. पूत, and पाप sin.
पूतपाप्मन्: पूतपाप्मन् mfn. (-प्मा-प्मा-प्म) Purified from sin.  E. पूत, and पाप्मन् sin.
पूतफल: पूतफल m. (-लः) The jack-tree.  E. पूत fetid, फल fruit.
पूतात्मन्: पूतात्मन् m. (-त्मा) 	 1. A saint, an ascetic, a pure or purified person. 2. A man of a cleanly person, or purified by ablution. 	 3. An epithet of Vishṇu.  E. पूत purified, आत्मन् spirit or self.
पूति: पूति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Purity, purification. 	 2. A stench, a stink, putrefac-tion. 	 3. Civet. 	 n. (-ति) 	 1. Filthy water. 	 2. Pus, matter. Adj. Putr-id, Stinking, ill-smelling.  E. पू to be pure, or पूय to stink, aff. क्तिच्.

पूति(ती)क m. (-कः) Grey bonduc, (Cæsalpinia bonducella, Rox.) 	 f. (-का) 1. A potherb, “पुंइशाक” (Basella lucida &c.) 	 2. A civet or pole-cat. Adj. Foul. 	 n. (-कं) Ordure, excrement.  E. पूति a stink, कन् aff.
पूतिकरज: पूतिकरज m. (-जः) A plant, (Cæsalpinia bonducella.)  E. पूतिक the same, रञ्ज् to colour, aff. अण्; also with the nasal retained, पूतिकरञ्ज “नाटाकरम्जा” ।
पूतिकर्णक: पूतिकर्णक m. (-कः) Fetid ulceration of the ear.  E. पूति, and कर्ण the ear, कन् added.
पूतिकामुख: पूतिकामुख m. (-खः) A bi-valve-shell  E. पूतिका a potherb, and मुख face, appearance.
पूतिकाष्ठ: पूतिकाष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A sort of pine, (P. devadāru.)  E. पूति purity, काष्ठ wood; also with कन् added पूतिकाष्ठक m. (-कः) The Sarala tree.
पूतिगन्ध: पूतिगन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Ill-smelling. 	 n. (-न्धं) 	 1. Sulphur. 	 2. Tin. 	 m. (-न्धः) Stench, fetid odour.  E. पूति a stink and गन्ध smell.
पूतिगन्धि: पूतिगन्धि mfn. (-न्धिः-न्धिः-न्धि) Ill-smelling. Adj. Stinking.  E. पूति stink-ing, गन्ध smell, and इन् substituted for the final.
पूतिगन्धिक: पूतिगन्धिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Ill-smelling, fetid.  E. पूति a stink, गन्ध smell, ठक् aff.
पूतितैला: पूतितैला f. (-ला) Heart-pea, (Cardiospermum halicacabum.)  E. पूति stink, तैल oil. “लताकट्की” इति भाषा ।
पूतिनस्य: पूतिनस्य n. (-स्यं) Fetid exhalation from the nostrils.  E. पूति, and नस्य nostril.
पूतिनासिक: पूतिनासिक Adj. Having a fetid nose.
पूतिपुष्पिका: पूतिपुष्पिका f. (-का) A variety of the common citron, (Citrus medica.) E. पूति stinking, and पुष्प a flower, कन् aff.
पूतिफला: पूतिफला f. (-ला) A plant, (Psoralea corilifolia.)  E. पूति stinking, फल fruit. “सोमराज्याम्” ।
पूतिफली: पूतिफली f. (-ली) A medicinal plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.)  E. पूति stink, फल fruit.
पूतिमांस: पूतिमांस n. (-सं) Dead or decayed flesh.  E. पूति, and मांस flesh.
पूतिमेद: पूतिमेद m. (-दः) The khayar tree, (mimosa catechu.)
पूतिवात: पूतिवात m. (-तः) The Bel, (Ægle marmelos.) 	 2. Foul air.  E. पूति a stink, वात wind.
पूतिवृक्ष: पूतिवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) A plant, (Bignonia Indica.)  E. पूति a foul smell, and वृक्ष a tree. “श्योनाक वृक्षे” ।
पूतिशारिजा: पूतिशारिजा f. (-जा) The pole or civet-cat. “खटाश” ।
पूती: पूती(ति)क m. (-कः) 	 1. A plant, (Cæsalpinia bonducella.) 	 2. The pole-cat or civet-cat. 	 f. (-का) A potherb, (Basella rubra, and lucida.)  E. पूति a stink or purity, कन् added, and the penultimate optionally long.
पूतीकरज: पूतीकरज m. (-जः) A plant, (Cæsalpinia bonducella) Also पूतीक, पूतिक, पूतिकरज पूतीकरञ्ज, or पूतिकरञ्ज. “नाटाकरम्जा” ।
पूत्यण्ड: पूत्यण्ड m. (-ण्ड) 	 1. The musk deer. 	 2. An insect with a fetid smell, the winged-bug. “गंँधोपोका”  E. पूति a stench, and अण्ड the testicle or any egg.
पूथिका: पूथिका f. (-का) A potherb; see पूतीक and पूतिक ।
पून: पून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Lost, destroyed.  E. पू to purify aff. क्त, deriv. irr. “पूञो विनाशे” पा० क्तस्य नः ।
पूप: पूप m. (-पः) A cake.  E. पू to purify, aff. पक् or यत् ।
पूपला: पूपला f. (-ली) A sort of sweet cake, fried with Ghee or oil.  E. पूप a cake, ला to get or be, aff. क.
पूपशाला: पूपशाला f. (-ला) A baker's or confectioner's shop.  E. पूप, and शाला a hall.
पूपाली: पूपाली f. (-ली) A sort of cake or biscuit, made of meal or barley, half-baked or fried.  E. पूप cake, आङ् before, ला to be or resemble, aff. क, fem. aff. ङीप्; also with कन् added पूपालिका; or पूपाय अलति, अल्-अच० गौरा० ङीष् ।
पूपिका: पूपिका f. (-का) A sort of cake, half-baked or fried in oil or Ghee. E. पूप a cake, कन् aff. of comparison, fem. form.
पूय: पूय(ई)पूयी r. 1st cl. (पूयते) 	 1. To split or cleave. 	 2. To stink. दुर्गन्धे अक० भेदने विशरणेच सक० दिवा० आत्म० सेट् ।
पूय n. (-यं) Pus, matter, discharge from an ulcer, sore or wound, E. पूय् to stink, aff. अच्.
पूयन: पूयन n. (-नं) Pus, discharge from a wound or sore.  E. पूय to stink, aff. ल्युट् ।
पूयरक्त: पूयरक्त n. (-क्तं) 	 1. Ichor, sanies. 	 2. Discharge of sanies from the nostrils. m. (-क्तः) A kind of disease of the nose.  E. पूय, and रक्त blood.
पूयशोणित: पूयशोणित n. (-तं) Ichor, sanies.  E. पूय, and शोणित blood.
पूयारि: पूयारि m. (-रिः) The Nimba tree, (Melia azadirachta.)  E. पूय pus, and अरि inimical; the leaves being used to produce discussion, or the absorption of matter that has formed.
पूयालस: पूयालस m. (-सः) 	 1. Suppuration at the joints, white swelling. 	 2. Mat-ter in the eye.  E. पूय, and अलस idle.
पूर: पूर r. 4th cl. (ई) पूरी (पूर्य्यते) 1. To satisfy. 	 2. To fill. 	 3. To be satisfied. 4. To be full. दिवा० आत्म० सक० सेट् । r. 10th cl. (पूरयति-ते) 	 1. To satisfy. 	 2. To fill out. 	 3. To fill with wind, to blow. 	 4. To cover, to surround. 	 5. To fill with sound, to make resonant. 	 6. To inten-sify, to strengthen. चु० उभ० सक० सेट् । With आ 1. To fill, to make full. 	 2. To blow. 	 3. To cover, to envelop, to intertwine. With परि To fill completely. With प्र, 1. To fill. 	 2. To enrich, to load with riches. With सम, To fill.

पूर mfn. subst. (-रः-रा-रं) A sort of unleavened cake, fried with Ghee or oil. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A piece of water, a large quantity of water, a lake. 	 2. The healing or cleansing of ulcers. 	 3. Making content, satisfying. 	 4. Filling. 	 5. Supply. 	 6. Swelling of a river or the sea. 	 7. A stream, a flood. 	 n. (-रं) A kind of incense. Adj. (-रः-रा-रं) Full, filled. पृथु: पृथु mfn. (-थुः-थुः-थ्वी-थु) 	 1. Large, great. 	 2. Smart, clever. 	 m. (-थुः) 	 1. The fifth monarch of the solar dynasty in the second age. 	 2. A name of Agni or fire. 	 f. (-थुः) 	 1. पृथुल: पृथुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Great, large. 	 f. (-ला) A medicinal substance, “Hingupatri.”  E. पृथु, and लच् aff.
पृथुशेखर: पृथुशेखर m. (-रः) A mountain.  E. पृथु large, and शेखर a crest.
पृथुस्कन्ध: पृथुस्कन्ध m. (-न्धः) A boar.  E. पृथु large, स्कन्ध shoulder.
पृथूदर: पृथूदर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Large-bellied, stout, corpulent. 	 m. (-रः) A ram. E. पृथु, and उदर the belly.
पृथ्वी: पृथ्वी f. (-थ्वी) 	 1. The earth. 	 2. A pungent seed. (Nigella Indica.) 	 3. A medical substance and condiment, perhaps the leaf of the asafœtida plant, “Hingupatri.” 4. The mother of the seventh Jina, or Jaina deified teacher, SUPĀRSWA. 	 5. Cardamoms. 	 6. Name of a metre. E. पृथ्वीभर: पृथ्वीभर m. (-रः) A species of the Atyasti metre.
पृदाकु: पृदाकु m. (-कुः) 	 1. A snake. 	 2. A scorpion. 	 3. A tiger. 	 4. A leopard or the small hunting leopard. 	 5. An elephant. 	 6. A tree.  E. पर्द to fart, Unādi aff. काकु; the vowel substituted for the semi-vowel.
पृश्नि: पृश्नि mfn. (-श्निः-श्निः-श्नि) 	 1. Small, short, thin. 	 2. Delicate, feeble. 	 f. (-श्निः) 1. A ray of light. 	 2. पृश्निगर्भ: पृश्निगर्भ m. (-र्भः) A name of KRISHṆA.  E. पृश्नि the wife of a saint incarnate in DEVAKĪ, and गर्भ the embryo.
पृश्निपर्णी: पृश्निपर्णी f. (-णी) A plant, (Hemionites cordifolia,) according to some of its synonymes, but in ROXBURGH'S Catalogue, Hedysarum lagopo-dioides.)  E. पृश्नि small, पर्ण a leaf.
पृश्निभद्र: पृश्निभद्र m. (-द्रः) A name of KRISHṆA.  E. पृश्नि DEVAKĪ and भद्र auspicious.
पृश्निशृङ्ग: पृश्निशृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. A name of KRISHṆA or VISHṆU, in that incarna-tion. 	 2. A name of GANEŚA.  E. पृश्नि small, and शृङ्ग a crest.
पृश्नी: पृश्नी f. (-श्नी) An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.)  E. पृष् to sprinkle, नि, aff. and ङीप् added.

पृषत्: पृषत् mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्) Sprinkling. 	 n. sing. (-षत्) du. (-षती) plu. (-षन्ति) A drop of water or any liquid. 	 mf. (-षन्-षती) The porcine deer. E. पृष् to sprinkle, Unādi aff. अति, or participial aff. शतृ; also पृषत् and पृषन्ति ।

पृषताश्व: पृषताश्व m. (-श्वः) Air, wind.  E. पृषत् the porcine deer, and अश्व a horse: see पृषदश्व ।
पृषत्क: पृषत्क m. (-त्कः) An arrow  E. पृषत् a deer, and कन् added; swift as a deer.

पृषदाज्य: पृषदाज्य n. (-ज्यं) Ghee mixed with curds, forming an oblation.  E. पृषत् sprinkling, and आज्य Ghee.
पृषद्वल: पृषद्वल m. (-लः) A horse of the wind.  E. पृषत् a deer, वलच् aff.
पृषन्ति: पृषन्ति n. (-न्ति) A drop of water.  E. पृष् to sprinkle, aff. झिच्; according to the best authorities, however, this word is the plural inflection of पृषत् ।
पृषाकरा: पृषाकरा f. (-रा) A small stone used as a weight.
पृषातक: पृषातक n. (-कं) An oblation of Ghee and curds.  E. पृष् sprinkling, अत् to go or be, अच् and कन् affs.
पृषोदर: पृषोदर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Having a spot or circle on the belly. According to Professor Turkabāchaspati:--पृषः दिवोदरं यस्य पृषो० तलोपः 1. Small-bellied, and पृषन्ति उदरे यस्य. 	 2. Air, wind. But in his other works this word is taken as a type of such irregular compounds. Accor-ding to others:--E. पृषत् a drop of any thing liquid, and उदर the belly, form irregular and special; the word is most commonly in use as a grammatical term, being the leading word of a class in which the formation of each is peculiar to itself, and being thence applied to designate the rule which comprehends the whole of the series.
पृषोद्यान: पृषोद्यान n. (-नं) A small garden.  E. पृषत्, and उद्यान a garden, त rejected.
पृष्ट: पृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Asked, inquired, interrogated. 	 2. Sprinkled. E. प्रच्छ् to ask, क्त aff. and the vowel substituted for the semi-vowel.
पृष्टहायन: पृष्टहायन m. (-नः) A species of grain. 	 mf. (-नः-ना) An elephant.
पृष्टि: पृष्टि m. (-ष्टिः) 	 1. A ray of light. 	 2. Touch.  E. पृष् to touch, &c. aff. क्तिन्. when it is derived from प्रच्छ्-क्तिन् it means “Inquiry” and when formed from पृष् कर्तरि क्तिच् it signifies “the back” or “at the side of.
पृष्ट्वा: पृष्ट्वा Ind. Having asked.  E. प्रच्छ् to ask, क्त्वाच् aff.
पृष्ठ: पृष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) 	 1. The back. 	 2. The rear, the last, the back or hinder part of any thing. 	 3. The surface or superficies. 	 4. The back or the other side, (as of a document.) 	 5. The flat roof of a house.  E. पृष् to sprinkle, Unādi aff. थक् ।
पृष्ठगोप: पृष्ठगोप m. (-पः) A soldier who protects the rear of a warrior while he is fighting.
पृष्ठग्रन्थि: पृष्ठग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) A hump on the back.  E. पृष्ठ the back, ग्रन्थि a knot.
पृष्ठचक्षुस्: पृष्ठचक्षुस् m. (-क्षुः) A crab. According to Vāchaspatya:--A bear.  E. पृष्ठ the back, and चक्षुस् the eye.
पृष्ठतल्पन: पृष्ठतल्पन n. (-नं) The exterior muscles on the back of an elephant.
पृष्ठतस्: पृष्ठतस् Ind. 	 1. Behind, at the back of. 	 2. Backwards. 	 3. Secretly, covert-ly.  E. पृष्ठ the back, and तसि aff.
पृष्ठदृष्टि: पृष्ठदृष्टि m. (-ष्टिः) A bear.  E. पृष्ठ and दृष्टि sight, looking behind him.
पृष्ठफल: पृष्ठफल n. (-लं) Superficial contents of any figure.  E. पृष्ठ and फल fruit.
पृष्ठमांस: पृष्ठमांस n. (-सं) A fleshy protuberance on the back.
पृष्ठमांसाद: पृष्ठमांसाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) A backbiter, a talebearer, a slanderer.  E. पृष्ठ the back, मांस the flesh, अद् to eat, aff. अच् ।
पृष्ठमांसादन: पृष्ठमांसादन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) A backbiter. 	 n. (-नं) Backbiting, slandering. E. पृष्ठमांस and अदन eating: see the last.
पृष्ठवंश: पृष्ठवंश m. (-शः) The back-bone.  E. पृष्ठ the back, and वंश a bamboo.
पृष्ठवास्तु: पृष्ठवास्तु n. (-स्तु) The upper story of a house.
पृष्ठवाह्: पृष्ठवाह् m. (-वाट् or वाड्) An ox of burthen, or one in training.  E. पष्ठ and वाह् who bears: also प्रष्ठवाह् ।
पृष्ठवाह्य: पृष्ठवाह्य m. (-ह्यः) An ox of burthen, carrying any thing on his back. E. पृष्ठ the back, वह् to bear, aff. ण्यत् ।
पृष्ठशय: पृष्ठशय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Sleeping on the back.  E. पृष्ठ and शय who sleeps.
पृष्ठशृङ्ग: पृष्ठशृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A wild goat.  E. पृष्ठ the back, and शृङ्ग a horn, whose horn bends over towards the back.
पृष्ठशृङ्गिन्: पृष्ठशृङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) 	 1. A buffalo. 	 2. An eunuch. 	 3. A name of BHIMASENA. 4. A ram.  E. पृष्ठ the back, शृङ्ग a horn, and इनि aff.
पृष्ठ्य: पृष्ठ्य mfn. (-ष्ठ्यः-ष्ठ्या-ष्ठ्यं) Relating or belonging to the back. 	 m. (-ष्ठ्यः) A pack-horse. 	 n. (-ष्ठ्यं) A multitude of back bones.  E. पष्ठ the back, यत् aff.
पृष्णि: पृष्णि mfn. (-ष्णिः-ष्णिः-ष्णि) Small, short or thin: see पृश्नि. 	 f. (-ष्णिः) 	 1. The heel: see पार्ष्णि. 	 2. A ray of light.  E. पृष् to sprinkle, नि Unādi aff. deriv. irr.
पॄ: पॄ r. 3rd. cl. (पिपर्त्ति) 	 1. To fill. 	 2. To blow 3. To satisfy. जुही० पर० सक० सेट् । 9th cl. (पृणाति) To rear, to bring up, &c. क्य्र० भ्वा० पर० सक० सेट् । r. 10th cl. (पारयति-ते) 	 1. To nourish, to protect. 	 2. To fill. चु० उभ० सक० सेट् ।

पेटाक: पेटाक m. (-कः) A basket.  E. पेटा, and कन् added.
पेटिका: पेटिका f. (-का) A box, a basket.  E. पेटा and कन् added.
पेटी: पेटी f. (-टी) A small basket.  E. पिट्, aff. अच्, ङीप् being added.

पेरा: पेरा f. (-रा) A kind of musical instrument.  E. पि वा रे ।
पेरु: पेरु m. (-रुः) 	 1. The ocean. 	 2. The golden mountain. 	 3. The sun. 	 4. Fire. E. पा to drink, Unādi aff. रु ।
पेरोज: पेरोज n. (-जं) The turquoise: it is the Persian word.
पेल: पेल(ऋ)पेऌ r. 1st cl. (पेलति) To go or move. r. 10th cl. (पेलयति-ते) To shake, to tremble. कम्पे अक० गतौ सक० भ्वा० पर० सेट् ।
पेल m. (-लः) 	 1. A small part. 	 2. Going. 	 n. (-लं) A testicle.  E. पिल् to send, aff. घञ्, or पेल् to go, अच् aff.
पेलव: पेलव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 	 1. Delicate, fine. 	 2. Thin, slim, slender. 	 3. Soft. E. पेल, वा to get, aff. ड ।
पेलि: पेलि m. (-लिः) 	 1. One who goes. 	 2. A horse.  E. पेल, इन् aff.
पेलिन्: पेलिन् m. (-ली) 	 1. A horse.  E. पेल going, and इनि aff.
पेव: पेव(ऋ)पेवृ r. 1st cl. (पेवते) To gratify by service, to serve, to attend on.
पेशल: पेशल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Dexterous, clever. 	 2. Beautiful, agreeable, 3. Fraudulent, crafty. 	 4. Soft, smooth. 	 5. Tender, delicate. 	 6. Thin, slender.  E. पिश् to be a component part, अलच् aff.; also पेषल and पेसल ।
पेशस्कत्: पेशस्कत् m. (-कृत्) A sort of insect, a kind of wasp.
पेशि: पेशि m. (-शिः) The thunderbolt. 	 f. (-शिः or -शी) 	 1. An egg. 	 2. Split pease. E. पिश् to be a part, Unādi aff. इन्; also with ङीप् added in the fem, form पेशी, as below.
पेशी: पेशी f. (-शी) 	 1. The egg of a bird. 	 2. A blown bud. 	 3. Spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.) 	 4. A ball of flesh or meat. 	 5. A sheath, a scabbard. 	 6. A muscle. 	 7. The fetus shortly after conception. 8. A kind of musical instrument. 	 9. The name a river. 	 10. The name of a female imp or demon.  E. पिश् to be a component part, aff. इन् and ङीप् added; also पेशि ।
पेशी(शि)कोष(श) m. (-षः or शः) A bird's egg. “अण्डकोषेच” ।
पेश्वर: पेश्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Who or what grinds.  E. पिश् to grind, वरच् aff.
पेष: पेष(ऋ)पेषृ r. 1st cl. (पेषते) To resolve or endeavour diligently.

पैठर: पैठर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Boiled in a pot, (flesh, &c.)  E. पिठर a vessel, aff. अण् ।

Nature; in philosophy the passive or material cause of the world, as opposed to the active or spiritual; and in my-thology, a goddess, the personified will of the Supreme in the creation identified with Māyā or illusion, and in an especial manner the prototype of the female sex; hence it is the same with the Sakti or personified energy or bride of a deity, as LAKSHMI, DURGĀ, &c. in some systems Prakriti is considered the same with the Supreme Being. 	 2. The natural state or condition of any thing. 	 3. A radical form or predicament of being, an illusion, intelligence, consciousness, and the five elements, or Ākās, fire, air, earth, and water. 	 4. The five elements collectively. 	 5. Cause, origin. 	 6. A woman or womankind. 	 7. A mother. 	 8. An animal. 9. The male organ of generation. 	 10. The female organ of genera-tion. 	 11. A requisite of regal administration, of which seven are enumerated; the king, the minister, an ally, treasure, territory, fortresses, and an army: the corporations or companies of citizens are sometimes added, making an eighth class. 	 13. A form of metre, consisting of a stanza of four lines, each line containing twenty-one syllables. 	 14. (In arithmetic,) A given coefficient. प्रति: प्रति Ind. As a prefix to verbal themes it means,--1. In the direction of, towards. 	 2. In opposition to. 	 3. Back, in return. 4. Down upon. As a prefix to nouns not immediately derived from verbs it means,--1. Likeness, resemblance. 	 2. Rivalry. As a particle and prefix it means. --I. Substitution, (instead, in lieu;) as प्रद्युम्नः केशवात् प्रति. 	 2. Several order, (severally, each by each;) as वृक्षं प्रति सिञ्चति; प्रतिवेद each Veda; प्रतिदिनं every day; प्रतिछिद्रं each opening; प्रतिगर्भ every birth; प्रत्येक one by one. 	 3. Direction, (to, towards, upon;) as वृक्षं प्रति विद्योतते विद्युत्. 	 4. Beloning to, (as a part or portion.) 	 3. Exchange, return, (again, back again,) as तिलेभ्यः प्रति माषान् यच्छति. 	 6. A little, &c. as शाकप्रति, सूपप्रति. 	 7. Opposition, in place, as प्रतिसूर्य्यं against the sun, प्रतिवात against the wind. 	 8. With respect to, अनेकभार्य्यं, प्रत्याह. 	 9. In proportion to, as त्वं सहस्राणि प्रति 10. In the vicinity of, by the side of, as गङ्गां प्रति. 	 11. At the time of, as फाल्गुनं प्रति. 	 12. Concerning, as वह्निर्विवाहं प्रति कर्म्मसाक्षी.  E. प्रथ् to be famous, डति aff.; in the following compounds the final इ of प्रति is optionally long, before derivatives formed with घञ्, as प्रतिहार or प्रतीहार &c.

प्रतीवाप: प्रतीवाप m. (-पः) 	 1. Calcining or fluxing metals. 	 2. Throwing one sub-stance into another to alter its form or state. 	 3. Adding any thing to a medicine during or after decoction. 	 4. Mixing whey with milk. 	 5. A public danger or calamity, as a plague, &c. E. प्रति before, वप् to spread, aff. घञ्, whence the vowel of the prefix is lengthened.
प्रतीवेश: प्रतीवेश m. (-शः) A neighbouring residence, a neighbourhood: see प्रतिवेश ।
प्रतीवेशिन: प्रतीवेशिन mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) A neighbour, living in the neighbourhood. E. प्रतिवेश a neighbourhood, and इनि aff; also प्रतिवेशिन् ।
प्रतीहार: प्रतीहार m. (रः) 	 1. A door. 	 2. A porter, a warder. 	 3. An agreement for return of assistance, alliance, confederacy. 	 f. (-री) A female door-keeper; (though this word is a feminine in form, is not necessarily so in sense.)  E. प्रति severally, mutually, हृ to convey, aff. घञ्; also प्रतिहार ।
प्रतीहास: प्रतीहास m. (-सः) A plant, (Nerium odorum.)  E. प्रति before, हस् to smile, aff. घञ् ।
प्रतुद: प्रतुद m. (-दः) 	 1. A bird of game, a falcon, a hawk, or rather one that kills or strikes with his beak, including also the owl, parrot, crow, raven, peacock, &c. 	 2. An instrument for pricking. E. प्र before, तुद् to torment, (with the beak,) and क aff.
प्रतुष्टुषु: प्रतुष्टुषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) 	 1. Wishing to praise. 	 2. Wishing to prepare or make ready.  E. प्र before, ष्टु to praise, desid. v., उ aff.
प्रतूणी: प्रतूणी f. (-णी) Pain shooting from the rectum along the bowels.
प्रतूर्ण: प्रतूर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Quick, fleet.  E. प्र before, त्वर् to make haste, क्त aff.
प्रतोद: प्रतोद m. (-दः) 	 1. A long whip. 	 2. A goad.  E. प्र thoroughly, तुद् to tor-ment, aff. घञ् ।
प्रतोली: प्रतोली f. (-ली) A high street, the principal road through a town or village.  E. प्र before, तुल् to weigh, aff. अच् गौरा० ङीष् ।
प्रतोलीक: प्रतोलीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Having a high street, (a town.)  E. कन् added to the last.
प्रत्त: प्रत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 	 1. Given, presented. 	 2. Given in marriage, either betrothed or married.  E. प्र before, दा to give, aff. क्त, form special.
प्रत्तवत्: प्रत्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Giving, presenting.  E. प्र before, दा to give, क्तवतु aff.
प्रत्न: प्रत्न mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं) 	 1. Old, ancient. 	 2. Traditional, customary.  E. प्र for प्रगे here said to mean old, त्न aff. and गे rejected.
प्रत्यक: प्रत्यक Ind. 	 1. Subsequent, behind, following in time or place. 	 2. In an opposite direction. 	 3. Against. 	 4. In the interior. 	 5. Uniform, unmixed. 	 6. Western. 	 7. Formerly, in old days: see प्रत्यच् ।
प्रत्यक्पर्णी: प्रत्यक्पर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.)  E. प्रत्यच् uniform, and पर्ण a leaf. “अपामार्गे” ।
प्रत्यक्पुष्पी: प्रत्यक्पुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.)  E. प्रत्यच् uniform, पुष्प a flower. “अपामार्गे ।”
प्रत्यक्श्रेणी: प्रत्यक्श्रेणी f. (-णी) 	 1. A plant, commonly Dantī. 	 2. A plant, (Sal-vinia cucullata.)  E. प्रत्यक् western, and श्रेणी line or row. “मूषिकपर्ण्याञ्च ।”
प्रत्यक्ष: प्रत्यक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) 	 1. Perceptible, perceivable, present, cognizable by any of the organs of sense. 	 2. Distinct, clear, evident. 	 3. Direct, immediate. 	 4. Corporeal. 	 n. (-क्षं) Ocular evidence, apprehension by the senses, perception, (considered as a mode of proof. In Phil.) E. अक्ष an organ of sense with प्रति indicative prefix.
प्रत्यक्षम्: प्रत्यक्षम् It is used as an indeclinable in the sense of:--1. In the pre-sence of, before, 2. Publicly. 	 3. Immediately, directly, personally: also similar words as प्रत्यक्षेण and प्रत्यक्षात् ।
प्रत्यक्षज्ञान: प्रत्यक्षज्ञान n. (-नं) Knowledge obtained by perception.
प्रत्यक्षतस्: प्रत्यक्षतस् Ind. Evidently, perceptibly.  E. प्रत्यक्ष, and तम् aff.
प्रत्यक्षदर्शन: प्रत्यक्षदर्शन m. (-नः) A witness, an eye-witness.  E. प्रत्यक्ष what is present, and दर्शन seeing.
प्रत्यक्षप्रमा: प्रत्यक्षप्रमा f. (-मा) Correct knowledge obtained through perception by the senses.
प्रत्यक्षप्रमाण: प्रत्यक्षप्रमाण n. (-णं) 	 1. Ocular proof, evidence of the senses. 	 2. An organ or faculty of perception.  E. प्रत्यक्ष and प्रमाण proof.
प्रत्यक्षभूत: प्रत्यक्षभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Manifested, become visible.  E. प्रत्यक्ष and भूत become.
प्रत्यक्षभोग: प्रत्यक्षभोग m. (-गः) Enjoyment or use of any thing with the con-sciousness of the owner.  E. प्रत्यक्ष, and भोग enjoyment.
प्रत्यक्षवादिन्: प्रत्यक्षवादिन् m. (-दी) A Bauddha.  E. प्रत्यक्ष, and वादिन् who declares; admitting of no other evidence than actual presence.
प्रत्यक्षिन्: प्रत्यक्षिन् mfn. (-क्षी-क्षिणी-क्षि) Seeing, perceiving, conscious of what is perceptible.  E. प्रत्यक्ष perceptible, and इनि aff.
प्रत्यक्षीकरण: प्रत्यक्षीकरण n. (-णं) Making manifest or apparent.  E. प्रत्यक्ष, करण mak-ing, च्वि aug.
प्रत्यक्षीकृत: प्रत्यक्षीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Manifested, displayed, made present or visible.  E. प्रत्यक्ष and कृत made, च्वि aug.
प्रत्यक्स्रोतस्: प्रत्यक्स्रोतस् Adj. Flowing towards the west. 	 f. (-तः) An epithet of Narmadā, the river.
प्रत्यगाशापति: प्रत्यगाशापति m. (-तिः) A name of VARUṆA.  E. प्रत्यक् west, आशा a quarter, पति regent or lord.
प्रत्यग्र: प्रत्यग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) 	 1. New, fresh, recent. 	 2. Pre-purified. 	 3. Repea-ted.  E. प्रति before, अग्र first.
प्रत्यग्रता: प्रत्यग्रता f. (-ता) Newness, freshness.  E. तल् added to प्रत्यग्र; also with त्व, प्रत्यग्रत्वं ।
प्रत्यग्रथ: प्रत्यग्रथ m. (-थः) A country; also अहिच्छत्र ।
प्रत्यग्रवयस्: प्रत्यग्रवयस् n. (-यः) Youth.  E. प्रत्यग्र, and वयस् age.
प्रत्यङ्ग: प्रत्यङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) An organ of perception. 	 n. Adv. (-ङ्गं) On the body, or the limbs severally. 	 n. Subst. (-ङ्गं) 	 1. A minor member of the body, as the chin, nose, ear, &c. 	 2. A subdivision of science, &c. E. प्रति belonging to, अङ्ग the body.
प्रत्यङ्गिराः: प्रत्यङ्गिराः f. (-रा) A form of DURGĀ, one of the goddesses of the Tantrīkas.
प्रत्यङ्मुख: प्रत्यङ्मुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Facing the west.  E. प्रत्यञ्च, and मुख face.
प्रत्यच्: प्रत्यच् or प्रत्यञ्च् mfn. (-प्रत्यङ्-प्रतीची or according to some प्रत्यञ्ची-प्रत्यक्) 1. Behind or subsequent, following in time or place. 	 2. Turned away. 	 3. West, western. 	 4. Uniform, unmixed.  E. प्रति before, अञ्च् to go, aff. क्विप् or विच्; the neuter form is used as a particle: see प्रत्यक् ।
प्रत्यदन: प्रत्यदन n. (-नं) 	 1. Eating. 	 2. Food.  E. प्रति before, अदन eating.
प्रत्यनन्तर: प्रत्यनन्तर n. Adv. (-रं) Next in succession.  E. प्रति, अनन्तर without an interval.
प्रत्यनीक: प्रत्यनीक m. (-कः) An enemy. 	 n. (-कं) Injuring one who cannot retaliate. E. प्रति against, अनीक an army.
प्रत्यन्त: प्रत्यन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्त) Bordering, skirting, contiguous. 	 m. (-न्तः) The country of the Mlechchhas or savages.  E. प्रति about, अन्त the end.
प्रत्यन्तपर्वत: प्रत्यन्तपर्व्वत m. (-तः) A small hill near a mountain.  E. प्रत्यन्त skirting, and पर्व्वत a mountain.
प्रत्यन्तपर्व्वत: प्रत्यन्तपर्व्वत m. (-तः) A small hill near a mountain.  E. प्रत्यन्त skirting, and पर्व्वत a mountain.
प्रत्यभिज्ञात: प्रत्यभिज्ञात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Recognised, known.  E. प्रति, and अभि before, ज्ञा to know, aff. क्त ।
प्रत्यभिज्ञान: प्रत्यभिज्ञान n. (-नं) Recognition, knowing, recognising.  E. प्रति and अभि before, ज्ञा to know, ल्युट् aff.
प्रत्यभियोग: प्रत्यभियोग m. (-गः) A counter plaint or charge, an accusation brought against the accuser or plaintiff.  E. प्रति against, अभियोग accusation.
प्रत्यभिवाद: प्रत्यभिवाद m. (-दः) Returning a salute or obeisance, the benediction of a teacher.  E. प्रति (re), अभिवाद salute; also प्रत्यभिवादन ।
प्रत्यय: प्रत्यय m. (-यः) 	 1. Trust, faith, belief, confidence. 	 2. Oath, ordeal. 	 3. Cause, motive. 	 4. Usage, custom, practice. 	 5. Fame, celebrity. 6. Certainty, ascertainment. 	 7. Knewledge, apprehension. 	 8. A termination or an affix to roots and words forming derivatives and inflections, (in Gram.) 	 9. A dependent, a subject, 10. Instrument, means of agency, a helpmate or associate, applicable either to persons or things. 	 11. A householder who keeps a sacred fire. 12. Religious contemplation. 	 13. A hole.  E. प्रति again, against, to or towards, इण् to go, aff. अच् ।
प्रत्ययकारिणी: प्रत्ययकारिणी f. (-णी) A seal, a signet.  E. प्रत्यय confidence, and कारिणी causing.
प्रत्ययित: प्रत्ययित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Trusted, confidential.  E. प्रत्यय confidence, and इतच् aff.
प्रत्ययिन्: प्रत्ययिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Trusting, believing, having faith in.  E. प्रत्यय, and इनि aff.
प्रत्यर्थ: प्रत्यर्थ n. (-र्थं) 	 1. A reply, an answer, a counter-representation. 	 2. Oppo-sition, hostility. 	 f. (-र्था) Useful, expedient.  E. प्रति successive order, and अर्थ representation.
प्रत्यर्थिन्: प्रत्यर्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) 	 1. Hostile, inimical. 	 2. Opposing, contra-dicting, rejecting. 	 m. (-र्थी) 	 1. An enemy. 	 2. (In law,) A defendant. E. प्रति again, against (re), अर्थ meaning, intention, &c. इनि aff.
प्रत्यर्पण: प्रत्यर्पण n. (-णं) The returning of a thing.  E. प्रति back, अर्पण delivering.
प्रत्यर्पित: प्रत्यर्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Returned, restored, re-delivered.  E. प्रति again, अर्पित delivered.
प्रत्यवमर्श: प्रत्यवमर्श m. (-र्शः) 	 1. Counsel, advice, injunction. 	 2. Profound contem-plation. 	 3. A counter-conclusion.  E. प्रति and अव before, मृश् to advise, घञ् aff.
प्रत्यवमर्ष: प्रत्यवमर्ष m. (-र्षः) Patience, constant in pursuit or exertion.  E. प्रति, अव before, मृष् to bear, aff. घञ् ।
प्रत्यवसान: प्रत्यवसान n. (-नं) Eating.  E. प्रति and अव prefixed to षो to destroy, aff. ल्युट् ।
प्रत्यवसित: प्रत्यवसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Eaten.  E. प्रति, अव before, षो to destroy, aff. क्त ।
प्रत्यवस्कन्द: प्रत्यवस्कन्द m. (-न्दः) A special plea at law; admission of a fact, but quali-fying or explaining it so as not to allow it to be a matter of accu-sation.  E. प्रति against, अव before, स्कदि to go, aff. घञ्; also with ल्युट् aff. प्रत्यवस्कन्दन ।
प्रत्यवस्थातृ: प्रत्यवस्थातृ m. (-ता) An enemy.  E. प्रति and अव before, स्था to stay, to oppose or encounter and तृच् aff.
प्रत्यवस्थान: प्रत्यवस्थान n. (-नं) 	 1. Former state or place, in status quo. 	 2. Removal. 3. Opposition, hostility.  E. प्रति and अवस्थान situation.
प्रत्यवाय: प्रत्यवाय m. (-यः) 	 1. Sin. 	 2. Disappearance, either of what exists or non-production of what does not exist. 	 3. Reverse, contrary course or proceeding. 	 4. Disappointment. 	 5. Disarrangement.  E. प्रति and अव before, इण् to go, aff. अच् ।
प्रत्यवेक्षण: प्रत्यवेक्षण n. (-णं) Looking after, taking care of.
प्रत्यश्मन्: प्रत्यश्मन् n. (-श्म) Red chalk.  E. प्रति like, अश्मन् a stone. “गैरिके” ।
प्रत्यस्तमय: प्रत्यस्तमय m. (-यः) 	 1. The setting of the sun. 	 2. End, cessation.
प्रत्यहम्: प्रत्यहम् Ind. 	 1. In the morning. 	 2. Day by day, every day.  E. प्रति implying succession, and अहन् a day.
प्रत्याकार: प्रत्याकार m. (-रः) A scabbard, a sheath.  E. प्रति like, आकार form.
प्रत्याकलित: प्रत्याकलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Interposed. 	 2. Introduced, as a step in legal process.  E. प्रति and आङ् before, कल् to go, क्त aff.
प्रत्याख्यात: प्रत्याख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Removed, set aside. 	 2. Informed, apprised. 3. Discouraged, prohibited, forbidden. 	 4. Denied, refused. 	 5. Celebrated, notorious.  E. प्रति before, आख्यात said, declared.
प्रत्याख्यान: प्रत्याख्यान n. (-नं) 	 1. Rejection, refutation, disallowance, disregard. 	 2. Denial, refusal. 	 3. Reproach.  E. प्रति reverse, आङ् before, ख्या to say and ल्युट् aff.
प्रत्याख्येय: प्रत्याख्येय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. To be declined or refused. 	 2. To be refuted, denied, &c.  E. प्रति and आङ् before, ख्या to speak, यत् aff.
प्रत्यागत: प्रत्यागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Come back, returned. 	 2. Arrived at.  E. प्रति again, आगत come.
प्रत्यागम: प्रत्यागम m. (-मः) 	 1. Return. 	 2. Arrival.  E. प्रति, and आगम coming; also प्रत्यागमन ।
प्रत्यागार: प्रत्यागार m. (-रः) Former place or state.  E. प्रति, and आगार mansion.
प्रत्यादिष्ट: प्रत्यादिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Removed, set aside. 	 2. Informed, apprised. 3. Warned, cautioned. 	 4. Declared, (as from heaven.)  E. प्रति before, आदिष्ट shewn.
प्रत्यादेश: प्रत्यादेश m. (-शः) 	 1. Rejection, disallowance. 	 2. Information, apprising, informing. 	 3. Warning, caution. 	 4. Refusal, denial. 	 5. Putting to shame, obscuring. 	 6. Heavenly annunciation or declaration.  E. प्रति, आङ् before, दिश् to shew, aff. घञ् ।
प्रत्यानयन: प्रत्यानयन n. (-नं) 	 1. Bringing back, recovering.  E. प्रति, आङ् before, णी to lead, aff. ल्युट् ।
प्रत्यानिनीषु: प्रत्यानिनीषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Desirous of bringing back.  E. प्रति and आङ् be-fore, णी to bring, desid. v., उ aff.
प्रत्यानीत: प्रत्यानीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Brought back.  E. प्रति and आङ् before, णी to obtain, क्त aff.
प्रत्यापत्ति: प्रत्यापत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 	 1. Return. 	 2. Indifference to wordly objects.
प्रत्याम्नाय: प्रत्याम्नाय m. (-यः) The fifth member of a complete syllogism, (the repe-tition of the first statement).  E. प्रतिरूपतया आम्नायते प्रति + आ + म्ना-कर्मणि घञ् । प्रतिनिधित्वेन विधीयमाने ।
प्रत्याय: प्रत्याय m. (-यः) A toll, a tax.
प्रत्यायन: प्रत्यायन n. (-नं) 	 1. Marrying. 	 2. Setting.  E. प्रति + आ + इ-णिच् “णौ गमिर बोधने” पातञ्जल उक्तेः न गमादेशः भावे ल्युट् । बोधने, विश्वासजनने च ।
प्रत्यालीढ: प्रत्यालीढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Eaten. 	 n. (-ढं) A particular attitude in shoot-ing, the left foot advanced and right retracted.  E. प्रति and आङ् before, लिह् to lick, aff. क्त ।
प्रत्यावर्तन: प्रत्यावर्त्तन n. (-नं) Returning, coming back.  E. प्रति and आङ् before, वृत् to be, ल्युट् aff.
प्रत्यावर्त्तन: प्रत्यावर्त्तन n. (-नं) Returning, coming back.  E. प्रति and आङ् before, वृत् to be, ल्युट् aff.
प्रत्यावृत्त: प्रत्यावृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Returned, come back.  E. प्रति and आङ् before, वृत् to be, क्त aff.
प्रत्याशा: प्रत्याशा f. (-शा) Hope, expectation, desire.  E. प्रति specific, and आशा hope.
प्रत्याशिन्: प्रत्याशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Hoping, expecting.  E. प्रत्याशा, and इनि aff.
प्रत्यासङ्कलित: प्रत्यासङ्कलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Added to. 	 2. Ascertained, determined. E. प्रति and आङ् before, सङ्कलित added.

प्रमाण: प्रमाण n. (-णं) 	 1. Cause, motive. 	 2. Limit. 	 3. Proof, testimony, authority. 4. A scripture, a work of sacred authority. 	 5. Measure, (whether of weight, length or capacity.) 	 6. Magnitude, extent. 	 7. Standard, authority. 	 8. Correct knowledge, accurate perception, (in logic.) 	 9. Unity. 	 10. Quantity. 	 11. A speaker of the truth. 	 12. Always, eter-nal. 	 13. A title of VISHṆU. 	 14. Principal, capital.  E. प्र before, मा to measure, aff. ल्युट्; that by which all is measured; this word is gener-ally restricted to the singular number, as वेदाः प्रमाणं the Vedas are the authority; it is also confined to the neuter gender, as पुत्त्रः प्रमाणं the boy is a witness; some exceptions occur however, as प्रमाणः पुरुषः, प्रमाणा स्त्री the man witness, the woman witness; and in the following rule, प्रत्यक्षानुमानोपमानशब्दाः प्रमाणानि perception, inference, comparison, and sound, are proofs. According to the Naiyāyikas अनुपलब्धि or non-perception and अर्थापत्ति or the inference from cir-cumstances of the Mimānsakas being exempted by them; the Sānkhys recognize प्रत्थक्ष, अनुमान and शब्द only.

प्रस्विन्न: प्रस्विन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 	 1. Perspiring, covered with perspiration. 	 2. Heated, sweated.  E. प्र before, स्विद् to sweat, क्त aff.
प्रस्वेद: प्रस्वेद m. (-दः) Great or excessive perspiration.  E. प्र intensitive, स्वेद sweat.
प्रस्वेदित: प्रस्वेदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Perspiring, sweating. 	 2. Heated, sweated. 	 3. Hot, causing perspiration.  E. प्र before, ष्विद् to sweat, क्त aff.
प्रस्वेदितवत्: प्रस्वेदितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत) Suffering or producing perspiration. E. प्र before, ष्विद् to sweat, क्तवतु aff.
प्रहत: प्रहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Struck, wounded, killed. 	 2. Repelled, repulsed, overcome, defeated. 	 3. Spread, expanded. 	 4. Contiguous, bound-ing, limitative. 	 5. Learned, accomplished. 	 6. Beaten, frequented, (as a path). 	 7. Beaten, (as a drum).  E. प्र again and हत struck, injured.
प्रहर: प्रहर m. (-रः) A watch, an 8th part of the day, or a division compri-sing about three hours.  E. प्र before, ह to take, अप् aff.
प्रहरण: प्रहरण n. (-णं) 	 1. A weapon. 	 2. A covered car, a litter for women or any litter or small covered car for diversion. 	 3. War, battle. 	 4. Strik-ing, killing. 	 5. Assailing, attacking. 	 6. Removing, expelling.  E. प्र before, हृ to take, aff. ल्युट् ।
प्रहरणकलिका: प्रहरणकलिका f. (-का) A species of the Sarkari metre.
प्रहरिन्: प्रहरिन् m. (-री) A watchman, a bellman.  E. प्रहर a watch, and इनि aff.
प्रहरिष्यत्: प्रहरिष्यत् mfn. (-ष्यन्-ष्यन्ती-ष्यत्) Taking, intending or wishing to take. E. प्र, हृ to take, with a future sense, शतृ aff.
प्रहर्तृ: प्रहर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-त्त्री-र्त्तृ) 	 1. Striking, a striker, a combatant. 	 2. Fighting. 3. Shooting.  E. प्र before, हृ to take, तृच् aff.
प्रहर्त्तृ: प्रहर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-त्त्री-र्त्तृ) 	 1. Striking, a striker, a combatant. 	 2. Fighting. 3. Shooting.  E. प्र before, हृ to take, तृच् aff.
प्रहर्ष: प्रहर्ष m. (-र्षः) 	 1. Delight, joy, rapture, exultation. 	 2. Erection of the male organ.  E. प्र before, हृष् to rejoice, णिच्-ल्यु aff.
प्रहर्षण: प्रहर्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. Happy, delighted. 	 2. Delighting. 	 m. (-णः) The planet Mercury, or its ruler. 	 f. (-णी) 	 1. Turmeric. 	 2. A form of metre.  E. प्र before, हृ to rejoice, aff. ल्युट् ।
प्रहर्षिणी: प्रहर्षिणी f. (-णी) A species of the Atijagati metre.
प्रहर्षित: प्रहर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Delighted, very happy.  E. प्र before, हृष् to rejoice, क्त aff.
प्रहसत्: प्रहसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) Laughing, laughing heartily. 	 f. (-न्ती) Ara-bian jasmine.  E. प्र before, हस् to smile, aff. शतृ, fem. aff. ङीप् ।
प्रहसन: प्रहसन n. (-नं) 	 1. Loud, violent or hearty laughter. 	 2. Mirth, merri-ment. 	 3. Sarcasm, satire, as a branch of rhetorical composition. 	 4. Reproof, ridicule, irony. 	 5. A farce, a comedy. It is thus defined in Sāhitya Darpana:--भाणवत् सन्धिसन्ध्यङ्गलास्याङ्गाङ्कैर्विनिर्मितम् । भवेत् प्रहसनं वृतं निन्द्यानां कविकल्पितम् ।  E. प्र before, हस् to laugh, aff. ल्युट् ।
प्रहसन्ती: प्रहसन्ती f. (-न्ती) 	 1. A kind of Jasmine. 	 2. A large fire-pan.  E. प्र + हस्-शतृ-ङीप् ।
प्रहसित: प्रहसित n. (-तं) Laughter, mirth.  E. प्र and हस् to laugh, क्त aff.
प्रहस्त: प्रहस्त m. (-स्तः) 	 1. The oped hand with the fingers extended. 	 2. Name of one of the generals of Rāvana.  E. प्र exchanging, हस्त the hand.
प्रहाणि: प्रहाणि f. (-णिः) 	 1. Abandoning. 	 2. Want, deficiency.  E. प्र + हा-णि-णत्वम् ।
प्रहापण: प्रहापण n. (-णं) Driving away, forced abandonment or departure.  E. प्र before, हा to quit, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
प्रहार: प्रहार m. (-रः) 	 1. Striking. 	 2. Wounding, killing. 	 3. A blow, a knock, a stroke. 	 4. A cut, a thrust. 	 5. A kick. 	 6. Suiting, fitting.  E. प्र before, हृ to take, aff. घञ् ।
प्रहारण: प्रहारण n. (-णं) A desirable gift.  E. प्र before, हृ to take, aff. ल्युट्; also प्रवारण ।
प्रहारार्त: प्रहारार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Bruised, wounded, hurt by a blow. 	 n. (-र्त्त) Lasting and acute pain from a wound or maim.  E. प्रहार striking, and आर्त्त pained.
प्रहारार्त्त: प्रहारार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Bruised, wounded, hurt by a blow. 	 n. (-र्त्त) Lasting and acute pain from a wound or maim.  E. प्रहार striking, and आर्त्त pained.
प्रहास: प्रहास m. (-सः) 	 1. Loud laughter. 	 2. Ridicule, derision. 	 3. Irony. 	 4. Blowing, (as a flower). 	 5. Sīva. 	 6. An actor, a dancer. 	 7. A place of pilgrimage; also सोमतीर्थ.  E. प्र before, हस् to laugh, aff. घञ् ।
प्रहासिन्: प्रहासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) 	 1. Laughing aloud. 	 3. Diverting or causing laughter. 	 m. (-सी) A jester, a Buffoon, a clown.  E. प्र before, हस् to laugh, aff. णिनि ।
प्रहि: प्रहि m. (-हिः) A well.  E. प्र before, हृ to take, unādi aff. इन्, and the final of the radical rejected.
प्रहित: प्रहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Sent, dispatched. 	 2. Appointed, commissioned. 3. Stretched out, extended. 	 4. Placed. 	 5. Discharged as an arrow from a bow. 	 6. Learned. 	 7. Suitable, appropriate. 	 n. (-तं) Sauce, gravy, condiment.  E. प्र before, हित proper.
प्रहीण: प्रहीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Left, abandoned. 	 n. (-णं) Removal, loss, waste, destruction.  E. प्र before, हा to quit, ल्युट् aff.
प्रहीणजीवित: प्रहीणजीवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dead, slain.  E. प्रहीण and जीवित life.
प्रहुत: प्रहुत n. (-तं) Offering articles of food to spirits or goblins.  E. प्र well, हु to offer in oblation, क्त aff.
प्रहृत: प्रहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Seized. 	 2. Struck, beaten, wounded. 	 n. (-तं) 	 1. Striking, killing. 	 2. A stroke, a blow.  E. प्र and हृत taken.
प्रहृष्ट: प्रहृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Pleased, delighted. 	 2. Bristling.  E. प्र before, हृष् to be pleased, aff. क्त ।
प्रहृष्टक: प्रहृष्टक m. (-कः) A crow.  E. प्र before, हृष्ट pleased, aff. कन् ।
प्रहेणक: प्रहेणक n. (-कं) Victuals or sweetmeats, &c. distributed at festivals.
प्रहेलक: प्रहेलक n. (-कं) 	 1. A riddle, an enigma, a puzzling question. 	 2. A kind of cake.
प्रहेलि: प्रहेलि f. (-लिः) A poetic riddle.: See the next.
प्रहेलिका: प्रहेलिका f. (-का) An enigma, a riddle, a puzzling or enigmatical ques-tion.  E. प्र before, हिल् to play and इन्-संज्ञायां कन् aff. It is thus defined in Vāchaspatya. “व्यक्तीकृत्य कमप्यर्थं स्वरूपार्थस्य गोपनात् । यत्र बाह्यान्तरावर्थौ कथ्यते सा प्रहेलिका ॥”
प्रह्राद: प्रह्राद m. (-दः) A prince: see प्रह्लाद.  E. ल changed to र ।
प्रह्लत्ति: प्रह्लत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Pleasure, happiness.  E. प्र before, ह्लद् to be glad, क्तिन् aff.
प्रह्लन्न: प्रह्लन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Pleased, happy, glad.  E. प्र before, ह्लाद् to be happy, क्त aff.
प्रह्लन्नि: प्रह्लन्नि f. (-न्निः) Pleasure, delight.  E. प्र before, ह्लद् to be happy, क्तिन् aff.
प्रह्लाद: प्रह्लाद m. (-दः) 	 1. Pleasure, joy, happiness. 	 2. Sound, noise. 	 3. The name of HIRAṆYĀKSHA'S PIOUS son and regent of one division of Pātāla.  E. प्र before, ह्लाद gladness or sound.
प्रह्लादित: प्रह्लादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rejoiced, delighted.  E. प्रह्लाद to be happy, क्त aff.
प्रह्व: प्रह्व mfn. (-ह्वः-ह्वा-ह्वं) 	 1. Bowed, bent, stooping. 	 2. Intent upon, engaged in, engrossed by. 	 3. Sloping, slanting, inclining. 	 4. Submissive, humble.  E. प्र before, ह्वेञ् to call, Unādi aff. वन्, form irr.
प्रह्वाञ्जलि: प्रह्वाञ्जलि mfn. (-लिः-लिः-लि) Stooping or bowing with the palm of the hands joined, and put to the forehead in taken of respect.  E. प्रह्व, and अञ्जलि salute.
प्रह्वाय: प्रह्वाय m. (-यः) Calling, summoning, invocation.  E. प्र before, ह्वे to call, घञ् aff.
प्रह्वीकृत: प्रह्वीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Conquered, won, subjected. 	 2. Bent, bowed. E. प्रह्व, and कृत made, च्वि aff.
प्रा: प्रा r. 2nd cl. (प्राति) To fill. अदा० पर० सक० अनिट् ।
प्रांशु: प्रांशु mfn. (-शुः-शुः-शु) 	 1. High, tall, lofty. 	 2. A tall man, a man of great stature.  E. प्र before, अंशु a ray of light.
प्राक्: प्राक् Ind. 	 1. Before, already, prior, preceding, in place or time. 	 2. In front of. 	 3. As for as, up to. 	 4. Previously. 	 5. East, eastern. 	 6. Past, gone. 	 7. First. 	 8. Between, amongst, amidst. 	 9. At dawn, early in the morning. E. See प्राच् ।
प्राकरणिक: प्राकरणिक f. (-की) Belonging to the subject under discussion, relevant to the matter in hand; (the word is sometimes used in the sense of upameya in rhetorical works).
प्राकषिक: प्राकषिक m. (-कः) 	 1. A catamite. 	 2. A dancer, but especially one who employs or hires the wives of others. 	 3. One who gets his livelihood by another man's wife.  E. प्र and आङ् prefixed to कष् to go, Unādi aff. किकन् ।
प्राकाम्य: प्राकाम्य n. (-म्यं) 	 1. Irresistible will or fiat, one of the ŚIVA'S eight attributes. 	 2. Wilfulness, following or obeying one's own will or inclination.  E. प्र and आङ् before, कम् to desire, aff. ण्यत् ।
प्राकार: प्राकार m. (-रः) An inclosure, a fence, a rampart, particularly a sur-rounding wall, &c. elevated on a mound of earth.  E. प्र and आङ् implying initial, first, कृ to make, aff. घञ्; otherwise the prefix is considered as प्र only, the vowel being made long by the affix being घञ् ।
प्राकारीय: प्राकारीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. Walled, enclosed by a wall. 	 2. Of, belonging to, or fit for wall.  E. प्राकार and छ aff.
प्राकृत: प्राकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Low, common, vulgar, thence especially appli-cable to a provincial and peculiar dialect of the Sanskrit language. 2. Natural. 	 3. Belonging to or derived from the philosophical Pra-kritī, illusory, material, &c. 	 m. (-तः) A low man or one following a degraded profession. 	 n. (-तं) Any dialect not Sanskrit, it is espe-cially spoken by the female characters and the inferior personages of plays,  E. प्रकृति nature, and अण् aff., or प्र pre-eminently and अकृत not made.
प्राकृतज्वर: प्राकृतज्वर m. (-रः) Common or usual fever, occurring from the affections of the wind, bile, and phlegm severally, in as many seasons, or the rains, autumn and spring.  E. प्राकृत and ज्वर fever.
प्राकृतप्रलय: प्राकृतप्रलय m. (-यः) The total dissolution of the world.  E. प्राकृत material, and प्रलय destruction.
प्राकृतमानुष: प्राकृतमानुष m. (-षः) A man in general.  E. प्राकृत, and मानुष man.
प्राकृतमित्र: प्राकृतमित्र m. (-त्रः) A natural friend or ally; as applied to a sovereign, it means one whose states are removed by an intervening kingdom from those to which it should be friendly, the प्राकृतारि or natural enemy is the chief of the intervening state, and the प्राकृतोदासीनः or natural neutral is the outer one of the four.  E. प्राकृत natural, and मित्र a friend.
प्राकृतारि: प्राकृतारि m. (-रिः) A natural enemy or the sovereign of an adjacent country.
प्राकृतिक: प्राकृतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging or relating to Prakritī, nature or matter, material, natural, illusory, &c.  E. प्रकृति, and ठञ् aff.
प्राक्काल: प्राक्काल n. (-लं) Former age or time.  E. प्राच् and काल time.
प्राक्कालीन: प्राक्कालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Anterior, ancient, of a former time.  E. प्राक्काल and ख aff.
प्राक्कूल: प्राक्कूल m. (-लः) The tip of Kusa grass placed to the east.  E. प्राक् and कूल point of grass.
प्राक्तन: प्राक्तन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) 	 1. Old, ancient. 	 2. Prior, anterior, preceding, former.  E. प्राक् formerly, ठ्युल् aff. and तन् aug.
प्राक्तनकर्मन्: प्राक्तनकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 	 1. Fate, destiny. 	 2. Any act formerly done.  E. प्राक्तन prior, and कर्म्मन् act.
प्राक्तनकर्म्मन्: प्राक्तनकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 	 1. Fate, destiny. 	 2. Any act formerly done.  E. प्राक्तन prior, and कर्म्मन् act.
प्राक्फल: प्राक्फल m. (-लः) The bread-fruit-tree.  E. प्राक् before, (flower,) and फल fruit.
प्राक्फल्गुनी: प्राक्फल्गुनी f. (-नी) The eleventh of the lunar asterisms: see पूर्व्वफल्गुनी. E. प्राक् preceding, and फल्गुनी the asterism.
प्राक्फल्गुनीभव: प्राक्फल्गुनीभव m. (-वः) A name of VRIHASPATI.  E. प्राक्फल्गुनी and भव born, when the moon was in that mansion; also similar com-pounds as प्राक्फाल्गुनीय ।
प्राक्फाल्गुन: प्राक्फाल्गुन m. (-नः) VRIHASPATI.  E. प्राक्फल्गुनी, and अण् aff.
प्राक्शिरस: प्राक्शिरस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 	 1. Facing the east. 	 2. Having the head to the east in burial.  E. प्राच्, and शिरस् the head, मच् added.
प्राक्सन्ध्या: प्राक्सन्ध्या f. (-न्ध्या) Dawn.  E. प्राक् the first, सन्ध्या junction of the day.
प्राखर्य: प्राखर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 	 1. Sharpness. 	 2. Pungency. 	 3. Wickedness.  E. प्रखर and ष्यञ् aff.
प्राखर्य्य: प्राखर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 	 1. Sharpness. 	 2. Pungency. 	 3. Wickedness.  E. प्रखर and ष्यञ् aff.
प्रागग्र: प्रागग्र Adj. Having the point turned towards the east.
प्रागभाव: प्रागभाव m. (-वः) Antecedent privation, the non-existence of any thing which may yet be. In law, the non-possession of property that may be possessed.  E. प्राक् prior, अ negative and भाव being.
प्रागल्भ्य: प्रागल्भ्य n. (-ल्भ्यं) 	 1. Confidence, boldness, determination. 	 2. Arrogance, effrontery. 	 3. Importance, rank.  E. प्रगल्भ confident, ष्यञ् aff.
प्रागार: प्रागार m. (-रः) A house, a building.
प्रागुदीची: प्रागुदीची f. (-ची) The north-east.  E. प्राक् the east, and उदीची the north.
प्राग्गामिन्: प्राग्गामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Going before, a precursor.  E. प्राच् and गामिन् who goes.
प्राग्ज्योतिष: प्राग्ज्योतिष m. (-षः) A country, Kāmarupa, part of Assām.  E. प्राक् for-merly, ज्योतिष light; being the scene of BRAHMĀ'S penance.
प्राग्भार: प्राग्भार m. (-रः) The top or peak of a mountain.  E. प्राक् first, भार bur-then; also read प्राग्भाव ।
प्राग्भाव: प्राग्भाव m. (-वः) 	 1. Prior existence. 	 2. Superiority, excellence. 	 3. The top of a mountain.  E. प्राक् and भाव being or nature.
प्राग्भावतस्: प्राग्भावतस् Ind. From a prior state of being.  E. प्राग्भाव, and तसि aff.
प्राग्रहर: प्राग्रहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Chief, principal.  E. प्र, and अग्र first, हर who surpasses.
प्राग्राट: प्राग्राट n. (-टं) Thin curds.  E. प्र before, अग्र the top, and अट what goes.
प्राग्र्य: प्राग्र्य mfn. (-ग्र्यः-ग्र्या-ग्र्यं) Chief, principal.  E. प्र prefixed to अग्र्य chief.
प्राग्व्य: प्राग्व्य f. (-ग्व्या) Adj. Best, chief, most excellent.
प्राग्वंश: प्राग्वंश m. (-शः) 	 1. The room opposite to that which contains the ma-terials for an oblation, and in which the family and friends of the sacrificer assemble. 	 2. A former dynasty or race.  E. प्राक् before, and वंश a race, &c.
प्राघात: प्राघात m. (-तः) War, battle.  E. प्र before, हन् to kill, aff. घञ्, and the vowel of the prefix optionally made long.
प्राघार: प्राघार m. (-रः) Dropping, oozing, trickling, aspersion, or pouring out of any oily substance.  E. प्र before, घॄ to sprinkle or drop, aff. घञ् ।
प्राघुण: प्राघुण m. (-णः) A guest, a visitor, one demanding hospitality.  E. प्र and आङ् before, घुण् to turn round, aff. क ।
प्राघुण(णि)क m. (-कः) 	 1. A guest.  E. प्रघुण स्वार्थें ठक् ।
प्राघूर्णिक: प्राघूर्णिक m. (-कः) A guest.  E. प्र before, घूर्ण going about, aff. ठक् ।
प्राङ्ग: प्राङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A sort of small tabor or drum.  E. प्र before, अञ्ज् to go or be, aff. घञ् ।
प्राङ्गण: प्राङ्गण n. (-णं) 	 1. A sort of drum. 	 2. A court, a yard. 	 3. A hall, a floor. E. प्र before, अगि to go, aff. ल्युट् ।

प्रादुर्भाव: प्रादुर्भाव m. (-वः) Appearance, manifestation.  E. पादुस्, and भाव quality,

प्रापक: प्रापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Procuring causing to obtain. 	 2. Obtaining, who or what obtains.  E. प्राप् to obtain, ण्वुल् aff.

प्राप्तावसर: प्राप्तावसर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Opportune, seasonable, taking or finding occasion.  E. प्राप्त and अवसर opportunity.

E. प्र before, आप् to get or obtain, aff. क्तिन् ।
प्राप्य: प्राप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Attainable, obtainable,  E. प्र before, आप् to attain, aff. ण्यत् ।

A state or condition of life, age, youth, &c. 	 n. (-यं) Sin.  E. प्र before, इन् to go, अच् aff.

प्रावण: प्रावण n. (-णं) A spade, a hoe.

प्रासादीय: प्रासादीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of or belonging to a palace  E. प्रासाद, and छ aff.

प्रियङ्गु: प्रियङ्गु m. (-ङ्गुः) 	 1. A medicinal plant, and perfume, commonly known by the name Priyangu, and described in some places as a fra-grant seed. 	 2. Panick seed, (Panicum italicum.) 	 3. प्रियतम: प्रियतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Dearest, most beloved. 	 m. (-मः) A tree, (Celosia cristata).  E. प्रिय desirable, तमप् aff. “मयूरशिखावृक्षे” ।
प्रियतर: प्रियतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Dearer, more dear.  E. प्रिय, तरप् comparative aff.
प्रियता: प्रियता f. (-ता) Love, affection.  E. प्रिय beloved, तल् aff.; also with त्व aff. प्रियत्व n. (-त्वं).
प्रियदर्शन: प्रियदर्शन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Handsome, lovely, good-looking. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. A parrot. 	 2. A tree, (Mimusops kauki).  E. प्रिय beloved, and दर्शन appearance.
प्रियप्राय: प्रियप्राय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Eloquent, well-spoken, of pleasing speech. 	 n. (-यं) Eloquence in language.  E. प्रिय desired, प्राय abundance.
प्रियप्रेप्सु: प्रियप्रेप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Lamenting the loss or absence of any beloved object, wishing or grieving for it.  E. प्रिय beloved and प्रेप्सु desirous.
प्रियभाषण: प्रियभाषण n. (-णं) Speaking kindly.  E. प्रिय and भाषण speaking.
प्रियमधु: प्रियमधु m. (-धुः) BALARĀMA, the half-brother of KRISHṆA  E. प्रिय fond, मधु wine.
प्रियमाण: प्रियमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Beloved, affectionate.  E. प्रि to please, शानच् aff.
प्रियंवद: प्रियंवद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Sweet or pleasant speaking. 	 m. (-दः) A sort of demi-god or Vidyādhara  E. प्रिय kind, desired, वद् to speak, aff. खच्, मुम् aug.
प्रियम्भविष्णु: प्रियम्भविष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Become dear to, or beloved by.  E. प्रिय, मू to be, खिष्णुच् aff.

प्रियम्भावुक: प्रियम्भावुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Become dear to, or beloved by.  E. प्रिय, and भू to be, खुकञ् aff.
प्रियम्भावुकता: प्रियम्भावुकता f. (-ता) Amiability, becoming beloved, the state or condi-tion.  E. तल् added to the last.
प्रियवर्णी: प्रियवर्णी f. (-र्णी) A creeping plant, (Echites frutescens.)  E. प्रिय desired, घर्ण class.
प्रियवादिन्: प्रियवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Sweet or pleasant spoken, flattering, a flat-terer.  E. प्रिय kind, वादिन् who speaks.
प्रियसख: प्रियसख m. (-खः) A tree, (Khayer, or Mimosa catechu.) 	 f. (-खी) A female friend or companion, a confidant.  E. प्रिय desired, सखि a friend, टच् aff.
प्रियसत्य: प्रियसत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Pleasant and true. 	 n. (-त्यं) Eloquent or pleas-ing, as well as true, (discourse.)  E. प्रिय loved, and सत्य true.
प्रियसन्देश: प्रियसन्देश m. (-शः) A tree bearing a fragrant flower, (Michelia cham-paca.)  E. प्रिय a friend, and सन्देश intelligence “चम्पकवृक्षे”.
प्रियाख्य: प्रियाख्य mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं) Announcing good tidings.  E. प्रिय, and आख्य who says
प्रियाल: प्रियाल m. (-लः) A tree, commonly Piyāsāl, (Buchanania latifolia, Rox-BUKGH'S catalogue, but the name is applied to different trees.) E. प्रि to satisfy, aff. कालन् and the radical vowel changed to रि; also with कन् added प्रियालक m. (-कः) and with the vowel protract ed. प्रीयाल m. (-लः) also-as derived from पीय a Sautra root, पीयाल. or पियाल &c.
प्रियासु: प्रियासु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) Fond of life.  E. प्रिय, and असु breath.
प्रियैषिन्: प्रियैषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Friendly, affectionate, wishing to please. E. प्रिय, and एषिन् seeking.
प्रियोदित: प्रियोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well or kindly spoken, pleasingly uttered. 	 n. (-तं) Kindly or gentle speech.  E. प्रिय kind, &c. and उदित said.
प्री: प्री (ङ) प्रीङ् r. 4th cl. (प्रीयते) (ञ) प्रीञ् r. 9th cl. (प्रीणाति प्रीणीते) and 1st and 10th cls. (प्रियति-ते प्राययति-ते) or प्रीणयति 1. To please, to delight, to satisfy. 	 2. To be pleased or satisfied. 	 3. To desire or love.
प्रीण: प्रीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. Old ancient. 	 2. Pleased, satisfied.  E. प्री to please, aff. णिच्-क्त ।
प्रीणन: प्रीणन n. (-नं) Satisfaction, satisfying, satiety.  E. प्री to please aff. ल्युट् ।
प्रीणयित्वा: प्रीणयित्वा Ind. Having pleased or propitiated,  E. प्री to please, क्ता aff.
प्रीत: प्रीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Pleased, happy, glad. 	 2. Pleased or satisfied with. 	 3. Gracicus, kind, affectionate. 	 4. Beloved, dear to. 	 n. (-तं) Pleasure, delight.  E. प्री to please, aff. क्त ।
प्रीतात्मन्: प्रीतात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Pleased, satisfied, content.  E. प्रीत and आत्मन् self.
प्रीति: प्रीति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Joy, pleasure, happiness. 	 2. Love, affection, regard. 3. The wife of KĀMA, or Cupid. 	 4. The second of the twenty-seven astronomical Yogas.  E. प्री to please, aff. क्तिच ।
प्रीतिकर: प्रीतिकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Pleasing, agreeable to.  E. प्रीति and कर making.
प्रीतिजुषा: प्रीतिजुषा f. (-षा) The wife of ANIRUDDHA.  E. प्रीति the wife of KĀMA, जुष् to serve, affs. क and टाप् ।
प्रीतिद: प्रीतिद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Affectionate, inspiring love or regard. 	 m. (-दः) A jester, a buffoon.  E. प्रीति affection, pleasure and द who gives.
प्रीतिदान: प्रीतिदान n. (-नं) A kind or friendly present.  E. प्रीति affection, and दान giving.
प्रीतिदाय: प्रीतिदाय n. (-यं) A gift or token of affection.  E. प्रीति and दाय a gift.
प्रीतिपूर्व्वक: प्रीतिपूर्व्वक n. (-कं) Adv. Through favour or kindness.  E. प्रीति and पूर्व्वक an antecedent.
प्रीतिमत्: प्रीतिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Kind, affectionate.  E. प्रीति and मतुप् aff.
प्रीतिमनस: प्रीतिमनस mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः) 	 1. Content, happy. 	 2. Kind.  E. प्रीति and मन्स् the mind.
प्रीतिवचस्: प्रीतिवचस् n. (-चः) Gracious or kindly speech.  E. प्रीति and वचस् speech.
प्रीयमाण: प्रीयमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being pleased or propitiated.  E. प्री to please, pass. v., शानच् aff.
प्रु: प्रु (ङ) प्रुङ् r. 1st cl. (प्रवते) 	 1. To go, to move. 	 2. To jump.

प्रुष्ट: प्रुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Burnt.  E. प्रुष् to burn, aff. क्ता ।

प्रेक्षक: प्रेक्षक m. (-कः) A spectator, a beholder, one of an audience.  E. प्र be-fore, ईक्ष् to see, वुन् aff.

प्रेक्षमाण: प्रेक्षमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Looking at or on, beholding, regarding.  E. प्र before, इक्ष् to see, शानच् aff.
प्रेक्ष्यमाण: प्रेक्ष्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being seen or looked at.  E. प्र before, ईक्ष् to see, pass. v., शानच् aff.
प्रेक्षा: प्रेक्षा f. (-क्षा) 	 1. Intellect, understanding. 	 2. Dancing. 	 3. Seeing, view-ing, observing. 	 4. Seeing a play or entertainment of dancing, &c. 5. The branch of a tree. 	 6. Deliberation, reflection.  E. प्र before, ईक्ष् to see, affs. अङ् and टाप् ।

प्रेङ्खोलित: प्रेङ्खोलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Agitated, shaken, swung, set in motion. E. प्रेङ्खोल nominal verb, to swing, aff क्त.
प्रेत: प्रेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dead, deceased. 	 m. (-तः) 	 1. A ghost, a goblin, a spirit, an evil being, especially animating the carcases of the dead. 	 2. The spirit before obsequial rites are performed.  E. प्र be-fore, इत gone.
प्रेतकर्मन्: प्रेतकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Funeral or obsequial rites.  E. प्रेत and कर्म्मन् act; also प्रेतकार्य्य, प्रेतक्रिया &c.
प्रेतकर्म्मन्: प्रेतकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Funeral or obsequial rites.  E. प्रेत and कर्म्मन् act; also प्रेतकार्य्य, प्रेतक्रिया &c.
प्रेतकार्य: प्रेतकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Obsequial ceremonies, any usages observed in honour of the dead.  E. प्रेत dead, कार्य्य practice.
प्रेतकार्य्य: प्रेतकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Obsequial ceremonies, any usages observed in honour of the dead.  E. प्रेत dead, कार्य्य practice.
प्रेतकृत्य: प्रेतकृत्य nf. (-त्यं-त्या) Obsequial rites.  E. प्रेत and कृत्य a ceremony; also प्रेतकर्म्म, &c.

प्रेतत्व: प्रेतत्व n. (-त्वं) The character or state of a departed spirit.  E. प्रेत and त्व aff.

प्रेतनर: प्रेतनर m. (-रः) A ghost, a corpse.  E. प्रेत and नर a man.
प्रेतनिर्हारक: प्रेतनिर्हारक m. (-कः) 	 1. A man-employed to carry forth dead bodies. 2. A kinsman who does so.  E. प्रेत and निर् out, हृ to take, ण्वुल् aff.
प्रेतपक्ष: प्रेतपक्ष n. (-क्षं) The dark half of the month.  E. प्रेत and पक्ष a fortnight.

प्रेतपति: प्रेतपति m. (-तिः) YAMA, ruler of the dead.  E. प्रेत dead and पति master.

प्रेतवाहित: प्रेतवाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Possessed by a devil or fiend.  E. प्रेत a spirit and वाहित borne, actuated.

प्रेतहार: प्रेतहार m. (-रः) One who carries a corpse, a near kinsman.  E. प्रेत and हार who takes.
प्रेतान्न: प्रेतान्न n. (-न्नं) Food offered to the manes or distributed on a person's death.  E. प्रेत and अन्न food.
प्रेतोद्देश: प्रेतोद्देश m. (-शः) An offering to the manes.  E. प्रेत and उद्देश object.
प्रेत्य: प्रेत्य Ind. 	 1. In the next world. 	 2. Having died.  E. प्रेत dead, and यत् aff. or प्र before, इ to go, ल्यप् aff.

Swimming, floating, diving. 	 3. A raft, a float. 4. A frog. 	 5. A monkey. 	 6. A sheep. 	 7. A diver, or bird so called, (Pelicanus fusicollis.) 	 8. A sort of duck. 	 9. Leaping, jumping, tumbling. 	 mn. (-तः-तं) The third sound given to vowels; the protracted or continuous sound, being three times the length of the short vowel, and occupying three moments in its utterance.  E. प्लु to go by leaps, aff. क्त ।
